tei:div.tei:p: chab spel tshe brtan phun tshothogs kyi ce'om rig brtsams chotshos phyedags bsgrigs/hā/ ༵༵༵ chi0/ ri smo067 thababa'i5ba ri 602 ri 551 15 01712 67 ri ma po ri 05059570ཿ ri

phi spel gyi gsung rtsom dang rig gzhung bawo tsho zhib dzog dpe tshogs/ 6 yi ༈༈ cha cho sadze ci'i 7 7 5 ྅(rjo khu nga ngarngoXrig ra tha nganor dza ner lisgo/ ga phoXng sna༅/ri pho(kha rigasang rtse rsharmedze༄ / cha ba spel tshe brta na phun tshog sa kyi ca na tswa la ri rngo ༷ 〉 kā la rdo ri gyi ci /sna / 4 ga ri /rte / da/ki/ngas snye dzā ni tshe skos 6 3cing / /tshe 6 40 / rsha/ lgo 'e / dzha/ snye ci ji kha 'i la shī pi spelatshe brtan phure tshogasakyis brtsams/ chab spel rig gzhung bsam tsho zhib 'jug tshogs chung gis bsgrigs/ ming dku bod rig pa dpe man khang bod snangasabong yis dpe rnying /nge spun zung /
4/ rta — — 4 ji momi — —ji cimebyucho

chab spel gyi gsu nga com dang rig bzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jus dpe tshosas/ (5) ri70/na tshang///tshelko u yismosmo05 phobo rog /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos 4phyogs bsgrigs/ ba spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyis brtsams/chab spel rig gzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jug tshogs chung gis bsgrigs/krung bo'i bod ris/ pa dpe skrun khang /bod ljongs bod yis dpe rnying dpe skrun khang /

༄ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyi rig gzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jug tshogs chung gi blo 'don u yon/las don mdzub ston u yor lhan lang gi sbyi khyab blo 'don pa/ wu'u ying ce/rig gzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jug u yon lhan khang i byu khyab blo 'dor pa/tshu'i yu sa ying /blo 'don ba/ blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ lhag pa phun tshogs/ pad ma rnam rgyal/hren la'e yun/ bsod nams rig 'dzin/ ngag dbang tshe ring /tshe brtan bkra shis/ zhus kong kri/ kro'u yo na/khren ching ying / wang ku'e/

༄khyo/chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyi rig gzhung bsaX blo'i zhib 'jug tshogs chung gi las don u yon/tsu'u krang / sun yung /tsu'u krang gzhon pa/ ko'o lin/ wang zha'o snang / yon tan tshe ring /khongs mi/ 'brong bu tshe ring rdo rje/ ho tsung dbying / skal bzang ye shes/tshe ring dpal 'byor/

༄ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyi rig gzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jug tshogs chung gi tshogs mi/rtsom sgrig u yon lhan khang ma kru'u ren/ sun yu nga / gtso 'gan rtsom sgrig ba/ 'byong bu tshe ring ngo rje/ ho tsung dbying /gco 'gan rtsom sgrig gzhon pa/ phur bu rdo rje/(rgyun las) dbang drag sdo rje/rtsom sgrib u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi/'byong bu tshe ring rdo rje/ ho tsung dbying / phur bu rdo rje/krin li me/ dbang dras rdo rje/ zla ba/ gro mo zla ba tshe ring /zla ba tshe ring / skal bzang phun tshogs /lan tshe| hwa/rtsom sgrig 'ab bsher pa 'brong bu tshe ring rtso rje/mtha' ma'i 'ab bsher pa lhas pa tshe ring /'u dag pa/ dbang dras rdo rje/

1— ——ge ri chab spel gyi rig gzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jug bcar 'dri'i byed sgo spel skabs kyi gtam bshad / —dpe tshogs 'di nyid kyi gleng gzhi'i ched du bkod pa/ ga sun yung /bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug thad/ sngon gyi mkhas pa tshos gzhi 'dzin lta grub 'dra min gyi thog nas bstan bcos mi nyung ba zhig brtsams myong yod na'ang /nye ba'i dus rabs gong si lo rgyus deb zer mi nyungaba'i khrod/ bod kyi lo rgyus kun lha rgyang gtam rgyud kyi tshul du bris pas/ deng dus kyi lo rgyus rig pa'i ngosanas bltas tshe/ ris gzhung dpyad zhib kyi yid brtan 'pher dka' zhing /lo rgyus dpyad yig rtog 'jug girabang du btang na'ang / deb ther de tshor lo rgyus kyi rin thangaldanasad kyang / rin thang sngon 'don byed pa la/ nges par du rmongs byed smug zhag snag pos 'thums pa rnams dbye sel rim can byed dbosayaste/ lha sgrung gi snang tshul brgyud lo rgyus kyi dngos don ji bzhin gsal rtogs thub pa byed dgos/ zhib 'jug gi las don 'ji nyid mi mang ngo zhig la mtshon na/ ha cang dka' tshegs che ba zhig yin/ zhib 'jug pa dang klog pa po mang po zhig rtag tu deb ther de dag gi lha sgrung gtam rgyud kyis maso bo sbos thing mun 'thoms kyi gnas su bsgyur nas/ khong tsho'i mthong chos su grub pa ni gnam gyi lha dang mi'i rje bo ji ltarazung du 'brel ba'i bshad rgyun thor rasas tsam du zad gathis/ bod kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas skor la lo rgyus kyi

2 ga /chab spel tshe brtan gun chosas kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/wa wa —— —wa lta stangs gsal zhing dwangs pa zhig shin tu nas 'byung lag por gyur yod/bod du bod risas mkhas pas nye rabs sam deng rabs lo rgyus ril par zhib 'jug byas pa'i khrod du/ chab spel mchog nas gtso 'gan rtsom sgrig mdzad pa'i (bod kyi lo rgyus ragasarim g.yu yi phreng bar 〉rig 0zhung dpyad zhib kyi thad cha 'jog yid rton rung ba'i go babs chen po ldan pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mkhas dbang nyid nas bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug la gzhol ba'i brgyud rim nang / mdzub khrid bsam blo ha cang gsal po yod pa dang / 'jug sgo sang zab kyis brtag thabs smra ba'i rig gzhung si thabs lam la brten sasar gtod bya rgyu gal cher brtsis nas/ lo rgyus kyi dngos don rang bzhin la brtsi 'jog byed pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen 'og brtags shing dpyod pa'i thabs lam ci rigs kyis lo rgyus kyi dngos don brtsad 'tshol dang ra sprod phra zhib mdzad yod/ chab spel mchog nas dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang gsungs myong bar/ bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jus de phyi rol dngos don gyi chos nyid dang mthun zhing yongs su gzu bor gnas pa dang / klog pa bos yid ches byar 'os snyam pa zhig 'byung dgos na/ gsham gsal phyogs gsum gyi thad nus shugs chen po rgyag dgos pa ni/1 bod mi rigs rang gi lorgyus yig tshang sngog 'don phyogs sgrig gang legs byed dgos/ de yang yig tshang de das gi khrod du skabs de'i rtsom pa po dang skabs de'i mi pal ba tshos mig mthong byung ba'i lo rgyus dag zin thor bkod yod pa'i phyir/2 bod kyi lo rgyus rig pa'i zhib 'jug brgyud rim nang / phyi don dngos dang mthun zhing drang po drang bzhag yong ba byed par/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi lo rgyus yis tshang phud/ da dung mi rigs gzhan gyis bris pa'i lo rgyus

ga /gleng gzhi/ 3— — riyig rigs la'ang dpyad 0zhi cha 'jog byed dgos pa ste dper na rgya rigs dang / sog rigs/ shī shā la sogs pa'i gle rgyus deb ther nang bi bod dang 'brel yod dpyad yig dang / de bzhin tun hong gna' yig khrod kyi bod dang 'brel yod kyi nang don sogs lta bu'o//3 sana' rdzas rtog zhib kyi grub 'bras rnams bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug thad bed spyod gang zab dang gang legs bya rgyu yang gal 'gangs shin tu che zhing med du mi rung ba zhig yin zhes gsungs/de lta na'ang / chab spel mchog nas dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu'i thad lta tshul re 'ga' gsungs pa la/skabs der srol rgyun lta bar zhen pa'i mkhas pa mi nyung ba zhig gis yid rtse gnyis la gzhol ba'i 'khang ra'ang gnang myong yod/ de ni rig sazhung bsam blo'i lta tshul thad bcings 'grol yang dag ma thob pas lan zhi sa brjod pa tsam gyis mi chog par/ de'i khrod kyi gnad don mang po zhig ni ris gzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jug gi thabs lam ltar thon yin min gyi gnad don dang / ris gzhung zhib 'jus gi mdzub khrid bsam blo dang rig 0zhung dpyad zhib kyi brtas thabs smra ba'i gnad don la rag las yod pa zhig red/ chab spel mchog bi lo ngo nyi shu'i lhag ring gi rigs lam dpyad 'bras shin tu phun sum tshogs pa dang / phon 'bo che ba phud/ gal che shos ni bod kyi srol rgyun lo rgyus smra ba'i zhib 'jug thabs lam gyi 'ching rgya las dbye mtshams ring du phyes par brten/ gang nyid kyi rigs lam rtog 'jug bya gzhas de skas rim sasar pa zhig tu slebs thub pa byung yod/ gang des sngar byung ma myong ba'i rig gzhung dpyad zhib kyi dpangs mthon po de lta bur rkang pa tshulas par byas te rang 'gul rang rtogs ngang rigs lam dpyad zhib la 'jug thub pa ci'i

40— ga /chabaspel tshe brtan sun tshog kyi ma ni/sne brtsam chos phyogs bsgrigs/phyir ram zhi na/ de'i thad mi rabs rjes ma rnams kyi ngos nas/ lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs chen po dang zung du 'brel nas ngos 'dzin byed dgos pa yin/ bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus hril po'i byung rabs mang das cig gis chab spel mchos la bag chags ha cang chen po bzhag pa yang / dper na btsan dbang rgyal khab kyi btsan 'dzul dang / bod kyi mtho rim pa'i 'khrug rtsod/ ming go'i krung dbyang sku tshab bod la phebs nas tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid khri gsol mdzad sgor gtso skyong gnang ba/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa/ de bzhin dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur la sogs pas gang gi rigs lam dpyad 'jug thad shugs rkyen zab mo thebs yod/ gang gis yon tan la brtson zhib gnang ba'i ring /skabs de dus kyi dran dbang mi nyung ba zhig dang 'brel 'dris gnang myong ba dang / bag chags zab shos ni nye rabs bod kyi lo rgyus smra bar dge mtshan du mas phyug pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po dge 'dun chos 'phel gang nyid yin/ dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog ni bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus thog ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa 'i mi sna zhig yin la/ gang de'i bod kyi lo rgyus skor gyi 'grel brjod lag dang / bod kyi gnas skabs 595 dus skor gyi lta stangs bzhed dgongs/ lhag don gang des skabs der brtsams par mdzad cing /skabs de dus bod sa gnas kyi dbang bsgyur pas lta spyod shin tu log par brtsi ba'i bka' rtsom de dag las gsal por mthong thub pa ni/ bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus rig pa'i bo rgyus thog mi tshul ring lugs kyi 'od snang rab tu 'tsher zhing / bod mi rigs kyi bsam blo'i lo rgyus 'phel rim nang gdod ma'i dngos gtso — ring lugs kyi lta ba'i myu gu 'bus 'go tshugs pa de red/mi'i risas kyi bsam blo'i lo rgyus 'phel rim gyi khyen yongs la blta skabs/rang res dngos don 'di 'dra zhig mthong thub pa ste/ mi'i rigs kyi lo ngo stong

—wa —wa — ——— —— —— ra /chesangagazhi/ ri daphrag du ma'i lo rgyus khrod du/ spyir na lha yod smra ba dang / dngos po yod tshad la bla srog yod par smra ba nas/ rim bzhin gdod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs dang / de bzhin dngos gtso ring lugs/ lha med smra ba bcas rim bzhin dar ba dang 'dzam gling yul gru mang po zhig nang / dper na sana' bo'i ke ri si dang rang rgyal gyi dbus gzhung sa khul lta bur lo ngo stong 'ga'i snga rol nas lha med smra ba'i bsam blo byung yo da mod/ bod kyi bsam blo'i lo rgyus 'phel rim dang / bod yig gsar du btod pa'i thog ma'i skabs de nas/ dus yun ha cang ring po zhig nang lta yod smra ba'i khyad chos 'ba' zhig mngon du phyung ba la/dase 'dun chos 'phel byon pa nas bzung / da sazod bod kyi bsam blo'i lo rgyus thog lo ngo stong phras du ma'i ring lha yod smra ba'i bsam blos kha 'o bsgyur ba'i srol rgyun la 'gyur ldog phyogs cha tsam gtong thub byung yod/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi bsam blos bod yul spyi dang lhag par bod rigs shes yon can rnams la phan che'i shugs rkyen che tsam thebs myong yod pa dang / ma mthar yang skabs de'i spyi tshogs rim gras khag nang sbir grasas chen po byung zhing / sa gnas dbang 'dzin pas kyang de la 'jigs snang byed kyin yod/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi bsam blo des/ shes rig gi bden don nyid la brtson zhib don gnyer dang / mdun skyod kyi lam bu gsar du 'tshol rgyu'i thad/ rang mi rigs kyi shes yon can rnams la gting phug zab min la ma ltos par bag chags gang legs bzhag yod/ chab spel mchog nas kyang de bzhin ngos 'dzin sanang don du/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gdod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs dang mi tshul ring lugs kyi dbongs don mtha' dag sang de'i rigs lam rtos 'jug gi mi tshe'i bshul lam khrod du shul ris mtshon rtags ha cang zab mo yod ces gsungs mi rigs sang dang gang yin rung thog ma'i bsam blo nyag phra ba nge nas

6 ga /chab spel tshe bstan sun tshoms kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos zugs bsgrigs/wa wa — — wa warang rtogs kyi bsam blo 'byung ba'i go rim khrod sngon byon skyes bu dam pa rnams la brten nas bgrod lam gsar bshongs byed dbos kyi yod/ dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog dang chab spel mchog ni rang cag bod rigs shes yon can khrod kyi bsam blo gsar pa'i bgrod lam btod mkhan ngo mnongs mi dathos pa'i mkhas dbang gnyis yin pa dang / da dung chab spel mchog nas snga mthud phyi skyong gi nus nga bla lhag tu 'don gnang mdzad pa yin/ sal srid de ltar ma yin na bod mi rigs hril ngo 'i bsam blo nyid lha yod smra ba'i 'ching rgya las cis skyong sgrol bar dka' zhing / rjes 'jug don gnyer can rnams kyang mang des ming gzhi bting pa'i lam bu brgyud sngar bas myur zhing yang dag pa'i lam khar bskyod thabs bral bar 'gyur nges yin chab spel mchog nas rang gi zhib 'jug i las ku'i smor gleng skabs thengs mang gsungs myong bar/ mes rgyal spun zla mi rigs kyi bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'am dpyad zhib gros tshogs khas la zhugs tshe blo gsogs cher bskyed thub pa dang / bsam sazhig gi nus pa rgya cher 'gro ba bcas kyi phan 'bras spyir btang ma yin pa thos byung zhes dang /ma'o tse tung si mtshan nyid rig pa'i gsung rtsom la slob sbyong zhus pa brgyud/ 'o rgyus dngos gtso ring lugs la rtsa ba'i nges shes rnyed nas rang ngos kyi dpyad zhib las ke'i thad mdzub ston gyi dge mtshan chen po byung zhes gsungs shing /de yang rang res phyi rol gyi don dngos la gzhigs pa dang / ris dang bral ba'i sgo nas ltos tshe chab spel mchog nas bod kyi bsam blo'i lo rgyus khyod du gnas babs gal chen bzung nges shing / bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus rig pa'i bsam blo'i lo rgyus thog rdo ring lta bu'i mdzad rjes chen po ba'ag yod ces kyang brjod rung ngo / /rgyu mtshan de rang la brten nas/ rig gzhung zhib 'jug las rigs dang /

rdza/gleng bzhi/ 7lhag don bod rig pa'i khyab khongs kyi mkhas dbang gang mang zhi/ gis chab spel mchog la do snang chen po gnang gin yo da pa yang / zhib 'jug la mkho ba'i dpyad gzhi 'tshol sgrub kyi ched tsam ma yin par/ chab spel gang nyid bod rigs shes yon can bgres gras shig yin pa dang / gang des rig gzhung dpyad zhib kyi bshul lam ring mo dang / bsam blo'i 'phel phyogs kyi ngang tshul bcas par yid 'jog chen po gnang bas yin/chab spel mchog nas rig sazhung dpyad zhib la gzhol ba'i dus dkyil tsam du/ snyan pa 'i grags pa ring du khyab gyur nas/ krung dbyang gi dbu khrid la yang thags snang byung ba dang / skabs thog bod rang skyong nyo ngas kyi dab khrid rigi ༅ zi sde smyo jig kyis sang gi zhib 'jus byed sgo dang 'tsho ba sang cir thugs 'khur ha cang chen po gnang ba yin/ blo mthun hu'u cin tha'o yis bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tang ud hru'u ci'i thugs 'gan bzhes ring chab spel mchog la thugs 'khur ches cher gnang myong ba dang / gnam lo gsar tshes skabs khyim du gzigs par phebs pa ma zad/ sku ngo mas zhib 'jug 'gro gron gyi sand don thas gcod gnang ba dang / 1990lor spyi khyab hru'u ci cang tse min mchog la ngos sbyor yang mdzad/ (bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim gci yi phreng ba 〉 zhes pa'i stod cha thog mar 'grems pa'i mdzad sgo tshugs nyin/ cin tha'o hru'u ci sku dngos tshogs rar phebs thog gal che'i gsung bshad kyang sanang ste/ dpe ngeb de nyid la sadeng 'jos gang legs mdzad pa la sogs kyi ngang tshul de dag ri /cin tha'o hru'u cis bod du phyag las gnang ring bod du las don sgo kun la gcig gyur 'char 'god dang khyon yo ngas nas lta rtog bya rgyur mthong chen sanang ba dang / lhas pa ra du bod kyi shes ldan mi snar gces 'dzin gzigs skyong mdzad lugs sacig bsdus su mngon pa zhig yin la/ de'i thog nas tang dang

8 ga chab spol tshe brtan kun tshog kyi rtsom ris brtsam chos rgyags bsgrig /wa —wa wa wa wasrid gzhung gis grangs nyung mi rigs kyi shes yon can la snga mo nyid nas byams brtse'i gces skyong gnang lugs mngon par gsal ba dang / rang re'i dus rabs 'di'i khyad yon dang tang gi gzhi rtsa'i dmigs yul yongs su mtshon pa zhig yin / chab spel mchog nas bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang du phyag las lo mang gnang ba dang / thog mtha' bar gsum du rtse gcig sbyang brtson ngang dus 'da' bar mdzad pa'i gshes rgyud de nyid nged cag gi mig dper 'os pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ rtag 'grus g.yel med dang / gzhan la nyams khrid gnang rgyur sun snang ye med par/ spam mtho'i legs skyes ji snyed mdzad yod thogarang cag kun la rtsa che'i rgyu nor mang dag bzhag cing 'jog mus mchis/bgres po gang gis kyang de bzhin gsal kha gnang bar/ rang ngos kyi 'dun pa che shos ni/ bdag nyid kyi shes bya dang bsam gzhig gi 'bras bu gang yod gtan 'jalas yong bar byas nas mi rabs rjes ma'i dpyad byar 'bul rgyu de yin zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bgres po gang gi mi lo bcu phral ring gi thugs re mngon sum legs 'grubasapong ba bya rgyu de rang re rjes rabs rnams la mtshon na/g.yol du med pa'i 'os 'gan rang yin/ da cha chab spel mchog sku na shin tu smin pa ra brten/ chab srid dang / rig gzhung dpyad zhib kyi gnas babs gang thad nas bshad kyang / spyi tshogs tshan rig krong gis gang de'i ris gzhung bsam blo dang / ris gzhung dpyad zhib kyi mi tshe'i bshul lam/ de bzhin gal che'i dpyad rtsom khag bcas pa ra myur skyob rang bzhin gyi zhib 'jug bya rgyu de ni dgos pa don la gnas pa zhig yin/ gal srid de 'dra ma byung tshe sngar song phyis 'byung kun la ngo gnongs dgos pa zhig dang / spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gis gang gi re smon de nyid sgrub ma nus par ngo gnongs dgos par tshang 'gyur

ga /gleng gzhi/ 9—————nges/ da cha nga tshos chab spel rig gzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jug las gzhi'i tshogasachung ched du btsugs te sang de'i rig sazhung bsam blorang mi —tshe'i bshul lam la sogs khyen yongs dang rim mang star chags kyi thabs lam la brten te zhib 'jug byed dgos shing / satso bor zhib 'jug byed dbos pa ni/1 gtso bo gang de'i rig gzhung bsam blo dang / lo rgyus zhib 'jus thad kyi thabs lam gsar par dpyad zhib bya rgyu/ chab spel mcho0 gi mi tshul ring lusas kyi bsam blo dang / gdod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi bsam blo ni/nyid kyi gsung rtsom yod do cog gi nang khyab yod cing / sang de'i rig gzhung dpyad zhib kyi thabs lam gsar pa nge ni rang re phyi rabs rnams kyi blo sgo yangs por 'byed byed cig yin/ de das la rtog dpyod bya rgyur shugs snon lhag tu rgyag dgos pa yang / zhib 'jug tshogs chung gi zhib 'jug mi sna tshos rang so so'i rig gzhung dpyad zhib kyi lta tshul spyad de brtags shing dpyad par byas thog de'i khrod nas blo skyed thon dgos pa de yin/2 gang de'i rig gzhung dpyad zhib kyi mi tshe'i bshul lam la zhib 'jug bya rgyu/ chab spel mchog ni dgung lo drug cur bcar nye'i skabs 'dir gzhi nas lo rgyus rig par rtog 'jug gi mgo brtsams pa yin pas/ rig gzhung dpyad zhib la dngos su gzhol ba'i dus yun de tsam ring po ma yirno/ 'ong nyid rig gzhung dpyad zhib kyi sgor ma zhugs gong / bod rnying pa'i sa sanas srid gzhung nang go gnas bzhes myong ba dang (bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs / rtsom mkhan zhwa sgab pa dang ngo 'dris kyang yod/ chab spel mchog bi ris gzhung dpyad zhib kyi mi che'i bshul lam la zhib 'jug byed skabs/ khong nas lo rgyus zhib 'jug na 'go brtsams nga 'i dus tshod lo nar tshad bkag byar du med/ de yang ris gzhung dpyad zhib kyi byed sgor ma zhugs pa'i song rol nas/ rang

10 gagi chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/———— —— ——— nyid brgyud rin pa'i 'tsho sdod kyi myong ba'i steng nas rig gzhung dpyad zhib kyi mang gzhi tshugs zin pa yin/ der brten gang de'i rig gzhung dpyad zhib kyi mi che'i bshul lam la zhib 'jug bya rgyu de yang zhib 'jug tshogs chung si slad ma'i 'jug yul gyi phyogs shis yin cing / mi tshul zhib 'jus dang rig gzhung tshan rig khag las 'das pa'i rigs 'gre'i zhib 'jug byed thabs spyad phyin/‘ chab spel rig gzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jug gi las gzhi 'di'i nang / khong gi rigs lam dpyad zhib kyi mi tshe'i bshul lam la zhib 'jug bya rgyu 'di nyid grub cha gal chen zhig tu kha tshon bcad chog pa yang / dus rabs gsar pa 'di'i nang / spyi tshogs tshan rig dang / tha na rang byung tshan rig tshud pa 'i phyogs gang sar/ rgyags bsdus kyi zhib 'jug byed thabs dang // rig gzhung tshan khag las 'das pa'i rigs 'gre'i zhib 'jug byed thabs dag kun gyis rgya cher nyer spyod zin pas yin/ spyi tshogs tshan rig zhib 'jug byed sgo'i chud du'ang lo rgyus rig pa dang gsar 'gyur rig pa la sogs pa'i zhib 'jug byed thabs phan tshun dpe 'gre dpe ltos chog cing / dpe 'gre go bsdur de lta bu brgyud tshan khag las 'das pa'i rigs 'gre'i zhib 'jug kyang byed dbos/3 sang des brtag zhib gnang myong ba'i rig pa 'i gnas kyi gro/ da du da dung zab mor 'jug dgos shing don snying che tsam ldan pa dag la mtha' dpyod gros bsdur bya rgyu/ chab spel mchog nas bod kyi lo rgyus kyi byung rim thad zhib 'jus mdzad zin pa rnams ltos bcas kyi thog nas skas rim gsar pa zhig tu slebs yod kyang / bgres po gang des/ rang gis gtso 'gan rtsom sgrig mdzad pa'i deb ther la (bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim g.yu yi phreng ba 〉zhis ming 'dogs mdzad pa de rang gi thog nas/ da dung 'byung gzhi khungs 'tshol dang mtha' dpyod mjug 'phro mang ba der phyi rabs rnams kyis gom sang mdun spos

ra —/glengagazhi/ 11ngang rjes bstud bya rgyur lus yod pa shugs kyis bstan yod/ gzhan yang chab spel mchog si rig gzhung bsam blor zhib 'jus byed skabs/ khong bi bsam blo'i 'gyur ldo ga dang / lta ba grub tshul bcas par dpyad pa phra zhib byed dgos pa yin/ dper na chab spel mchog gi brtsams chos de dag las mi tshul ring lusas dang sadod ma'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi 'od snang lham mer 'tsher bar som nyi byed mi dgos kyang / de ni lo rgyus dngos satso ring lugs dang rtsod sgrub dngos gtso ring lusas kyi lta ba'i yang rtser son pa ga la yin/ de'i thad khong gi brtsams chos rnams kyi tshur snang mtshon don gyi thos nas brdor sha gcod rgyu la sa sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen sa se mo zhig la brten te la tshon sacod mi rung /chab spel mchos i gzims tshul la la ra 'i ba phra'i khungs satugs nyams rtos bgyid skabs/ gong bi ris sazhung dpyad zhib kyi mi tshe'i bshul la ma dang zung du thel dgos shing / lo rgyus rig pa dang brtag thabs smra ba'i thad nas gom gang ma dun spos slos khyon yo ngas dang ma lag rim can gyi sgo nas jib 'jus byed dgos nga yang / dperan chab spel mchog bi lta ba 'asa' shas brgyud dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi bsam blos bod rigs shes yon can rnam sa la shusas rkyen ji 'dra thebs min dang / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob tshun/ mi'i rigs kyi sngo na thon bsam/ blo ste dper na mar le ring lugs dang ma'o tse tung dgongs pas bong rilas shes ldan pa ra dge mtshan phan 'bras ji byung skor la 'ib dbya da byed dgos pa sogs lta bu yin/chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs mchog gi rigs lam dpyad 'bras rnam sa dang gang de'i mkhyen rab nyams 'gyur gzengs su bstod pa dang / rig gzhung dpyad zhib kyi mdzub khrid kha phyogs nyid ya nga dag rgyun bsring mtha' 'khyongs thog snga bsnad mjus skyong dang / shul 'dzin rjes spros/ sngar bas dor cha gsal ston gyis khu phral ring lugs la ngo rtsol / mes rgyal gong bu gcis

12 ga /chab spel tshe ba na sun tshogs kyi rtso rig ba mas cho zugs bsgrigs/wa ——wa ——————gyur dang mi rigs mthun sgril la srung skyob/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs sgrun dang deng rabs can 'dzugs kun byed pa'i 'o rgyus 'phel rim rlabs po che'i khrod/ mi rigs kyi phul byung shul rgyun rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum ngang / mi tshul spyi tshogs tshan rig dang lhag don krung go'i bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi bya gzhag de nyid dar rgyas gong spel gtong phyir rang cag rnams nas legs skyes gsar du 'bul thub pa bcas kyi don du/ rang skyong ljongs tang mud kyi thugs 'khur mdzub khrid dang zhib 'jug tshogs chung gi blo 'don u yon dang de bzhin 'brel yod mkhas dbang rnam pa'i shugs che'i rgyab skyor 'og tshogs chung khongs mi rnams kyis zla shas ring 'bad brtson lhod med brgyud/ ‘ chab spel rig gzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jug dpe tshogs 'di nyid da lam zhib 'jug las gzhi'i gzhi rtsa'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i grub 'bras su bde blag ngang legs 'grub byung nas bgres po nyid kyis rang gi brtsams chos rnams phyogs bsgrigs kyi tshul du 'don rgyu'i thugs smon yongs su smin par byas pa dang /ci dus mtshams rjes ma'i zhib 'jug gi bya gzhag khrod du nga tshos mu mthud 'bad brtson ngang chab spel rig gzhung bsam blo'i zhib 'jug gi las ka de nyid sngar bas gting tshugs pa dang / sngar bas cha tshang ba'i sgo nas spel thub pa bya rgyu dang bcas/ bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang du 2007lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 25nyin/ (tshe ring dpa la 'byor gyis bod yig tu phab bsgyur byas/)

dkar chagasnyan rtsom/bsil dus kyi bod ljongs/ (3)dpyid dus kyi bod ljongs/ (5)rang rigs gzhon nur gdams pa 'i ka phreng / (10)lha sa skyid glu/ (12)nged 'bros pa'i sems la gsal po yo da/ (/5)bsngags brjod dga' ba'i rol mo (2/)rgyal kha nas rgyal la'i phyogs su bskyod pa/ (24)'tsho ba gsar par phul ba'i bstod dbyangs/ (28)shis brjod bkra shes rtags brgyad/ (33)shis brjod/ (35)ma'o kru'u zhi rjes su dran pa/ (38)rab dga'i mchod sprin/ ( 40)tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho sku 'khrungs nas lo sum brgya 'khor bar dran gso zhus ba/ (4/ /tang gi bu phrul bzang ngo lu'u ya'o tseng / rtag tu bod dmangs snying dbus gson por bzhu/gas/ (44)nya gad mo shor ba/ ( pa2)(zla zer 〉 dus deb dang ngo bklags pa'i tshor snang / (77)
