— snyed wa — — rna1bsil dus kyi bod ljongs/ka shi'i ras kyi mdzes pa rab 'phrog dgun dus bod kyi yul ljongs ni/ /kha ba'i grelas mas yongs su bklubs pa'i ke la sha ris kun nas bskor/ /tsā bur rdul gyis dbyig 'dzin sgeg mo'i bzhin gyi ra ri ma lus bkrus / /nga cag mes rgyal mtha' mtshams 'di ni rab dkar ba so'i gzhong pa 'dra /ca gas rab bskyangs gsar du btsugs pa'i 'bras ldan shing dang skyed mos tshal /cha shas yul gyi gdod ma'i nags dang 'dzam gling yang rtser sngar med kyi/ /ja shing la solas rkang 'thung kun kyang srin bal las byas 'khri shing la / /nya rgyas zla ba'i 'od kyis rgyad ba'in 'dren byed zim bus blta la 'bod / /ta ma las g.yogs chu thel can bzhin dgun brgal skyes dngos sna tshogs kyang sne/tha ram grang ba'i reg bya 'gos ched gangs dkar phying pa'i mal cha gyon / /da dung dwangs bsil yan lag brgyad ldan chu dang chu phran thams cad kyang / /na chung saser mig can dang lhan cig 'khyags rom g.yang ṭi'i lang par nyal / pa tra'i ris ltar mdzes shing bkra ba'i grong dang grong gseb gsar skrun rnam sa / pha lam ltar 'tsher gangs kyi brod na ma nyisas gangs lta me to0 bzhin / /ba sam can si khang bzang star phreng dwangs shel sgo dang sgol khung can/ /sdoji tsho 'jigs ma lus nam mkha'i nor bu la phyogs ma dzes pa'i nyi ma me tos bzhin/ /tsa ko ra ltar grang ngar zil gnon zhum med dpa' bo'i mi dmangs rngams tsha grang 'gyur ldog che ba'i sanam sashis gang la'ang mi 'jigs seng 'e ltar/ /dza drag brtan snying zhing 'bros las rigs khas gi 'dzugs spun bya sa'ag nang /

4 ༄tsho chab del tshe brtan phun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyosas bsgrigs/——— ——— ——— — —— — — — — ——— wa ————wa ler ngeng bzhi snying la bcangs ba'in rgyang skyod gsar pa ra gom chen spo/ /zhwa gos pags pa'i gra lo rab rgyas dga' spro'i glu sgras bar snang 'gengs/ /za btung bcud ldan sha mar ja chang ci dgar rol ba'i 'tsho ba skrun/ / 'a 'ur 'drud 'then 'alor lo sna tshogs las grwa'i phyogs mtshams kun tu rgyu/ /ya mtshan rdzas me'i 'bar gas shulas kyis ra nga byung ri brag mgo bo dud / /ra ltar 'gying ba'i ri khug rnams su gting dpa ga dka' ba'i chu mdzod bskrun /'a dang lung nga sa 'khod snyoms nas pha mtha' yas pa'i zhing thang bcos/ /shwa 'od than zhod rang byung sanod 'che'i g.yul las rnam pa ra rgyal byas nas/ /sa rgod das kyang zang rabs ba'i'i ched 'bru risas sna lnga 'bul du 'jugaha las mtha' med rtswa thang khyon du'ang le dbar stong ldan rtswa ra bskor/ /ha lam ri klung gang sar khyab pa 'i rgyusas rigs dkar nag khyu dang khyu / /a ho nam mkha'i mi lhung phreng ba sa gzhi'i ngos su 'phos ltar mdzes kyi /a la la tshes 'dzam gling yang rtser deng rabs can gyi bod gsar 'dzugs/ / dus bzhi'i tha mar grags pa'i dgun dus kyang / 'di lta'i yid 'ong lta na sdug pa'i yul/ / me tog dus dang char ldan 'bras bu'i dus/ /mdzes sdug rmad byung su yis brjod pa ra nus/ /

— —— — 5dpyid dus kyi bod ljongs/long long chu gter bzhi yi rba rlabs kyis/ /zab zab rgya mtsho'i ngosas su drangs dosas nas/ /yo ra yo ra'adzam gling sa 'dzin phal mo che mtho mtho sa la'i ljongs 'dir bros pa bzhin/ /rab mtho'i rtser 'dzegs nus pa'i dogs med kyang / /rab ngar dgun gyi grang reg nas gtses pas/ /rab dkar kha ba'i bos kyis mgo bstums te / /rab thibs gnyid du yur ba'i chu skyob rnam sa /gsal gsal dpyid dus lha yi rdzing ring mar /gsal/ las la khrus su zhusas pa'i nyin byed kyi /gsal sas la 'od stong 'gyed pa sa rab sad nge gas la bas la la shi'i ras gos phud nas blta / nyi 'od thigs pa rab bsasas sbrang chang la / /bag med spyad pas rab myos gangs kyi ri/ /tsha gdungs rngul chu rab zasas dal 'gro ma/ /shang shong brgyud nas rab 'bab chu klung rgyas/ dwangs bsil dag byed lhung lhung sgros pa'i rgyun/ /nor 'dzin sgeg mo sa sim sim btung pa na / /bgrang yas skye dngos chung chung son rtswa kun /

6 ga chab spel tshe brtan phun rdogs kyi marigab pasachos gas baji sa/lus stobs brtas ming 'bur 'bur myu gu 'bus/ /long 'thung rtsa bar drod gsher tsha thing thing / tshor bas gdod ma'i nasas tshal snum thing thing sgyu skyed tshal yal ga'i snas phran dmar thing thing /nyin ba'in gsar skyes lo 'dab ljang thing thing / /de mthong 'bras ldan 'khri shing ngar langs nas/ /ka ra ku shu kham shing li la sogs/ rang na khyad chos ngoms shing lo ma yi /sngon du me tog tshes shing dregs pas 'gyings/ /yid 'ong khu byug myos pa'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /ri klung kun tu dpyid kyi dpal yon sgrog /yid 'ong me tog bzhad pa'i dri zhim gyis/ /ri klung kun tu sna tshogs bsung mngar khyab/ /dgun dus mtsho dang mtshe'u chu rdzing 'bum/ /'bum phrag 'khyasas rom yol bas g.yogs dang mtshungs/ /mtshungs med tsha zer spu gris dbral nas slar/ /slar yang margad zhun ma'i lang tsho ngoms mdzes mdzes ngur pa chu skyar ngang pa sogs/ /snyan snyan mgrin pa'i dzra rnga rdung bzhin du/ /lteb ldeb gshos skyang spu sdug sprug dang bcas/ /lam lam mtshor 'jus gar gyis kun dga' skyed/ /'khyags nas mon yul 'grims pa'i 'ol ba yang / yang bskyar bod ljongs dpyid dpal blta ba'i phyir/ /

rdza /dpyid dus kyi bod sngongs/ 7ge wa — — —phyir log sngar 'dris yul dang yul can kun/ / kun tu 'tshol zhing bde bar bzhugs sam smra /ngar ngar dgun gyi bser bus yid 'byung nas/ /zab zab phug 'dzul 'phyi ba sgom chen yang / (chil chil pho drod 'bar bas ting 'dzin sad / /thag jig ku co 'don bzhin spang steng rgyu/ /dbu ba'i 'dzum dkar bzhad pa nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /rgyun chad med par 'bab pa'i yan lag kun/ /kun tu 'brel ba'i ma yur las brgyud de / /de mar yur phran brgya phrag nang du 'gro/ /mtha' yas zhing thang cha snyoms sa sazhi'i steng / /'phred gzhung mda' ltar 'drong ba'i chu yur gyis/ gru ba'i gru bzhir bsgos pa 'i 'ing mig rnams/ skoji ltar mis mangs ras sa'i bting pa bzhin/ /bar bar stobs ldan lcags kyi glang mchos gis/ /ldir ldir sgra sgros bus pa'i 'khor lo bskor/ /lhog lhos gshin pa'i zhing sa bla 'og brje/ / —thul thul du bas rlung phyogs yi ge 'bri/ /la ga rtsal byang chub na gzhon kha lo bas/ /sprin gsar thabs su btags 'dra'i snam gos rgyan / /mtshar mtshar 'ja' ris bkra ba'i gong rgyan gyis/ rgya se'i 'a mor po dos byed pa ba'in/ /gzhan na dgun btab lo tos ljang bzhon g.yo/ (

8 ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyosas bsgrigs/— ——— ———— ————— — —— — —————g.yo ldan spu ma ljang gu'i sa gdan bzhin/ /bzhin mdzes zhing pa 'i bu mos glu len bzhin/ / bzhin 'dzum dga' bas dpyid chu ngoms par 'dren/ /dkar dkar nas dang nag nag sran ril dang / /ser ser gro dang smug smu ga pad kha sogs/ /rang rang zhing sar gang sang 'phrod pa yi/ /de de'i son bzang rem rem 'debs pas brel/ /dpyid 'debs bya bas gang sar 'ur ding ring / /skye rgu ma lus spro bas 'dzum dmul dmul/ / lo legs len pa'i sems zugs tsha chil chil /can bzhi'i ched du kun kyang dga' lhang ltang / /mes rgyal ljang ljang g.yu yi skyed tshal du/ /'gyur slad mang mang pho mo thon gcon kun/ /'tshang kha shig shis skye shing 'dzugs pa'i dus/ dbyis 'dzin yom yom dga' bas g.yo'am snyam/ /pha mtha' mi mngon che che rtswa thang steng / /sprin dkar lhung lta'i mang mang lug khyus khengs/ /ma res bu 'khrid brel brel skye bsu yis/ /'brog pa'i lus po nga' yang sems nyid skyid/ / phyi yul dpyid dpal lang tsho dar ba'i nang / /nang gnas spun zla mi rigs mthun sgril zab/ /zab mo'i blo kha deng rabs can bzhir phyogs/ / phyogs yo ngas mdun bskyod rnam pa mchog tu bzang /

— — ga —/dpyidadusakyisod ngas/ — 9rlabs chen tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / / rirlabs chen lhus gtong dpa la 'byor srid jus kyis / rlabs chen bod ljongs mi dmangs khri phras brgya'i/ /rlabs chen rgyal gces lhag bsam mkha' la 'phyur/ /mdzes mdzes dpyid kyi dbe mtshan me tog 'bum/ /snya na snyan zung ldan sgra rgyan srad bu la/ /mdzes mdzes phreng bar bstar ba'i nyams 'gyur dbyangs / /snyan snyan sgrog nus shes yon bdag la med / /'on kyang bod ljongs gsar par dasa' ches pas /gang dran ched du brjod pa 'i grong tshig 'dir/ mkhas spyan btsa' ba'i rin thang mi ldan yang / /blo gsar gzhon nu dgyes pa'i skyes su bris /

sod ——— —————— —— ——wa ———wa ————wa rkewa rang rigs gzhon nur gdams pa'i ka phreng /ka nas a bar yi ge sum cu'i nang / /kha skad ma lus tshud pa'i bod yig 'di/ /ga nas bltas kyang brda sprod ri mo'i khrod/ /nga cag ngo gnong mi dgos pa zhig mchis/ji /ca co'i rang rang yul skad 'dra min sgru/ /cha shas rnam grangs shin tu mang mod kyang / /ja khu bsdus bzhin brda dag gzhung bsten na/ / nya sang zla bas mun ltar gcig gyur gsal/ ta re to re'i yul skad zur chas rnams/ /tha thor yi ge'i lam du spel drags na/ /da bzod phan tshun so brda mi 'phrod la/ /na mar 'then rtsod klan ka zam mi chad/ /pa ṭa'i ris ltar yi0 ngo chod na yang / /pha rol brjod bya'i snying po ma rtogs na/ /ba mchog 'o ma'i 'bab rgyun chad pa bzhin/ /ma lag rig gzhung nyams nas la thor 'gyur/ /tsa ri'i rong ltar zab pa 'i yis gzhung nang / /tsha grang 'byed bzhin phrad dang rnam dbye sogs/ /dza dzor min par so so'i byed nus rnams/ /

— —— ga /rang rigs ga'on /ra gdams pa'i la/ phreng 11wa ler mtshan nyid ji bzhin rtogs pa gnad / / zhwa bzhin sa na gyis bkur re'i dge rgan 'gas/ /za zir nang gses 'byed rgyur mkhas rloms byed /'a khag de 'dra'i slo ba khrid tshar dus med /ya yol slob ma'i dus tshod chud zos 'gro rwa ltar rengs pa'i phyogs re'i 'dod tshul la/ /la 'ur zhen nas don gyi mthil mi mthong /tha med rus par rtsod pa'i mkhas nyam sa kyang / /sa 'dir rang sa'an mgo bo basmo ra ba'i rgyu/ /ha las bzhed tshul phra zhib ma shes rung / /ha la ma don gyi khyad par 'byed nus shing / /a li'i dbyangs dang sasal byed sgra sbyor rnams/ /a mas bur ba'i na don dang sbyar nas slobs 'di ni mi rigs rig pa 'i ming tshis gzhi/ /phul byung gzhung lusas sgyu 'phrul kun bsdu nus / /legs shes nge dges segs sel bde legs ster / blo gros mchos 'thob 'dod don yo ngas rdzogs rtogs/ /

12——lha sa skyid glu/ hril hril sa yi bo la'i gtsug sator la / dkar dkar gangs ri'i mu tig do thal 'chang / /lhung lhung dal 'bab bzhi yi ska ralas can/ /mtho mtho bod ljongs lte ba lha sa skyid/ /ring ring stong phrag bgrang bya'i lo rgyus nang / /yang yang grags pa'i gna' rabs grong khyer 'di'i/ /snyan snyan ming si yi ge 'dzam gling ṣka /phyogs phyosas kun tu khyab pa'i lha sa skyid/ ༈ brjid brjid khor yus sa 'dzin phreng bas bskor/ dal dal srid pa'i chu klung gzholas nas 'bab/ /3 nga ljang skyed mos tshal gyis bar med dkrisas/ /mang mang grong gis yongs gtams lha sa skyid / /long long ci dasar 'phyo ba'i skyid chu yang / / nan nan dmangs kyi bka' lung thod du bcings/ /dkar dkar chu shel rags kyi ba gam nang / /'dzum 'dzum dal bus rgyu ba'i lha sa skyid/ / mer mer 'bab pa'i skyid chu'i bar snang du/ yer yer 'phur ba lta bu'i lcags zam 'gyings/ /

ga /lha sa skyid glu/ 1 3gsal gsal glos bzhu'i skar rgyas phra tshom gyi/ ri'atsher 'tsher 'od snang 'phro ba'i lha sa skyid/ /drang drang tshangs pa'i thig gi rjes 'gro ba'i/ /snyoms snyo ma sa phred gzhung snum nag sazhung lam gyis/ /lam lam mig mangs ras bzhi'i sho ris ltar/ ༈gling gling phye ba'i mdzes ljongs lha sa skyid/ /sanag gnag mthing zhun byusas 'dra'i snum lam gyi/ /phyogs phyogs sna tshogs ljon pa'i star phreng kun/ /skum zlum 0dugs ltar 'khyil ba'i yal 'dab kyi /'jam 'jam grib bsil snum pa'i lha sa skyid/ /hreng hreng spos ltar 'khyog bral ka ring ngos/ /dkar dkar nyi 'od skyengs byed glog sgron gyis/ mun mun mtshan yang bdugs kyi snang ba ltar/ /gsal sasal nyi ma'i grong khyer lha sa skyid / /snum snum zang 'thung bye ba'i skyed tshal krod/ dalar dkar byug ris bkra ba'i khang phreng dag / ljang ljang mar gad zhun ma'i thang yangs su/ /sta ra sta ra mu tig bsod 'dra'i lta sa skyid /mtho mtho grong mi'i bsti gnas thos khang rnams/ /mdzes mdzes gcig las gcig bkra phan tshun 'gran/ /cha cha dwangs thel khra gling brgya stong nang / gcis sacig du mar 'khrul ba'i lha sa skyid / /

14 lta /chab spel tshe ba na phun tshog kyi rtsom ri brtsams chos rgya sa bsgribs/'khor 'khor bar skor tshong khang brgya phrag tu/ /gang gang mkho ba'i sna tshogs tshong zong gis/ /byur byur rab lengs tshong rwa dar zhing rgyas/ /mang mang skye rgya'i re smong lta sa skyid/ /bar bar sos pa'i zas dang btung ba yi/ /thul thul dri zhim bro ba'i bza' khang mang kyi /gtsang gtsang yi ga 'gro ba'i yol go'i nang / /zhim zhim bza' btung 'dzoms pa'i lha sa skyid / ring ring byang thang a khu 'brog pa tsho'i/ /ser ser ser sha lta bu'i maragasar dang / /dmar dmar sol pa'i tshag sha lus sha song/sa/ /'dam 'dam bsgrus rgyu yod pa'i lta sa skyid/ /khra khra tshon ris bkra ba'i kha gdan dang / /'jam 'jam snam bu spang gdan btsugs phrug dang / (dkar dkar yal sogs lho byang zhing 'brog gi/ /zhor zhor thon rdzas 'bel ba'i lha sa skyid/ / rirang rang yul goms gshes lusas dang mthun pa'i/ /mdzes mdzes zhe lham sna mang rgyan bos dang / /'grig 'grig cha sam cog tse 'bol gdan sogs/ /gang gang mkho rgu kun yod lha sa skyid/ / phyogs phyogs stod smad lho byang gang sa nas/ /dung dung chos la dad pa 'i skye bo'i tshogs/ /

gagi / sa skyid spru/ /5wa —brjid brjid satsug las khang dang se 'bras sogs/ ༈rang rang mos pas mjal 'dzoms lha sa skyid / mang mang las la brtson pa 'i bod dmangs tshos /'bad 'bad ring nas bkun pa'i lo rgyus kyi /mtshar mtshar rig dngos snyan grags can de dag /'tsher 'tsher sngar bas 'od 'phro lha sa skyid/ /che ches chung gnon khral 'ul bshu gzhig sogs/ /'jigs 'jigs brnyas gtser ming tsam mi grags par /bde bde bas phebs rang rang 'bad pa'i 'bras/ /tshang tshang rang gis spyod pa'i lha sa skyid / /chung chung me tog 'bus 'dra'i byis pa rnams/ /skyid skyid slob grwa'i tshal na ci dasar rol/ /zab zab shes bya'i sanas mang rim gyis sbyong / /myur myur mkhas par 'gyur ba'i lha sa skyid/ /ring ring pha mtha' mi mngon 0zhung lam steng / /mgyo0sa mgyogs rlangs 'khor che 'bring chung gsum rgyu /—rgyang rgyang sngar gyi nyin lam chu tshod rer/ /shar shar 'gro skyod bde ba'i lha sa skyid/ / la la 'byung 'khrugs nang kyis bro tsha yang 'bul 'bul 'gro gron skar li tsam med pa ra/ /rang rang krung shis bod lusas gso rig sogs gang gang 'dod bzhin bsten pa'i lha sa skyid/ /

16 ga chab spel tshe brtan gun tshosas kyi rtsom ris brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/— —skyid skyid dbyar gyi dpal mos mgron 'bod tshe /ljang ljang de'u gsing g.yu yi do ra'i ngos/ / mtshar mtshar sna tshosas me rtog 'dab stong bzhad/ /snyan snyan sung ba'i glu len lta sa skyid/ /snum snum ljon pa'i grib bsil nyams dga' bar/ /la la tsam min grong mi rgan gzhon2spyan/ /zhim zhim zas dang ja chang 'dod yon la/ /rang rang ci dgar spyod pa'i lha sa skyid/ /mdzes mdzes gar dang a ce lha mo dang / /snyan snyan glu dbyangs rol mo'i mtshan tshogs sam ci /mtshar mtshar glog brnyasagazugs mthong rlung 'phrin sogs/ /mang mang ltad mos dus 'da' lha sa skyid/ / pa pha a ma nas 'khogs mang po yang / /gzhon gzhon bu dang bu mos skyor 'khrid kyis/ /rang rang gang 'dod sgyu rtsal dga' ston la/ /rem rem blta zhing dbod pa 'i lha sa skyid/ /che che grong khyer mtha' bzhi ma lus par/ /gshin gshin sa rgyu legs pa'i zhing thang nang / /nyil nyil snye ma'i rlabs phreng g.yo ldan pas/ /mang mang 'bru sna 'dzoms pa'i lha sa skyid/ /mtho mtho ri bos bskor ba'i rgyab mdun rnams/ /dkar dkar lug dang 'bri g.yas ba khyus khengs/ sgyu

ga /lha sa skyid thu/ /7——— — — — wa sdelo lo dus ba'ir 'o lo'i rgyun mi chag / ri'i/ma 'im dkar chu 'bel ba'i lha sa skyid/ /ring ring stong phrag lo rim brgyud pa yi/ /sang gang mi rigs lag shes bzo las kun/ /sim sim char rjes smyug ma'i myu gu bzhin/ /'dzoms 'dzoms slar yang dar ba'i lha sa skyid/ /legs lebs gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og /mgyogs mgyogs bod ljongs yar rgyas bya ltar 'phur/ /phyogs phyogs gang sar 'gyur ldog rnam grangs kun/ /re re brjod las 'das nga 'i lha sa skyid/ /ring ring ma yin 'o ngo sum cu'i nang / /mtho mtho rang ljongs tha gru'i 'gyur ldog 'dir/ /yang yang bsam gyin tang i srid jus la/ /dung dung dmangs kun mos pa 'i lha sa skyid/ /mang mang dar rgyas 'di ltar byung na yang / /de de tsam gyis mi dmangs blo mi khengs/ / rem rem mu mthud thun mong 'bad brtson gyis/ /yu da yud rnam pa gong 'phel lha sa skyid /byams byams spun zla mi rigs mthun sgril ngang / /'dzom sa 'dzoms dngos po'i 'byor pas phyug pa dang /gsal sasal shes rig dang la yon 'bar ba yi/ sgyulam lam bod gsar skrun pa 'i lha sa skyid/ /

18 sto chab spel tshe brtan sun bas kyi rtsom ris brtsams chos phyogs bsgribs ——— —mkhas mkhas grags ldan bka' drung shel gling pas/ /gces gces rang gi pa yul 'di spangs te / /skyo skyo gzhan yul 'grim dus brtsams pa yi/ /lhang lhang 6lha sa dran gru ltar ma yin/ /dar dar gra rgyas phan sam tshogs pa yi/ /ga ga glu skyid lha sa gsar pa 'i dpal yon 'bum/ /:sdo rje( 11 lhan 1de /skye the'u /spyo :red sa da sa ma nga nga ba da ngas da pa / /dga' dga' lha sa skyid pa'i glu chi'adi brtsams/ /

—— — —— 19ringed 'brog pa'i sems la gsal po yod/lo sum cu'i sngon gyi dus de ring / /yul skyid po gangs can bod ljongs 'thar /dpal dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur rlabs chen des/ /dam ngas yongs la 'tsho ba gsar pa bskyal/ /sdug mun pa'i yol ba rgyab tu g.yulas/ /skyid dga' ba'i nyi ma mdun nas shar/ /byang rtswa thang nor bu'i bang mdzod de /nged 'brog pa'i lag tu rang bdag thob/ /sngon btsan po rnams kyis bdag bzung ba'i /phyugs g.yag lug 'brog pa dmangs la dbang / /ri rtswa chu'i bdag bed yod tshad kun/ /dmangs bgros nas spyi yi phan bder spyod/ /mi'i bsam blor bcings 'grol thob pa na/ / thon skyed kyi sems shugs me ltar 'bar/ /rang rtsol 'bras rang la bdag pa nges/ /'brog dmangs kun dbul bcos phyug 'gyur byung / /bos dalar po phyugs rigs sman pa tshos/ /sbog nad yams rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad/ /phyugs rgyud bzang tshan rig sbyor sprad kyis/ /

20 ga /chab spel tshe brtan gun tsogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos zugs bsgrigs/—— ———— — —wa — bhe —— wa ——wa wasgo phyugs kyi spus tshad lo rer 'gyur/ /ri g.yas phyogs nor gyis gang ba ni/ / spang g.yu rir na bun 'khrigs pa 'dra/ /g.yon spang gshongs g.yang dkar lug khyus khengs/ /g.yu ljongs la kha bas g.yogs pa 'dra/ /zho 'o ma'i rdzing bu g.yas su 'khyil / /mar rgyur ba'i phung po g.yon du spungs/ /'brog dbul gyi 'tsho ba yar zla bzhin/ /'phel rgyas 'di spyi tshogs gsar pa'i drin/ /sbra rnying ral re lug ra bar g.yogs/ sbra gsar dang khang gsar phan tshun 'gran/ /rlangs 'khor gyi glog sgron khyim kun gsal/ / sgra 'jug gi 'khor los glu dbyangs khyab/ /sngar sdug bsngal gang las byung ba dang / /deng bde skyid su yis gnang ba shes/ /slad lam gsir gang du bskyod dgos pa/ /nged 'brog pa'i sems la gsal po yod/ /

— — —/spru/ri—bsngags brjod dga' ba'i rol mo/rlabs chen mes rgyal dbang phyogs lhun po yi rtse nas/ / —sri ) bye 'o ze ze'ispruze'ipa 60phyotathapa tshod zud tshosno 2she zin /1 theg thag 'gyu/ /gangs ljongs mi lo stong phras rgyad mu na gyi 'khrugs rom/ /cis car bcil nas phan bde'i 'od snang gis khyab byung / /mi rigs srid jus mtho ris skyed tshal las 'khrungs pa'i/ /rang skyong mi dmangs srid dbang dang ga bsam gyi smon bzang / /'dod rgya'i dpal yon lo 'dab 'bum phras gis phyug cing / shes rig nor ba'i 'bas ba g.yur du rang za'o/ /ra rī ra bcu phrag gnyis ldan bgrang bya'i 'khor lo yi ring la/ /sanam sa bla 'og 'gyur lta'i rang ljongs kyi grub 'bras/ / mngon sum dbang po lnga yi spyod yu la du gyur pa/ /mtha' das brjod pa ra chu lha'i lce brgya yang ngal lo/ /lhag don krung u gros tshogs gsum pa yi rjes su/ /rab yangs mes rgyal lte ba pe cing i phyogs nas/ /drus ldan glu las snyan pa'i krung dbyang i mdzub ston/ /0cig la sa sacig bzang le khri'i sa mtho 'dir khyab byung / /

22 sku /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyo sa bsgrigs/wa — — —wa wa rigs khag skye rgu'i sang bsam yid bzhin gyi re 'dun/ /ma lus yongs su skong ba'i bsam 'phel gyi nor bu/ /lhug gtong phyug 'gyur srid jus bsil zer gyi bdud rtsis/ /dbul po'i tsha gdung sel ba'i skal pa 'di bzang byung / /ma skul zhing 'brog thon skyed mtho rlabs su 'phyur zhing / / ma bcos kun kyang sna mang khe gnyer la gzhol ba/ /ma bos phyogs mtshams yongs nas tshong 'khos la 'jug sogs/ ma brjes bod ljongs rnam pa gsar rkyang du gyur song ༈ sngon med dmangs phyug yangs pa'i 0zhung lam gyi thog tu/ /zhing 'brog sger bdag rlangs 'khor brgya phrag gi dung sgra/ /lhang lhang sgrog pas dmangs sems dbang med du 'gul bzhin/ /las brtson phyug 'gyur 'gran pa'i rba rlabs this 'phyur byung / /rgyal nang spun zla'i mi rigs mnyam las dang mnyam sgrub/ /dpal 'byor lag rtsal tshong zog brje len gyi lam chen/ /lhug por bshangs pa sa mes rgyal lho nub kyi rgyal mtshams/ /gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa 'i rnam pa yis khengs song / /lo stong gter du sbas 'dra'i 'dzam gling gi yang rtses/ /rang gi khyad 'phags phul byung stobs shusas rnams bton te / /phyi phyogs sgo brgya phye nas gling chen lnga'i mgron por /ngo mtshar spro 'cham ltad mo'i le'u zhig phye'o/ /

༄gi /ba gas brjod dga' ba'i rol mo/ 23sgyur bcos srid jus gser gyi gru gzings la brten nas/ /las brtson phyug 'gyur mthun pa'i rlung g.yor dang 'grogs na/ /'byor phyug shes ldan bod gsar rin chen gyi gling du /bde blag bgrod pa'i re 'dod lag 'thil du son no/ /bod ljongs mdun skyod chen po'i gom stabs kyi khrod du/ /dmangs sems rab dga' rang skyong dus chen gyi skabs 'dir/ lhas bsam mtshon pa'i kha btags bla mtho ru btegs nas/ /rlabs chen gung khran tang la thugs rje che zhu'o/ /

24la lta— — ——— rgyal kha nas rgyal kha'i phyogs su bskyod pa/bgrang yas skye rgu'i phan dang bde ba'i rtsa las gcig gyur sdong po rab tu brtan/ sna mang mi rigs yal ga lnga phrag bcu dang nyag ma lnga ldan dpal gyis brjid/ /srid dpal lo 'bras g.yur du za zhing bzhi bcu bgrang bya'i lang tsho dar dralas pa/ /krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab yongs 'du'i 'khri shing rnam par rgyal gyur cig /nor dang skye bos yongs su gang ba'i mes rgyal zla ba'i ma ma 'dis/ /gna' bo'i rig gnas pad dkar tshal gyis mi yi rigs la mchod yon 'gyed/ /'on tang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs mi sru na lag ldan rdog pa yis/ /yun ring brdzis pas phun tshogs dpal yon rnyogs shing nyam nga'i gnas su byas/ /lus bong de'u'i ri dang mnyam yang rgud pa'i gcong nad kyis/ /ring du gtses pa'i stobs zungs nyams na gnyis 'thung dbang por yang / /ma rabs cice spyang wa skyes tshogs dang tha na khā tas kyang / /ci dgar brnyas shing 'tshe bar byed pa 'jig rten dngos po'i gshis/ /nub phyogs ma rtsa'i ring lugs dpa la 'byor nyams nyen las/ /thon pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs bdag med khyi smyon ltar/ /'dzam gling sa phyogs kun tu bag med rgyu ba'i dus/ /rang rgyal dum bur babos nas lhag med za la brngams/ /rgyal gces ma la ya yi bsung rgyun gyi/ /dri bzang snying la chags pa'i dpa' bo tshos/ /zungs khrag mes rgyal sa gzhir sator na yang / re ba'i 'bras bu nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /ris med krung hwa mi risas kun/ /chasas sam 'jis gi 'gas rtsar thus /'jigs chen 'di las sus skyob ces/ /re thag chad pa'i 'o dod 'bod/ /de tshe zla ba bcu pa 'i gsar brje'i me skyogs dpyid kyi 'brug sgra

—————— —— rna /rgyalakhanas rgyal kha'i cas su ba.a pa/ ri 25'dzam gling du/ /dar dir bsgrags des mar le ring lusas snyan grags krung go'i sa gzhi chen por bskyal/ /dmangs kyi mgon skyabs gsar brje'i gtso 'dzin mdongs mtha'i dbang rgyus dag gi yid dbang 'phrog /rlabs chen gsar brje'i lam bu rnyed pas rab spro'i sgro gur phub ste sar gyis brel/ /mar le ring lugs rtsa ba'i ris pa lhad med gser gyi srad bu sang / /krung go'i dngos don bzhun thabs nang du btso sbyang lan brgyar byas pa'i ga'ir/ /rnam bkra'i khyad chos mtshon mdangs bzang pos bya 'brug ris ldan thags su btags/ /yang das lag len chu gos kyis bklubs ma'o tse tung dbongs pa'i rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ /spung go gung khran tang zhes rnam par rgyal ba'i ded dpon gyis/ /bzo tshing gtsor gyur rigs khag mi dmangs yan lag ba'i ldan dpung / /khrid nas pas sol ri bo che gsum thal ba'i rdul du brlabs/ rgyal yongs bcings pa las bkrol rang dbang bde skyid nyi ma shar/ /yu na ring gnyid du yur ba'i shar phyogs sa srung bu/ /rang btsan lang tsho 'bar bas glo bur yar langs te/ /spyi mthun rgyalakhab thal dkar mche ba drug ldan du/ /gyur pa'i snyan grags sa gzhi ril mo kun tu khyab/ /rang bdas chab srid nor bu'i tos gis mdzes/ /dpal 'byor gser gyi dra ba dra phyed brgyan/ /tshan rig rig gnas rin chen do shal can/ /glang ngo rin chen gzi 'od 'dzam gleng 'phro/ /krung hwa mi rigs yongs kyi sa gzhi la/ /spyi tshogs ring 'u gas gsar brje'i gru char phab/ /dmangs yongs 'tsho ba gsar pa'i lo tos la/ /bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu smin/ /bzo zhing mang tshosas rgyal khab bdag por gyur/ rgyal 0ces ring lugs snying stobs mkha' la 'phyur/ /thon skyed gong 'phel rgyal khab stobs 'byor ldan/ /mi dmangs 'tsho ba'i chu tshad bya ltar 'phur /tshan rig sru nga skar kun gsal rgyan du mdzes / /rgyal srung stobs kyis sa'an sde zil gyis gnon /sngon med sdo snum chu bo'i rgyun bzhin rtsol/ /dmangs kun

26 ga /chab spel tshe brtan gun tshosas kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/la — —phyug 'gyur shes rig dang la yon 'bar/ /mdor na gnam sa bla 'og 'gyur ba lta'i/ /mi lo bzhi bcu'i yar rgyas dan mtshan kun/ /ma lus bsam la tshangs pa 'i blo gros dang / /brjod la chu lha'i rtse yang ngal bar gyur/ /de kun gung srin tang gi 'go khrid 'og /rgyal yongs spun zla mi rigs mthun sgril gyis/ /mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab legs btsugs te/ /spyi tshogs ring lugs lam du bskyod pa'i grin/ /'on tang mi dmangs bde skyid nges/ /dgra zla'i mig la tsher ma bsnun/ /nyin mo'i 'od snang sasal ba yis/ /'byung po'i bya rnams ldongs ba bzhin/ /'di na gzhan 'byor phun tshogs mthong tshe ma rungs sems ldan snying la zug rngu skye/ /phrag dog dug gis snying khong rab myos gzhan sde za 'dod tshul min kha chu 'dzar/ /btsan rgyal ring lugs gdus pa'i sbrul gyis mngon brtsi lkos 'gal lce gnyis lhab lhab skyang / /log spyod shos kha sdig pa'i khyu yang de yi rjes su khyi ltar 'bral med rgyug mes rgyal mtshan ldan mi rigs la rgya rang lus dang bcas phangs med du/ /btsong ste dmangs kyi dgra bo'i mdun du pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs/ /las gnyis thal mo brang lar sbyar te bka' gsung ci sgrub khas len pa'i/ /mi rigs rkang 'dren mjug ma med pa'i khyi skyon nyung shas phyir thon te /gung khran tang gi gcig gyur 'bo khrid mgo rting slog rgyu dang / /krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab rtsa slo ga gtong sems kyi/ /gsar brjer ngo rgol drag po'i satum spyod zing 'khrug cher bslangs nas/ gsod rdung gtor bsreg nam mkhar mi shong nag nyes bsags/ /mes rgyal lho nub mtha' mtshams grong khyer lha sar yang / /kha bral ring 'u gas nyung shas phyi nang las phrel gyis/ /phyi rgyal mi ngan nyung ngu'i sa 'brangs bod 'di rang btsan mas /bab col sgrog cing gtor bcom zing cha thengs 'ga' bslangs/ /'on te spyi tshogs 'phel ba'i chos nyid dang / /dmangs kyi khe phan re 'dod dang 'gal phyir/ /de kun so sos rdo chen yar bteg nas/ /rang rkang gcog pa'i ngan

gag— —rgyal khanas rgyal kha'i phyogs su bskyod pa ri 27'bras rang la 'khor/ /krung dbyang gros tshosas ba'i pa'i dpyid rlung gis/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen btsog snyigs gtsang mar phyags/ /mi dmangs yid la re ba'i 'bras bu byin/ /blo bde bag phebs dus bde'i khor yug bskrun/ /sa yol thabs med pa'i 'thab rtsod de dag sos/ /skye rgu'i blo mig rab rib mtha' dag 'phyis/ /yin min 'byed pa 'i shes rab gong 'phel gyis/ /gcig gyur bas ma blo'i tshang 0zhi brtan po tshugs/ /brtan snying mthun sgril rnam pa gsar pa'i 'os dmangs yo ngas ngos rtsa gcis sgril snying sto bas 'phel/ /'thab phyogs khas nas rgyal kha'i 'phrin bzang gis/ /rgyal tshugs dus ston chen po ra les/sa skyes 'bul/ /de mthong na tshod cher smin pa'i/ /cad ngo bdag kyang dasa' ba rgyas/ rgyal ston rten 'brel la dmigs nas/ /bsngags brjod rol mo ci dasar dgrol/

28— ——wa wa — 'tsho ba gsar par phul ba'i bstod dbyangs/wa bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol btang nas lo ngo sum cu 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu/bod ljongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams/ /gzab mchor bos dang mdzes pa 'i rgyan spras te/ /mi lo sum cu'i rlabs chen 'gyur ldog gi /'tsho ba gsar pa ra dga' ba'i bstod dbyangs 'bul/ /'di ni ston mo'i ched du ston mo dang / /glu gar don du glu gar 'khrab pa min/ /yar langs zhing bran khri tsho brgya phrag gis/snye /sngar dran deng bsdur byed pa'i nyin mo yin / /mi bzad dgun gyi grang ngar ma dran na/ /dpyid dpa la lang tsho'i dro skyid tshor mi thub/ /'khyags ltogs gdung ba'i lo zla ma dran na/ /zas gos 'dzoms pa'i bde ba tshor mi thub/snye /bran 0yog lam lusas mtshan mo'i mun nag khrod/ /bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin smag rum rab 'thibs pas /sar 'gro'i gtol med zhing bran khri tsho brgya/ /mchi ba'i lam du sason re'i 'gre ldos byed/ /rang lus rang la mi dbang btson ra'i nang / /

ston /bod zhi ba'i bcing 'grol btang na long sum cu 'khor bar rten 'brel mu/ 29— —————wa wa —— sa — 'i drag khral rigs thag zhags sbom bos bcings/ /brnas dka'i 'u lag lcags sgrog gnya' bar lci/ /mi yu la zer yang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong / /rkang pas ser skya'i grong du ma phyin kyang / /zas kyis sto ba mi rgyags rin cing skya/ /rgyal khams bskor ba'i zang po ma yin yang / /lus kyi gos hrul rkang rjen ser gas khengs/ /mgo la rwa dang lus la spu med kyang / /nyin mor theg dka'i khur gyis lus yongs mnan / /mtshan mo sa 'khyags stan dang rdo 'khyags sngas/ /smra shes dud 'gro'i 'tsho bas lo bla skyel/ /bzod dka'i gdung bas mnar ba'i pha ma rnams/ /rang sdug so khyag bzhin du mid na yang /snying ltar gces pa'i bu dang tsha bo darga /thar med me 'obs 'di las sus skyob snyam/ /'chi mas brnangs shing re thag chad pa'i mig /rig rig phyogs su blta ba'i lo zla'i nang / / gnam gyis ma bskyabs sa yis ma 'khyongs pa'i/ /skyabs med mgon med dus de brjed mi rung / /thon skyed malan la 'bras bu mi dbang bar/ /gzhan brten 'tsho 'bus rgyas za rgyas 'thung byed / /de ni bshu gzhig mkhan gyi lha yul dang / /ngal rtsol pa yi mi yul dmyal ba dngos/ ༈de lta'i phra 'ib sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /

30 tog /chab spel tshe brtan rgyun chosas mi ma rig brtsam lto rgyasas bsgris /wa wa —————chu lha'i lces kyang brjod par mi nus mod/ / rang thog myangagapa'i zhing bran zan rabs kyi/ /yid la me long nang gi gzugs /rtan bzhin/ /dbyar dus char chu dgun dus rlung mi khegs/ /brlan bsher mun nag can gyi khang hrul nang / /mi rabs mang por thal rdul du ba'i khrod/ /bskyal ba'i 'tsho bar phyir mig blta thub na/ /da lta nyams dga'i khang bzang shel khras brgyan/ /nyi 'od snang bas lus sems bde la phab/ /mkho dgu'i yo chas 'dzoms pa'i 'gyur ldog 'di/ /rtsa ba gang las byung ba cis kyang shes/ /snyiphrod pa'i dus med khral 'ul khur chen gyis/ /gnya' nas mnan te 'dar 'dar gom pa'i 'gros/ /spo bzhin la 'phrang rtsub mo brgal dus kyi/ /ngal dub ma brjed phyir dran byed thub na/ / deng 'dir ldir sgra gleg pa'i rlangs 'khor dang / /'drud 'then 'phrul 'khor che chung sna tshogs kyis/ /mi zag thams cad gang 'dod sa der skyel/ /bsam don lhun grub su yi drin yin rtogs/ /sngon chad g.yul thag chod dus spasas thag chod/ /da dung khral bun 'ded thag mi chod par/ /khur shog khyer shog hor 'dras rdog cing 'tshos /zas med sdug gi nam zla de dran na/ /deng dus ngal rtsol 'bral bu rang la dbang / /

ga /bod thi ba'i bcing 'grel btang nas lo ngo sum cu 'khor bar rten 'bril gu 31wa wa——— — —— — ——bang ba 'brus bkang sna mang zhor las brel/ sha mar bal sogs rang mos brje tshong gis / ma'o dgu tshang bas bde skyid snying nas tshor /sngon ces phyi yul dpyid dpal bzhad na yang / /mi la lto dang phyugs la zan chas med / /so nam ran dus sa bon ma mchis pas /skyed rtse'i bu lon 'tshol ba'i dus bsam na/ /deng sang lcags kyi glang ngo sa rmod log rgyag /mi phyugs 'tsho ba bzang bas stobs shugs che/ /son bzang brgya 'debs stong smug dus thog 'debs/ /'di dag gang las byung ba los kyang shes/ /spyi tshogs rnying pa'i sdug bsngal bgrang mi lang /spyi tshogs gsar pa'i bde skyid bshad mi tshar mdor na rlabs chen dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyis/ / zhing bran khri brgya yar la ngas bcings 'grol thob/ /tsanam sa bla 'og bsgyur ba'i gsar brje re/ / tshegs med lhun gyis grub pa ga la yin/ /rang bde blos btang dpa' bo du ma yis/ /zungs khrag phangs med bton nas bskrun pa lags/ sal te gung khyan tang gi 'go khrid dang / /mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag i 'bad 'thab gnyis/ /rigs khas spun zla'i rogs skyor gsum meji na/ bod dmangs deng gi bde skyid ji ltar 'byung / de'i phyir mes rgyal gcig gyur srung skyob dang sgyu

32 ga /chab spel tshe ba na —gun rdo sa kyi rtsomarig brtsam cho rgyagasabasgrims/mi rigs mdza' mthun rdog rtsa gcig dril gyis/ / spyi tshogs ring lugs bod gsar 'dzugs skrun ched/ /rang rang shes nus ci yod 'don la 'bungs/ /bzod dka' sngar gyi sdug bsngal ma shes na/ /da lta'i bde skyid thams cad cang cang 'dra/ /sasar rnying khyad par re re bzhin bsdur na/ /'tsho ba dngos kyi nang nas sdus lan rnyed/ /de skad tshigs su bcad pa'i 'bol rtsom 'di/ /rgya che'i rang rigs kun gyis gsan bde phyir/ /rgyan dang mngon brjod brda yis ma bcings par /kha che pha lu'i rtsom srol bzhin du bris/ / phyog

— — /)shā)shes brjod bkra shis rtags brgyad/mar le ring lugs gser gyi srog shing la / /krung go'i khyad chos dar zab chu bos grol/ /gung khran tang mchog nor bu'i tog gis mdzes/ /rlabs chen mes rgyal gdugs dkar grib bsil yangs/ /gangs can sa la'i sman ljongs chu gter dbus/ /mi rigs srid jus gser mig rab bkra ba'i/ /rang skyong dpal ldan gser nya kha sbyor gyi/ /dpa la yon ngom nas lo 'khor nyi shu'i ring / /grung dbyang mdzub ston dgos 'dod kun 'byung la sa/ /gangs ljongs dpal 'byor spel ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun /rab 'jo srid gzhung gter chen bum bzang na grags snya na dar dpyang phyosas kun lhab lhub sayo/ / sang 'thus bod ljongs mi dmangs pa da ma'i tshal/ /dbul sel phyug 'gyur 'dab stong yongs bzhad cing / /'dod rgya'i 'tsho ba sbrang rtsi'i mdzod 'dzin par ༈ /phyogs kyi bung bas yid smon bstod dbyangs sgros /tshan rig slob gso'i re kha g.yas 'khyil dung / rmongs pa'i gnyid las slong ba'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /le khri'i sa mthor bsam pa'i dpal yon 'bum/ skrun bzhin shes ldan bye ba skyed sring byed/ /

/4 sku /chab spel tshe ba na phun tshogs kyi rtsom ris brtsams chos spyogs ba thos/— 'dzam gling rtse mo deng rabs can 'gyur rted / sna tshogs 'dzugs skrun dpa la gyi be'u'i ris/ /mi dmangs phan bde'i dgos mtshe skong byed pa / /rang ljongs 'dzin ma'i lte gnas kun na bkra/ /btsan 'dzul dkrug shing mes rgyal kha bral so gas/ /dmangs gnod nyer 'tshe ming gi mthar byed pa'i/ /mi dmangs srid dbang nor bu'i rgyal mtshan mchos /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal zhing rnam par brjid/ /mi rigs mthun sgril gcis gyur mu khyud nang / /'bad pa 'i rtsibs stong deng can bzhi'i phyogs su/ /'tshar ba'i bod spyongs gser gyi 'khor 'o 'di/ sne ma dun nas mdun du 'phur bar rten 'brel zhu/ /

————wa shis brjod/ wa bod ljongs 〈 lho kha rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉 zhes par phul ba'i shis tshigarus bse ldong rmu dang dbra sosas las 'phel ba'i /gshis las la brtson zhing dang 'a ngar dang ldan pa /blo shes ris bkra ba'i bod mi yi 'byung khungs/ /yu la lo rgyus ring ba bod ljongs kyi lto kha/ /rje spur rgyal gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung ste/ ༈bod sana' rabs lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi lte ba/ mkhar yu ma bu bla sgang ma tho brjid dang ldan pa/ /yul gna' shul grasas can bod ljongs kyi lho kha/ /dma' 0shongs sa 'bru sna lnga 'dzoms kyi zhing sa / mtho spang ri g.yag rta ra lus gis khengs pa/ /grong grong brdal nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar bkra ba'i/ /yul 'dod rgu 'dzoms pa bod smongs kyi sto kha/ /snam dkar 'jam spu phrug sprin masar dang mtshungs la/ /mdzes pa nga gdan 'ja' tshon sna lnga la 'gran pa/ /'jam rtse ther rgya ngar dkar po dang 'dra sogs/ sgyubazo thags las dar ba bod ljongs kyi lho kha/ /

36 ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun tsho sa kyi rtsom rig ba mas chos rgyags bsgrims/yul snod bcud dge mtshan bye ba yis phyug kyang / /sngar zhing bran lam lugs spyi tshogs kyi nang du/ /rgya che ba'i zhing 'brog ngal rtsol gyi mi dmangs/ /khral 'u lag skra grangs chu gnyer gyis rab gtses/ /sdobyar lto ba mi rgyags phyed 'grangs dang phyed ltogs/ /dgun lus po mi dros grang 'khyags kyis mnar zhing / /gces rang lus rang la mi dbang ba'i zhing bran/ /sdug sna dgu spyong bas mi yul gyi dmyal ba/ /lo brgya phrag du mar mi rabs nas mi rabs/ /gtam smra shes tsam las rta phyugs kyi 'tsho ba/ /dus nyin mtshan 'khor mor dbang med du myong bzhin/ /sdus mun mtha' zad pa'i nam dus shig bsgug bsdad/ /shar mes rgyal kun chags ri rab kyi spo las/ /mthon gung khran tang gi 'od stong can 'char bas / bod sa mtho'i sdug bsngal 'khyags rom kun bzhus nas/ /dmangs par langs bcings bgrol 'dod don de grub byung //dpal spyi tshogs ring lugs khyad 'phags kyi lam du/ /yun ji tsam bskyod pa de tsam gyis bde skyid/ / sgos tang gi dbul bcos phyug 'gyur gyi srid jus/ / yongs zhing 'brog sems la je thim dang je mngar/ /nor dngos po'i dpal yon gra rgyas su 'gyur dus/ /yid bsam pa'i dpal yon lhan cig tu dar dgos/ /

—— gagi /shisabarjod/ zi 37yul lho kha'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi sdum rar/ /don dmangs phan me tog sna 'dzoms su ba'ad cig /gzhi rtsa ba'i rtsa don rnam bzhi dang 'gal ba'i/ /mi'i bsam blor btsog skyon satong byed kyi rigs la/ /yid som nyi med par dpa' ngar gyi 'thab rtsod / dus nam yang stod med mtha' 'khyongs su spel dbos/ /dpal gung khran ring lugs bsam blo yi myu gu /rtsom sgyu rtsal rig pa'i srog shing du bzung ste/ /bod dpal yon gnyis ldan 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du/ /skyes bzang po 'bul ba'i shis brjod cig zhu'o/ /

38—wa — ma'o kru'u zhi rjes su dran pa/lnga bcu phrag brgya bgrang bya'i lo rgyus kyi ri mor/ /bcu drug cha ldan ji bzhin ya ra 'phel dang mar 'grib/ /zo chun khyud mo'i 'gros ltar 'khor ba yi krung gor/ / bde sdug dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba mi 'dzad pa'i mtha' ma/ /rtse mo'i grangs ldan sa 'dzin lhun po yi 'bas su/ /krung hwa mi rigs smag rum rgya mtsho ru lhung zhing / /til ltar bcir zhing brlan bral yam shing ltar bsregs pa 'i/ /thar med mi bzad duḥkha'i tshor ba yis rab mnar/ /de'i tshe hra'o hran rtse dga'i ri bo yi spo las/ /blo gros zer khri 'bum ldan 'od snang gi phung bo/ /dang 'a mdzangs mun nag mthar byed mi rigs kyi skyob skar/ /ma'o tse tung zhis sngon med nyi bcon khyed shar byung / /mar le ring lugs bden don rin chen gyi tog de / krung go'i don dngos za 'og chu gos dang byul zhing / /gsar brje rgan rabs krung go'i srog thing du byas pa'i/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i gung khran tang dbu brnyes/ /de mthong tsam kyis krung hwa rigs khag gi mi dmangs/ /'chi gso'i bdud rtsi rnyed ltar tang gi rjes 'brangs te/ /sngon gshegs dpa' bos rang gi thungs khras dang brjes nas/ /'dzam gling g.yo 'gul thebs pa'i rgyal kha khri blangs yod/

— ———sa diX kru'u'irjes su dran pa ri 39btsan rgyal ring lusas sadus can lce gnyis kyi dug sbrul /dmag shed can dang sa bdas gnod 'bu yi khyu sogs/ /dmangs la 'tshe ba'i phyi nang dgra bshegs kyi tshogs rnams/ /tshar bcad rjes 'dzin ming gi lhag ma ru brlags song / /sngon chad nad kyis zin pa'i gnyis 'thung du brtsi ba'i/ rlabs chen mes rgyal sa sgang ya gling gi lte bar/ /stobs 'byor snyan grags gling lnga mtsho bzhi kun khyab pa'i/ /rin chen brtsegs pa bzhin du brjid nyams kyis 'gying yod /spyi tshogs ring lugs dpyid kyi dpal yon ltar rab ba' da / /rgyal khab stobs ldan mi dmangs bde skyid kyis phyug la/ /dpal yo na gnyis kyi grags snyan 'jig rten na 'bar ba'i/ /e ma gang gis mngon sum gzigs na ci ma rung / /mchog nyid bltams nas mi lo brgya phrag gcig 'khor ba'i /dus 'dir nyid kyi bka' drin snying dbus nas bsam ba'i na / /rigs lag mi dmangs kun gyis gtso 'dzin khyed dran nas/ /mig nas mchi zhag 'khor bzhin bka' drin tshig zhu'o/ /

40 wa —————— ——rab dga'i mchod dzin/—dro skyid mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang / / spun zla mi rigs las gdang dpung thel gyis/ /ji tsam mdun du bskyod pa de tsam gyis/ /bod ljongs stobs 'byor bde skyid dpal yon 'bar/ /ring ring ma song mi lo sum cu'i nang / /chung chung ma yin bod kyi 'gyur ldog 'dir/ /la la tsam min gzur gnas skye bo kun/ /'dzum 'dzum dga' ba'i bstod dbyangs phyogs brgyad 'gyed/ /tshul 'di mthong bas rgad po'i yid mtshor yang / /bcos min spro dga'i rlabs phreng dgung du 'phyur/ /zegs ma mu tig dkar po'i dog pa yis/ /dus ston chen por rab dga'i mchod srin spro/ /

—— sa/tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho 'khrungs nas lo sum brgya 'khor bar dran gso zhu ba/rin chen nags kyis basmor ba'i mon yul du/ /mtshan dpe mdzes sdug 'bar ba'i sku bltams shing / /tshangs dbyangs zil sanon mgur glu'i nyams 'gyur 'bum/ /gangs ljongs glu gzhas rgya mcho3re bla na 'phalas/ /thung thung ma yin mi lo brgya phrag gsum/ /yud yud dus bzhi'i bgrod pa sa gzhal ba'i ring /dal dal spyi tshogs 'gyur ba 'ga' byung yang / /snyan snya na mgur glu'i gralas pa nyams pa med / / ltos shis rtsom rig malas pa'i brtsam bya des/ /dam ngas kyod sgyu la nying bu spyod shes na/ /bskul ba med kyang mang tshogs rang nyid kyis /de la gces par 'dzin pa dngos po'i gshis/ /mi rims sgyu rtsal dar gyi srad bu lag /don ldan snyan tshig mu ti ka yi phreng / /sdebs legs tshims su bcad pa'i mgur glu yis/ /

42 gsha /chab spel tshe ba sdo dun tshogs kyi rtsom ris brtsamasachosargyagasabasgribs/ wa ma lus skye rgya'i yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog /sacam bu'i dri bral tshig gi me long nang / /gang 'char zol med thugs kyi gzugs brnyan 'bum/ /sna tshogs nyams brgya gar gyi rol pa can/ /mngon sum rjen 'char lta bas ngoms pa med/ /dus der rtog 'dzings du ba'i yol ba yis /spyi tshogs gsang ba'i rang mtshang bkab pa rnams/ /khyed kyis bsal bas rjes rabs dpyod ldan tshor/ /dngos don gnad kyi ltad mo ci yang bstan/ /mnyan na kun yid 'phrog pa sa pi wang dang / /myang na lus sems bde bas sbrang chang ste/ /lugs rnying 'ching zhags gcod pa sa spu gri yi/ /cho ga ma lus mgur glu 'di la rdzogs/ /dus rabs nyi shu'i smad cha deng gi char/ /rlabs chen gung khran tang gi 'od snang 'og /krung hwa mi rigs yar langs bcing bkrol thob/ /mes rgyal snyan pa'i grags pa 'dzam gling khyab/ /spyi tshogs ring lugs khyim tshang chen po'i nang / / spun zla mi rigs mdza' mthun mnyam sprel gyis/ /phan tshun brtsi bkur mdung shugs gcig sgril dang / /deng rabs can bzhi'i phyogs su dpung bskyod byed/ /

ga /tshangasadabyangasargyamatsho'akhrurda nas losum brgya'akhorabaradranas nub /ri0 43yun ring dbul phongs rjes lus gangs ljongs kyang / da lko 'byor phyug shes rig dpa la yo na dar/ /bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar pa la spyod pa'i/ /dpal 'di khyed kyis sazilas na ci ma rung / /sanya' 0non med pas mi rnams dasa' sgro 'khol / /bshu gzhog bral bas dpal 'byor dar 'ing rgyas/ /gzhon nu pho mo rang dbang sa/nyen sgrig byed/ / khyed kyi mgur klu'i dbongs pa mngon du gyur/ /mi risas srid jus bsil sbyin dbang po 'i 'od / /bod yul glu gar rgya mtsho la 'phros pas/ /sgyu rtsal sasar pa 'i rlabs phreng 'bum 'phyur bzhin/ / 'phel rgyas dbu ba'i 'dzum dkar phyogs bzhir 'gyed/ /

slong — ——— ——— — — ———tang gi bu phrug bzang po lu'u ya'o rtseng /rtag tu bod dmangs snying dbus gson por bzhugs/krung hwa mi risas nyam nga la sa skyob pa'i/ /krung go gung khran tang gi gso skyong 'og /krung hwa'i phul byung mi rabs gsar pa yis /krung bo'i bzhin ras rnam pa gsar du sgyur/ / tang i mi rigs srid jus nyi gzhon gyis/ /bod ljongs sa mthor dpyid kyi dpal yon bskrun/ /rigs khag spun zla'i mthun sgril me tog 'bum/ /bzhad cing yar rgyas bsung mngar phyogs bcur 'thul/ /yun ring rjes lus thebs pa'i bod ljongs 'dir/ /thon skyed 'dzugs skrun sgo brgya 'byed pa'i slad/ /sngon thon mi rigs spun zla'i rogs skyor ni/ /kha ba'i khrod du 'bud shing skyel ba bzhin/ /tang ji slob ston la thod spyi bor bcings bod dmangs zhabs 'degs bur po phrag par blangs/ /skyes nga 'i yu la dang sger sems rgyab tu skyur snye /

rdza /tadag sdo zug bzang pa lu'u ya'o tseng bong dasgom snyingarabu gson por ba ༄0/ 45le khri'i sa mthor pha yung gnyis pa btsugs/ /de lta'i blo mthun 'thab phyogs kub khyab pas/ / bod gsar 'dzugs skrun mdzad rjes je che dang / /mi rigs mthun sgril brtse dung je zab gnyis/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du lhan cig 'phel/ /'di na blo mthun lu'u ya'o tseng gis kyang / /yun ring lo 'tshar nyi shu rtsa drug ring / /mtha' das bod kyi mi dmangs la phul ba'i/ /dper 'os mdzad rjes cha tsam brjod la spro/ /khong nas rin thang bral ba'i gzhon nu'i dus/ /chud zos ma btang da7'a spyad 'bad 'thab kyis/ /slob la brtson pa'i rim pa myur bgrod thog /sa rgyu zhib 'jug ched la sa slob sbyong mdzad / /sbyangs pa mthar son slob grwa thon pa nas tang gi ci sasung sgrub la brtson pa'i mur/ /glo bur 'dzam glinganyang bod ljongs su/ /bskyod dgos sgrig 'dzugs b.la' brda spyi bor phab/ /tang i bka' dang rgyal mtshams 'dzugs skrun gyi /sazi brjid don snying bsams pa'i snying stobs kyis/ /rang sger dka' sdug mtha' dag zil mnan te/ /bka' yi cod paṇa bcing bar dam bca' bkod /

46 ga /chab spol tshe brtan sun tshog kyi rtsom rig brtsoms chos rgya thobasgrig /wa wa —wa —————— wa ——— bod kyi sa rgyu'i gsang ba rtogs pa dang / /sa nus thon khungs zab mo sdog 'don thog /mi rigs thon skyed gong 'phel myur gtong gi /'thab sems 'bar bzhin bod kyi phyogs su thon/ / thag ring 'grul bzhud byed pa'i shul lam du/ / ngal saso'i skabs su'ang sbar mos 'dam sa blangs/ /yang yang brtag bzhin ched las khur sems dang / /bod kyi sa gzhi chen po gcig tu 'dres/ /mnyam 'byor blo mthun brgyad dang lhan cig tu/ / bod spyongs zhing las chod lta ra bar phebs /thog mar sa rgyu'i dpyad zhib khang dang po/ /gnyer nas dmas 'thab 'tsho ba skyel 'go tshugs/ /bod rigs dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu bsal na/ /cis kyang mi risas de dang 'dres dgos snyam/ /las seng yod tshad bod rigs bzo pa'i khrod/ /zhing ra'i rtsi ba'i ngal rtsol nang du zhugs/ /dka' spyad brtson pa drag pos bod skad dang / / mi rigs yul srol goms sashis 'bad pas sbyangs/ /rim bzhin bzo par sa rgyu'i tshan rig gi /ga'i rtsa'i shes bya bshad nas khyab sadal btang / /a mas khong la bod du bskyod pa'i skabs/ /

ga /tang bu zug bzang po lu'u ya'o tseng bod dmang snying dbum son bar bzhushās/ 7wa ——— wa wa —wa — wa nga la gsang don ci yin bka' bkyon sogs/ /'dri tshig nan bos khengs pa'i 'phrin yig dag /yang yang 'byor bas sems la thug rngu ster/ /khong gis gung khran ring lugs mi'irigs kyi/ /lta ba gsal btsugs tang gi slob ston ltar/ / bod du rtsa ba 'dzugs rgyu'i chod sems bcas /a mar bzod gsol tshig gi sngon 'gro'i 'os / bod dmangs yongasal kho bo dbosapa dang / /bdas la'ang bod dang bod kyi mi dmangs dbos/ /de'i phyir bod rigs bu mo zla dkar dngan /gnyen sgrig gtan 'khel zin zhes 'phrin lan phul/ /chu stag gnam lo'i rang zhal lasar tshes nyin/ /long dang zla dkar blo mthun cha gsum lhan/ / bdun gcig zhing ra'i stabs bde'i tshogs khang nang / /mnyam du sasar brje'i gnyen sgrig dga' ston mdzad/ /mtshan mo las bzo kun 'dzoms dga' bder 0yeng :glo bur blo mthun lu'u lags der med pas/ /bcal mthar gzhung las khang nang 'brog khul gyi/ / skye dngos tshod 'debs dpyad yig sgrig pa mthong / /rgyal phung dmangs brlag lo bcu'i zang zing nang / /zla dkar 'byung khungs mnga' tshab red ces dang / /

48 ga /chab rtse tshe brtan gun tshog kyi rtsom rig ba mas chos cagagabasgrigs/lu'u lags dkar mkhas lam du 'gro zer sogs/ /dkar nag phyin ci slog pa'i rdung deg sog / —khong gis rang nyid gung khran ring lugs kyi/ / 'thab 'dzing pa zhigabyas te yod tshad kun/ / blos gtong thub pa'i mi zhig byed ces pa'i/ /dam bca' dran te ched las sngar bzhin sgrub/ /rgya che mtha' yas bod kyi sa gzhi'i thog / stod smad lho byang rdzong khag lnga bcu lhag / mtho gzar ri dang dma' ba'i chu rong sogs/ /gang sar khong gi rkang rjes rngul chus khyab/ / sa mtho'i gnam gshis ched las dka' sdug gig /yun ring gtses pa'i khong gi gzugs khams shāka / sna tshogs nad gzhis mnar bzhin hrang had du/ /'khor zhag bskyod nas ma rgan mjal 'phrad zhus/ /gzhon sha chags pa'i rang gi ba gcig de/ /sne dmi /dka' ngal nad kyis rgyad pa a mas gzigs/ /spyan chabs sil bzhin bza' tsho bu phrug bcas/ /rang yul log rgyu'i re 'dun nan tan gnang / /byams ldan a ma'i gsung ngo ldog dka' bas/ /brtson len bya rgyu'i rnam 'gyur bstan na yang / /lkog tu gcung mor bod dang kha bral na/ /

ga /tang gi bu sgug/bzang po lu'u ya'o chung bod dmangs snying dbum ga na por bzhus 49nga dang ched las snying po med ces gsungs/ /'khor zhag ma rdzogs gong nas bod du phebs/ /bod ljongs zhing las thon skyed ldab 'phar ched/ /sa mtho'i sa rgyu brtson zhib brtag dpyad kyi/ /tshan ris ched rtsom rin thang ldan pa'ang brtsams/ /rgya bod blo mthun tsho dang mnyam las 'og /mu'u re'i rgya ma stong dang nyis brgya ltas /thon pa 'i sran son lha sa ang dang pos / /bod dang zhing chen gzhan la'ang legs skyes phul/ /rgyal rtse rdzong gi tshod lta'i 'ing ra yis/ /dgun gror thon mtho blangs pa'i byas rjes nang / /long gi dpyad zhib gzengs su thon pa des/ /ming med dpa 'a bo'i tshan rig lesas skyes phul/ /bod ljongs dgun nas dgun gro smin 'gor ba'i/ / —gnad don sol phyir brtag dpyad zhib 'jug thog /phan ldan bya thabs bton sogs tshan rig dang / mthun pa'i zhing las bya bar mdzad rjes ba'ag /0'an yang nags tshal sa rgyur dpyad zhib dang / /rang byung nasas tshal bskyar dar brtson zhib gnang / /pha mtha' mi mngon byang phyogs rtswa thang bi /sa rgyu la yang brtag dpyad zhib 'jug mdzad / /

50 ga /chab spel tshe brtanasan tshogs kyi rtsom ri rtse ba lagaXdi chos phyogs bsgrigs/long rang gcig pus sa sgyu'i ma dpe grangs/ /chig stong bdun brgya lnga bcu 'tshol bsdu gnang / /bod ljongs yongs kyi sa rgyu'i rigs dbye dang / /skyodangos bkod sgrig 'char gzhi chen po brtsams/ /mthun rkyen zhan pa'i le khri'i sa mtho 'dir/ /'byung 'khrusas nad kyis gdung pa 'i lu'u lags kyis/ / ngal 'khang gnyis bzod dga'arnag khyad bsad ngang / / bskrun pa'i mdzad rjes mtha' dag brjod las 'das/ /lhag par blo mthun dngos grub phun tshogs sogs/ /bod rigs la ga rtsal mkhas mang gso skyong dang / sang du byon sar de sa'i mi dmangs la/ /sa rgyu tshan rig dmar khrid 'grel bshad gnang / /bod dang bod kyi mi dmangs la dasa' zhing sgyu /bod gsar skrun ched rang gi shes nus kun/ /bod kyi thon skyed chen por phul ba 'di / /bod dmangs snying gi dkyil du lham mer gsal/ /khong gi gting mtha' bral ba'i brtse dung dang / /khong gi bla na med pa'i gces sems te/ /khong gi don snying ldan pa'i bya gzhag dang / /khong gi rin thang bral ba'i tshe srog rnams/ rgya khyon che ba'i bod ljongs sa mtho dang / /

gan /tang gi bu phrug bzang po 'u 'u ya'o tseng bod dmangs snying dbus gson por bzugs/ 51—— wa — — —— wa wa rgya che'i bod kyi rigs khag mi dmangs yongs/ /rgya chen bod kyi sa rgyu zhib 'jug bcas/ /rgya khyab dbye ba med pa gcis tu 'dres/ /bod ljongs mi dmangs bde skyid snying nga bcangs/ /sa mtho'i sa rgyur bsam blo gtong bzhin du/ /dgun tshang nags rong dog po'i chu klung nang / /khong si sku srog las ku'i ched du shor/ /gung khran ring lugs snying stobs chu shel khams/ /sger sems sprin pa'i saya' tsam ma 'gos par/ /lhag bsam cha shas yongs gang zla ba de/ / glo bur chu lha'i phang par mnal na yang / /rang don khe grams gang yang mi gnyer bar/ /mtha' das bod kyi mi dmangs la phul ba'i/ rlabs chen tang gi bu phrug bzang po de / / rtas tu bod dmangs snying dbus gson por bzhugs/ /

52 — ———nya gad mo shor ba/(bod kyi dmangs khrod ngag srung snyan ngag gas bcad kyi lam du drangs ba/)mi yi rigs kyi shes rig gi /'byung khungs chen po mang tshogs nyid/ /dmangs dang bral la yon tan med/ /de yang 'di skad rjes su thos/ /sngon tshe dbyig ldan zhes grags pa'i/ /'dzam gling sa yi lte ba na/ / sa bdag 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ces/ /grags pa'i yi be gsal ba yod/ /lnga brgya btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas/ /rtse byed sa yi mig stong can/ ltade mthong mchod sbyin brgya pa༅yang / / skyengs te lhun po'i spo la bzhin/ /rnam rgyal khang bzang0la 'gran pho brang mkhar/ /brgya phrag lnga ldan btsun mo re re'i mkhar/ /nyams dga'i snyeg ris tshar du dngar ba yis/ /yongs bskor mu tig phreng bas gtsus tor bzhin/ /btsun mo'i lang tshor rjes chags sa bdag des/ /mkhar rer nub re gcig nas lnga brgya'i bar/ /

—— ga nyagadamo thor ba/ — 53mis bzos sa yi bo 'khyere srung skar gyis/ /sa sgang bzhin du rang gi pho༄nga bskor/ /rin chenacan dang za 'ogagis bklubs kyangan /bag yod ngo tsha'i gos bralagacer bur rtsa /chags sred rul dri bro ba'i spyod tshul der/ /dmangs kyis dmod pa'i rigs sngags shub bur bzla/ /khu byus myos pa'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /skul ltar me tog 'dab brgya༄sal/ /dri zhim bsung bas bung ba bzhin/ /des kyang dpyid kyi dpal yon bkug / ngoms med 'dod pa'i rtse dga' la/ /rol bas re zhig skyid lug pa/ / mi bdag skyed mos tshal yangs su/ /'khor bcas 'chas cing 'khyam pa las/ /rkang 'thung phreng bas yongs bskor ba'i/ / rab dwangs sngo sangs rdzing bu'i ngosas/ / 'dab stong bzhad pa'i chu skyes tshogs / sa skyong phebs par smra ba bzhin/ /rab dwangs padma can gyi nga bu'i khar/ /rab snum༅sngon pa 'i bsil grib nyams dga' bar/ /rab dkar chu shel brkos ma'i stegs bu la / /rab 'bar tsha 0dung sel phyir ngal gso bsten/ /mi dbang nos ko las pa la brten nas/ /

54 gan /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyi rtsom ri brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/wa wa —— — chu nang blta skabs sbal pa pho mo gnyis/ /brtsegs nas snyom 'jug bde ba'i rtse dga' la/ /rol mthong yid la rnamartog 'di ltar 'char/ /kye ma srog chags phra mo 'di lta yang / /rang rang grogasadang 'bral med lhan cig 'grogs/ /stong phrag byed ldan kho bo'i btsun mo dag /bzhi brgya go dgur grogs med —rab gdung snyam/ /de tshe mthing sngon chu rdzing las/ /sa yi zla ba'i mdangs 'phro ba'i/ /mig mi 'dzumasazhig mgo btegs nas/ /ha ha zhes pa'i dgod sgra sgrog /'dod pa'i dbang phyug rang gi bsam gtan las/ /glo bur sad de ya mtshan rgyas par bsams/ /e ma gser nyas mi ltar dathod pa'i gtam/ /sngon chad 'jig rten 'di na grags pa med/ /'di ni thun mong nyid min pa'i/ /ngo mtshar mchog ldan rgyu ci zhig /'tshol 'dod rings pa'i blo gros kyis/ /rgyal po'i pho brang phyogs su sdog /mes po'i blo ldan du rlom pa'i/ /che rgu blon po'i mdun gros su/ /rgyu mtshan bsnyad tshe thams cad kyang / /ri mor byas pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /

rdza /nya sad ma zor ba/ — 55— —— wa wamathar gyis 'brel med mu cor gtam/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mang smra yang / /dag byed srub las ji bcud bzhin/ /rdo kha chu shing snying por 'gran/ /sa bdag re ba'i rkang 'thung༅ni/ /'bras bus ma dud khong khro'i mes/ /dgyes pa bsregs nas spyo ba'i tshig /'di skad blon po'i tshogs la bsgrags/ /bdas gi mngon 'dod dri ba'i lan /'phyang mo'i dra ba gcod pa'i tshig /mi glan khyed cag dar zab kyis/ /g.yo gas pa'i khyi lud nyid du zad / song zhis bdun phrag gdusas7kyi ring / /rgyal khams kun tu dris la soms sal te da dung don med na / /'jig rten pha rol 'tshol phyir mngag /de skad btsan po'i bka' lung des/ /blon dang blon pos 'khor dang 'bangs/ /sgong skyes lus kyi spu tshogs bzhin/ /gong ma gong mas 'og ma mnan/ /mi zad rje bo'i dpya dang skyes ni zla ba'i ma ma'i rlabs phreng bzhin/ /sacis mjus gnyis su mthud pa 'i nyer 'tshes bar mtshams med par rtag

56 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi marag brtsams chos phyogs bsgri sa — wa wagatses pas/ / tshe gcig so nam bya bar 'bad kyang zas dang bos kyis rab dbul ba'i/ /ser skya'i yulasamatshungs zhing grong kun tu'ang btsan bo'i lung de rlung ltar bsnyegs/ /rgyus med don de thos pa'i tshe khrims kyis bsdigs pa'i skrag dang bcas/ /la 'ur gcig gis gcig la blta/ /de tshe bas mtha'i ri grong na/ /gnas bcas 'byor pas yongs btang yang / / shes rig nor gyis rab phyug pa'i/ /gzhon nu zhig gis bsams shing ches/ /grogs dag nyon mongs mi 'tshal bar /zhag 'ga'i rgyags phye bdag la stsol / /kun gyi chad du skog gyur 'di/ /'tshol ba'i dam bca' kho bo len/ /de thos thabs kyis phongs pa'i so nam pa/ /nyi zer reg pa'i padma'i dga' tshal bzhin /'dzum pa'i so phreng ge sar dathod dang bcas/ /cung zad lhag ma'i zas deg nyer bsdog byed/ /ga'on nu des kyang ngan ngon zagadang gos/ /khros por bgyis dang du ma'i sems kyi khur/ lhan cig rang i phrag pa la bkod de/ /grong mda'i shul lam chen por rim gyisaldanags/ /

wa — — rdza /nyagad shorab/ ri 57song zhing song las rgan po zhig /mdun na 'gro dang lhan cig bsdongs/ /phan tshun 'dres pa'i gtam sabazhin/ /ngam bzar can gyi la rtsar slebag /de tshe gzhon nus slar bsams pa/ /rig pa can gyi mi 'tshol na/ /go ba yod pa'i gleng slong snyam/ /thol byung rgad po la smras pa/ / mes kye la chen ma 'dzigs song / / rang cag bsnog pa'i zan bza' 'am/ /yang na ri yi spor phyin nas/ /bsod pa'i tha yi 'tshal ma 'tshal zhes la rgad ngo sa zan las ni/ /sha nyid ro bda' bcud ldan snyam/ / 'u cag dka' ba sngon spyad de/ /la rtser zas kyi bya ba byed/ /zhes thos sgod po'i 'char sgo dang du blangs/ /bal ldan rgyu ma'i bkod pa dang mtshungs pa'i/ /'khugs 'atātan gyen lam gom pa'i 'degs 'jog gis/ /byas mthar lhun stus ri bo'i rtse mor phyin/ /rab dkar chu 'dzin gnyis 'thungasagis 'khyud pa'i/ /gser ldan sges mo'i nu 'bur yangs rtse der/ /

58 gan/chab spel tshe brtan sun tshog kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgribs —wa wawa wa wa — ———ngal bcas lhags pa'i mgron la mchod yon du//bsgrun 'dra'i rang byung bdud rtsi'i lteng 17mthong //der ni gzhon nus khur phab ste /g.yos pa'i zan gyis rgad po mchod/ 'on tang ring nas sgug pa yi// sha yi dri tsam tshor ma gyur/ /brjod pa don 'gal ma rangs kyang // 'dri la cung zad ngo tsha yis// skyengs bcas rgad pos khur blangs te / /yang ni lhan cig lam du zhugs// —ngam nag brag ri'i ba gam mngon mtho ba//gnam gyi skas dang mtshungs pa 'ga' babs mthar//margad dum bu gcal du bkram pa dang /’/'dra ba'i ri zhing 'ga' zhig rtargyang nas mthong //rgad pos mdzub mo der gtad de / /'di dag kho bo'i zheng yin la// —bdag gi khyim yang mi ring bar/ / yod ces gzhon nu de la smras//des kyang blta bzhin ched du ni//gang gi sa zhing 'di das kun//btab bam 'on te ma btab ces/ dris la nad pos 'phya bzhin smras//ci smra zhing la ljang pa yang //

rdza /nya gad mo shor ba / ri 39sngo ljang ne tso'i sashog par 'gran/ /zhis thos gzhon nu 'dzum dang bcas/ /mi smra slar yang song ba las/ / rnga mong gnya' yi dbyibs srogs pa'i/ /ri nyag dum bu brgal ma thag /stus min sngon pa sa bskor ba yi/ /babs chags khor gnas grong zhis mthong / /yangs steng ma snyigs nu rgyas ma/ / nya gang zla ba'i gdong ldan zhig /las pa dpral ba la bkod de/ /sgrib nas gyen du bya ra byed/ /de mthong rgad pos gzhon nu la/ /'di ni kho bo'i khyim yin te / /'di yang bdag gi bu mo zhes/ /'dzum bcas lag sor sgreng bzhin bstan/ ༈ gzhon nu des kyang bu mo'i khor yug na/ /gnas pa'i g.yos snod rdza yi yol go la/ /smra ba bzhin du khyed kyi khog ma 'di/ / gsar pa nyid dam rnying pa yin zhes dris/ /yang ni rgad pos dbod bzhin du/ /dmar po das ni ma bkol la/ /nag por gyur rnams spyad zin pa/ /de la dri ba'i rgyu ma mchis/ /

60 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun cu sa kyi rtsom rig brtsams cho phyogs bsgribs — zhes la'ang gzhon nus mgo rtsog bcas/ /'dzum bzhin rim gyis song ba'i mthar /rgad po'i bsti gnas sgo drung du/ /ring por ma thogs brtol bar gyur/ /bu kye 'di na cung zhig skugs/ /ring bskyodangal ba sel ba'i slad/ /bdag gi khyim las nas chang gi /skyems shig myur du khyed la 'dren/ /zhes brjod rgad po khyim song nas/ /rang gi bu mo la smras pa/ /de ring lam du glen pa zhig /'grogs gang da lta sgo na mchis/ /'dri smed tsam yang mi shes pa'i/ /gtam gyis gzhan la bzhad gad slong / /btung ba'i skyems kyis sne len bcas/ /re zhig tshim par gyis shig gu/ /de thos gang la'ang rtog cing dpyod byed pa'i/ /mig yangs ma de'i yid kyi dwangs shel ngos/ /ya mtshan gsar pa'i ri mo 'char bzhin du/ /pha la glen pa'i smyu mtshan zhib tu dris/ /des kyang la gsham zan dang la rtser sha/ /de bzhin ljang ldan zhing kha btab ma btab/ /yangs steng g.yos snod rdza ma gsar rnying sogs/ /

wā /nya gad mo shora'i/ 61dris la btab pa'i lan bcas rgyas par bsnyad/ /ji ltar bur shing so yis ldan pa bzhin/ /mnyan zhing mnyan zhing rna ba'i bcud du gyur/ /gzhon nu'i tshod bgam gtam gyi lcags kyu yis/ /lus phra ma de'i yidakyi ri dwags bzung / /yab kye mi ni a ma'i 'bras bu bzhin/ /ma smin smin 'dra smin 'ga' ma smin ltar/ /snang phyir mkhas blun dpyod pa'ang sla min pas/ /mgron de khyim du bsus nas gleng mo bya/ /zhes brjod bu mo sgo drung song / /zhe sar bcas te gzhon nu bos/ /'os pa'i stan la bkod nas kyang / /bza' btung ston mo'i rim gro 'gyed/ /de nas skyes pa'i yul dang btags pa'i ming /'dri sogs phan tshun 'dres pa phebs pa'i 0 tam/ /smra zhing yid gzhungs gzhon nu nge zung ri / /gcig i spyod pa sa gcig la sim pa bster skyi slar yang bu mos 'dzum dang bcas /mgron po la ni 'di dag bslangs/ /gang gis kho mo'i yab gcig la/ /dris pa'i tshig 'gar bdag gis dpyad/ / gal te ma ngal mgestegs par/ /la yi gsham du zan bzos na/ /

62 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/———————— de la zan gyi ro nyid las/ /med phyir zan la rol bar lga /'bad pas ri yi rtser 'dzegs te/ /ngal zhing dub la bkres pa 'i tshe/ /la rtser zan bzos zan la yang / /sha yi ro mchog ldan zhes smra/ /bdag cag khyim la gzhan gyi nor/ /bskyis pa'i bu lon yod dam med/ /gal te yod na btab parme zhing / /skyes kyang 'bras bu gzhan gyi bsdu/ /de ni ma btab pa dang mtshungs/ /0zhan la chad pa'i bun med na/ /'bras bu rang gi mdzod du bsdu/ /de lta'izhing ni btab par smra/ /khrim steng langs pa kho mo la/ /dbang ba'i bdag po yod dam med/ /rtogs slad g.yos snod sna'i yol go/ /gsar rnying zol gyis 'dri bar go/ /gang gi rig pa'i bur srang gis/ /gzhan gyi blo rig ga'al byed gtam/ /de lan bdag gis bcal ba 'di/ /dmigs pa'i tshad du son nam ci/ / zhis thos gzhon nus rang gis 'bad bya'i don sne

rdza /nya sad mo thor ba/ — 63 — la don thos smin pas sgra ldan char sprin la/ /la 'ur blta ba'i rma bya'i bu mo bzhin/ /bzhin la rab dga'i 'dzum mdangs 'phro bcas smras/ /grol bar byas so mdzes ma'i 'gram chang gi/ /bsung bas ba ku la yi me tog bzhin/ /gang gi shes rig dpyad non sor mo yis/ /bdag yid rangs pa 'i re ba'i mdud rgya yang / de sogs ched du brjod pa 'i bsngags pa snyan tshig me tos zegs ma yis / /tshangs pa'i sras kyis u ma la bzhin 'u sa phra ma der rab bstod mthar/ 7mjus tu sa bdag btsan ngo 'i 'u nga gis lto skya bos hrul zhing par yang / saser mig dgod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhes khrims dang bsdos nga 'i don de bsnyad //re 'i ga mgul pa 'khyos la 'chang / /mig mdzes cung zad gyen du phyogs snelha yi bzo bos chu shel la / brkos pa'i lha mo bzhin du mdzes/ /de nas bu mo/sa gzhin nu la/ / dpu nga pa skyes snyedang sa spyod ma'i/ /du midapal dang 'gro 'dug nyal 'chas sogs / /spyod pa'i tshul dag zhib tu dris/ /zhes ldan des kyang dri ba rnams/ /ma 'dres rim pa ma 'chol bar/ gang dang sang la de dang de'i/ /

64 ga /chab spel tshe ba na phun tshogs kyi rtsom ri brtsams chos rgyasas bsgribs — — —— la —la na kun gsal zhing ran par btab/ /zla bzhin ma des zla 'od 'gyed/ /gzhon nu kun da'i bsung mngar 'byin/ /pha sgon ngo mtshar 'dzum dang bcas/ /de zung bzhin la res kyis blta/ /nyi mo'i 'dren pa'ang mdzes ldan de zung gi/ /mtshar ba'i gtam la ring zhig yengs pa las/ /rang 'od bu mo'i brtas dpyad bsam gtan gyi/ /gesas su 'gyur snyam rings pa'i 'gros kyis gshegs/ /de tshe bu mos zas dang sgron me sogs/ /mgron ngo la 'os sri zhu lesas bsgrubs te/ /pha dang gzhin nu bde bar mnal ba'i shul/ /rang nyid gnyid bral dpos dka'i don der dpyod / /nangs pa ra nyi zer mkha' la lhasas ma thas /zhigs pa'i dro yis mgron la legs mchod nas/ /'dzum dkar 'od kyis brgyan pa'i zla tshes ma sa/ /ngon sanyer gzhon nu de la 'di skad gdam sa/ /khyod nyid rgyal po'i drung gathegs la / /sa bdas bzhed pa'i don gsol slad / /lnga sras gdusas kyi nyi rma tho' mar /bdas nyid pho brang bsko'o zhes zhus / / btsan byed sgo lcags brgya phrag lnga/ /lde mig gcig gis 'byed nus pa/ /

rdza /nya gad mo shor ba/ — 65 — —— —— —sgrubs la bya ba ma rdzogs bar/ /gsang ba'i sgo rgya nan du sdoms/ /don de 'grub na rgyal po las/ /dam pa gsum yang slong zhes gsol/ /bdas nyid dbyis ldan grong slebs dus/ /khyed kyis bcu ba ma g.yel cig /'jigs pas mnar ba'i so nam pa/ /de das myur du dbusas dbyung 'tshal/ /slad kyi tshe na yu bu cag /dmangs kyi duḥkha sel phyir 'bad/ /snyede thos sa srung bus mthong ba'i/ /rol pa'i gnas kyi chu gter bzhin/ /gzhon nu'i yid kyi lhas rtsen mar/ /rab dasa'i char srin rlabs phreng g.yo/ /mnyes gshin pa dang bu mo la/ / gus bcas dang ba'i phyi phyag 'tshal/ /rgyang grags tsam bar rgad po yis/ /skyel ma dang bcas mnyam du zhusas/ /gang de mtha' yas rgya mtsho las/ /rin chen lon pa'i don mthun nam/ /lo legs blangs pa'i zhing pa ltar/ /yid la dga' ba 'bum phrag rgyas/ /mkha' lding 'dab gcos bskyod pa yis/ /

66 ga /chabaspelatshe bcanasan mas 4kyi mjigabartsamasachosaphyogs bsgrigs/mkha' yang yud kyis gzhal ba ltar / las pa g.yulas bzhin sa 'dzin de/ /bde blag tu ri brgal bar byas/ ༈ma skul gom pa'i 'angesas 'jog gis /dbyig 'dzin dga' ma'i brang brdungs pas/ /ma gtor thal rdul mchod yon gyis/ /bzhin dang lus kun klub par brgyan/ /me shel tsha bas rab gdung pas/ /bzhin las rngul chu'i thigs phreng rgyun/ mu tis phreng thas chad pa bzhin / /'gram pa 'i thang la su mgyosas 'gran / /de ltar btsan ngo 'i chad las nyin grangs kyis/ /'ded ltar ngal 0so spangs nas rings pa ra song / /snang byed nub ri'i mal du sarims nga na/ ༈gzhon nu de yang dbyis ldan grong du brtol/ /nub der skyed mos tshal gyi sgo 'gram du/ /sna tshosas spyon pa'i 'khri rshang gseb na nyal/ /'ogs ltar mi bdag skyed tshal 'chag pa yi/ /go skabs sgug pa 'i bsama'abatan gnyid la gzhol / /nangs par skya rengs dang po'i 'od dkar gyis/ /gzhon nu myos pa'i gnyid las rab sad de / /ri bos gser gyi la thod bcings pa 'i dus/ /rgyal po nyung ngu'i 'khor bcas ltags pa mthong / /

ga /nya thod rma shor ba/ 67— gzhon nus phyas dang zhe sar bcas/ /bdag la sa bdag bzhed pa'i don/ /nyung ngu'i tshis 'ga' gsol du mchis/ /gsang ba'i gnas su gshegs nga ra gsol/ /des kyang 'khor rnams gzhan du bskrad / /skyed tshal me tog ra ba'i nang / /'khrid cing chu shel stegs ba la/ / ma ririg rang nyid 'bod nas de la dris/ gzhon nus mgrin pa gzengs bstod nas/ /shes rab can mas gdams pa 'i tshig /3 ga dang chad pa'i skyon bral ba/ /ji bzhin sa yi bdas por smras/ /mi bdag yid kyi me long la/ /ngo mtshar gzugs brnyan ci yang 'char /skyed tshal srung ba nyer bkug ste/ / sazhin nu de la rim gro 'gyed / /ched du bskos pa'i blon po yis/ /mi med bras gi gus pa ru/ /yul gyi deg cha mkhan bsdus te/ /btsan byed lnga brgya 'bad pas sgrub/ /btsun mo rnams dang blon 'bangs kyis/ /tshor bar mi rung nan tshig bsgrasas / dbang ngo 'i grangs ldan gdugs kyi mthar/ /

68 ga /chab spel tshe brtan gun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams phyogs bsgrigs/ — lag bu mo 'phrad pa'i dus kyang btab/ /gzhon nu yis kyang rang gi yul rgyasas kyi/ /so nam pa dag 'phrin gyis dbugs dbyung zhing / /skyed tshal pag na nyin zhag bgrang ba gi /ri mo sa la 'bri bzhin bu mor sgug /dus la babs tshe nu rgyas de/ /bab chags gtsang ma'i thos kyis bklubs/ /dal bu yi ni lam zhugs mthar/ /rgyal po'i pho brang nye bar 'ongs/ / snga nas lam gyi bzhi mdo ru/ / sgug pa'i gzhon nu dang 'phradade/ /phebs par smra ba'i bsu dang bcas/ /rgyal po'i skyed tshal dang du song / /nam mkha'i nor bu chu skyes la/ /phyi mig blta bzhin nub rir bzhud/ /rab rib mtshan mun yol bkres/ /skye bo'i snang byed bsgribs pa'i dus/ /skyed mos tshal gyi pho brang du/ /rab gsal sgron me'i snang ba'i thos /zhing pa'i bu dang bu mo yis/ /sa yi dbang rgyus mjal bar song /don de rtogs la rings nga 'i blos/ 'phrad ma thag du mig yangs mar/ /

neemi /nya gad mo shor ba/ 69— ———saser nya dgod pa'i rgyu ci zhes/ /tshig gi thog ma kho nar byung / /lus phra ma des 'dzum bzhin du/ /rje bo de ltar rings mi 'tshal/ /tshig tsam brjod pas don de yi/ /'phyang mo'i dra ba gcod nus min/ /don gyi sbyor ba la zhugs te/ /'dri dang bshad la ma bstos par/ /bden pa'i rgyu mtshan lo na nyid/ nangs par khyod kyis gzims par 'gyur/ /'es smras btsan byed brgya phral lnga/ /'byed byed bsi tu'i lde mis bcas /blangs te gzhon nu de dang lhan/ /re zhig rang gi gnas su song / rim bzhin srod kyipha men mas/ dzimig sman bzhun ma'i khu bzhes/ /mkha' la lan brgyar byug pa las/ /phyogs kun smag rum stug pos thibs/ /skye rgu sgong skyes nor srungame kun / /sanas khang tshang dang sgo skyibs su/ /so so ra bsod par gnyid kyis myos/ /phyosas kun sim por gnas pa'i tshe/ /

70 ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun chogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/wa wa — — gzhon nu zung de dal bus thon/ /kun nas pho brang yongs bskor ba'i/ /calnga brgya btsun mo'i khang bzang sga/ /sgo la btsan byed re res mnan / / ma 'u sa 'byed pa 'i lde mig de / rgyal po'i sngas kyi 'og tu bcug /bde bar sarims shig nyin phyi mar/ /thugs kyi the cho'ispru sol zhes sasol ༈ /nangs par srid pa 'i mig gcis kyang / /ngo mtshar ltad mode blta slad / /nor bu'i shing rta mgyogs skul te/ /dbang phyogs ri bo'i spo la 'dzesas/ /blo gros rab gsal gzhon nu des/ /g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i7yang rtse nas/ /phyogs kun g.yo ba'i rnga sgra 'gyin/ /grong khyer pa rnams cis car bsdus/ /de tshe rgyal po blon 'khor bcas/ /spyan drangs g.yas phyogs nas brtsams te / sa spyod ma yi khang bzang re'i/ /sgo rgya rim gyis phye ba las/ /srid ldan g.yem ma de kun gyis/ /la las rgyal phran la las blon/ /

༄ /nya gad sma shor ba/ chi 71——— — ——la las tshong dpon bu la sogs/ /bsrel ba'i byi bo re re thon/ /yongs su rdzogs mthar shes ldan mas/ /lha kye chur nyal dgod pa'i tshe/ /gang gi thugs su ci dgongs pa/ /dran mdzod de ni de yi rgyu/ /mas thos des kyang rang nyid kyi/ kun rtog dran bzhin rgyu mtshan rnyed/ /ngo mtshar ba dang zhe snang gnyis/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du skyes/ /rab khros bzhin ni byu ru yi/ /me rtog rjes 'gro kun nas dmar/ /khrag ltar 'khrugs pa'i sdang mig gis/ /stong phrag pho mor gzir gyis blta/ /chad pas 'jigs dang ngo tshas nongs/ / rgya la tshud pa'i ri dwags bzhin/ /de dag bred sha thon pa 'i mis rig rig phyogs su blta bar byed / /dbang dang nor gyis rgyags pa rnams/ /'dod la rab sred ngo tsha bral /tshul min spyod pa'i rul dri yis/ grong khyer pa kun tshe la sdog /de sdong la gi snang ba dang /

72 ga /chab spel tshe brtan kun sa sa kyi rtsom ris brtsams chos phyogs bsgribs/wa —— —— — 'bangs la rab skyedas sa bdag deg / lang tsho dar ldan brgya phrag bcu/ / srog dang phros ces gtum pos spyo/ / de tshe shel ldan gzhon nu'os/ /kro zhing khrel ba'i nyams dang bcas/ / lag pa g.yugs nas mi bdag la/ /risas pa min zhi sa ldoganas slar/ /gal te btsun mo re re byi ba sacig / bston la sros dang 'bral ba'i sdig yod na/ /khyod gcig kho nas lus phra brgya phrag lnga/ /bdag gir byed la chad pa ji ltar gcod/ /dgongs shisaling tsho dar ba'i g.yon nu ma/ /'di snyed khyod kyis btsan porabang gis bkas /'di dag g.yem byed nyes pa'i chad las kyang / /le lan bda' na phugs rtsa rang la 'tshar /des na kho rngo sa dam —pa sasum slong ba'i/ /dus kyang 'di nyid lags pa sa legs pa ra dpyod / /dang po 'di dag srog la mi 'bab par /rang rang bde ba'i yul la 'god pa ra 'os/ /gnyis pa 'dod mthun gzhon nu thabs shes rnams/ /'jig rten lugs bzhin rang rang khyim thabs byed/ /

—— ༄ nyagadamoshorab/ — 73gsum pa nyes can rtsa ba khyod kyis kyang / /slad nas btsun mo gcig las bston mi 'tshal/ /de ltar bsgrags la dmangs kun gyis/ /yi rangs legs po'i gad rgyangs sgrog /ma gros bsam pa gcis mthun ngang / /sazhon nu de zung spyi bor bkur/ /sa spyod des kyang rang gi tshu'ago / rigashā pa min par kun nas gas/ /gdong pa smad cing phrag pa glod/ /dam pa gsum po khas kyis 'ches/ /shes rab nus pas ri skyes dang / /mtshar sdus dpal gyis legs brjod kyang / /pham byed sa yi zla ba dag / sa skyong ral pa'i rgyan du blangs/ /'jig rten mdzes pa'i snying po mtha' das byed pos gcig tu 'du byas pa'i/ phul byung yan lag mchos ma sang de sna tshogs rgyan dang gos kyis bklubs/ /skye dgu'i bdag mo'i khri la 'dzegs mthong lha dbang mchod sbyin brgya pa yang / /mig sto nga bgrad nas de la blta zhing pu lo'i sras mor dga' ba lhod / /dmangs kyi duḥl rang i phrag pa la/ len pa'i blo ldan sa'on nu mchog nge yang / /blon po kun gyi mchog tu dbang bskur bas/ /

14 ga chab spel tshe ba na sun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyags bsgrigs/mes po saser mngal can yang cung zad 'dar/ /nge tshe sa bdag blon po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'u gas min spyad la nongs bas yid༄ga ste rgyal thabs b.la' lung sa spyod ma der phul/ /blon po'i bya ba'ang gzhon nu de la gtad / /dpyod ldan ga'on nu de zung nas/ /rigs dang rigs min rnamasar 'byed/ /'jig rten lusas kyi satsug lag gisaka /rgyal khams chen po bde bar bskyangs/ /dmangs rnams dpya dang skyes kyi bye brag 'dzad med chu yi gnyer ma dag /nyung ngur byas nas so nam gyis 'tsho zhing pa rnams la ngal gso byin/ /mchos dman bar ma'i rim pa dag kyang rgyang thas thung ngu'i sanas la bkod / /thun mong bde byed khrims kyi srol yang ma lus phan bde'i nyer 'tshor bcas/ de la rab dga'i grong khyer pa/ /kun kyang dga' mgu'i gtam gyis brel/ /yu la ljongs dar zhing bde skyid kyi /dpal la rol ces bdag gis thos/ /de skad dmangs khrod ngas gi rol mo las /'ongs pa 'i sgrung gtam tam bu ra yi sgra/ / snyan ngas pi wang sadangs dang sbyar ba 'di/ /blo gsar gzhon nu dgyes pa'i yon du spro/

mi nya gang mo shor ba/ chi 75wa wa—wa — — —'on kyang kho bo yi ge'i bang dag dang / /daṇḍi'i gzhung la sbyangs pa ches dman pas/ /ma das los rtog 'khrul bar gyur pa kun/ / rig pa'i dang 'a bo rnams kyis 'chos par mdzod/ tang gi mi risas srid jus nyin byed kyi 'od snang /dpyid dpal yongs ba'ad deng ba'i'i mdun lam la 'phro dus //spyi tshosas ring lusas rig rtsal me tog ṅga sdum rar/ /dri thim 'dab ldan sasar pa'i skyes bzang 'di 'bul lo/ /ma na 'grel/ —0)sa yi mi0 stong can/ sa'i brgya sbyin ste rgyal po'i ming /②mchod sbyin brgya pa/ lha dbang brgya sbyin gyi ming gi rnam grangs/ 2 )rnam rgyal khang bzang / brgya sbyin gyi pho brang /sku)rab snum/ snag po'am mthus po'i don /mimis mi 'dzum nya spyi'i ming la'ang /yi zang 'thung / ljon 'ing spyi/hu)gdugs/ nyi ma dang nyin zhag gi ngon/hu)zla ba'i ma ma/ rgya mtsho'i ming /tsu'iser skya'i ci la/ yi dwa0sa kyi yul/sgo)'tshal ma 'tshal zas za ba'i ngon/()gnyis 'thung glang ngo che'i ming gi snam grangs

76 ga /— spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos rgyas bsgrigs/———— — — dgo po'ilteng ma chu mig 'tshangs pa'i sras/ bram ze'i ming /yodapung pa skyes/ rgyal po'i ming lis spyod ma/ btsun mo'i ming li ga cha mkhan/ mgar ba'i ming /yipo men ma/ sha za mala' 'gro/yosgong skyes/ byarag4sbyi/ yonor srung / sbo khyi'i ming /4khubasod par/ bde bar/ 4stegayung drung 'khyil ba/ rgyal po'i pho zang /nyusred ldan g.yem ma/ chags ldan gyi smad tshong ma/⑩byi po/ gzhan gyi bud med la lo sa gnam byed pa/lipu lo'i sras mo/ brgya byin gyi btsun mo'i ming /yigaser mngal can lha tshungs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs so//

ri77—( bla zer 〉 dus deb dang po bklags pa'i tshor snang /spyi tshogs ring lugs rlabs chen mes rgyal gyi sdum rar/ /dbyibs mdangs so sor bkra ba'i mi rigs kyi me tog /rang rang rig rtsal khu dog sna tshogs su bzhad kyang / /kun gyi snying bcud gung khran ring lusas kyi ze'u 'bru/ /mkhas mang thugs kyi rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ /legs 'khrungs sdebs legs bdud rtsi'i bsil zer can/ /sngon med rtsom ris sasar pa'i zla zer 'dis/ /rang rigs skye rgu'i re 'dod ku mud ba'ad/ /khyad par gsar rtsom ga bur thilas phreng gis/ / zhing 'brog dmangs kyi blo gros chu gter rgyas/ /spyi tshogs ring lugs bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun 'bum/ /'phyur bzhin rab dga'i dbu phreng 'dzum dkar 'gyed/ /rjod byed dmangs kyi skad yis sa le sbram/ /brjod bya 'tsho ba dngos kyi mu tig phras/ /rab brgyan brtsams sgrung rin chen rgyan mang gis/ /shes ldan gzhon nu'i yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog /de mthong gangs ljongs skye bo phal/ /

78 lta chab spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgrig /wa wa wa — wa lnge'abrus sgra thos pa'i rma bya bzhin /rab dgo'i sgro gur skum por 'bub// bstod dbyangs mgrin glu sgros par nges//rgad po bdas kyang lang tsho rgyad pa yi/ rab rib mig gi gung ba kem skam du//g.yo bcas dus deb pad ma'i 'dab yangs las /legs bshad sgrang rtsi'i ro mchos ci yang myong //lta ba'i/na bsam phyin dus rabs gsar pa 'di'i//gan lho 'i mi dmangs 'tsho ba'i gzugs brnyan 'bum//mngon sum bdag yid me long nang 'phos pas//le dbar stong 'asa'i shul lam thung ngur byas//de ltar rtsom tshul gsar pa'i zla zer gyis//rnying 'e/na rgyad po'i blo mun cung zad bsal//ngo mtshar bdud rtsi'i zesas ma snying la sim//thal mo'i 'dab brgya zum bzhin tshig 'di thal//

nee79— ————spang rgyan me tog ches cher bzhad pa la bkra shis bde legs 'u/wa dmangs khrod rtsom rig dus deb (spang rgyan me tog 〉ces par phul ba'i shis tshigayongs 'dzam gling sa gzhi ril mo yi yang rtser /yul ri mtho sa gtsang gangs can gyi bod ljongs/ /sa 'di na gnas pa'i bod rigs kyi mi dmangs/ /las bya bar brtson zhing shes rig gi dpal ldan/ /thar rlung bsil ba mo'i 'tshe ba la mi skrag /lho tsha gdug nyi ma'i zer phreng la mi 'jigs/ / nub rlung 'tshul drag po'i ldang shugs la mi 'dzem/ /byang kha char bu yug 'tshub pa la mi g.yol/ /sa gang du gnas der rang byung khams 'dul bar/ /dus nam yang skyo ngal med pa yi snying stobs/ /kun yid smon 'os pa'i mi dmangs kyi gshes rgyud/ /tshul de dag spang rgyan me tog la ldan yod/ /mdzes bum pa'i kha rgyan byed sems dang mi ldan/ /dpal rgyal po'i sdum rar 'tshang 'dod kyang mi byed/ /

80 ga /chab spel tshe ba na sun tsho sa kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos rgya sa bsgrigs/——tho gzim chung shel khra'i mdzes rgyan la mi mos/ /dro shel khung nang du de bas kyang mi 'dzul/ /sa bzang nan chu lud cha rkyen la mi re /mi'i gso skyong gzhan brten 'tsho ba la mi dga'/ ༈rang stobs kyis 'tsho ba'i spang rgyan gyi me tog /tshul rdo yang ngal rtsol mi dmangs la ldan yo da / /dus yun ring mi lo stong phrag gi ring la/ yul rang byung khams dang spyi tshogs kyi 'gal bar/ /sems dpa' ngar 'bar ba'i 'thab rtsod kyi khrod du/ /rilas sna mang dmangs khrod ris rtsal 'bum bskrun yod / /rgas skra dkar can rnam sa sgrung gtam gyi bang mdzod gzhon so dkar can rnams glu gzhas kyi rgya mtsho/ /lo dar zla babs rnams gtam dpe yi gter la /blo ris 'phrul ldan rnam sa gab tshis gi mkhar rdzong / /'on gyur kyang spyi tshosas rnying pa de'i nang du/ /bod mi rigs rang gi dmangs brod kyi rig sanas/ /ngag 'chal zhes snang chung rtsa bzhin du dor bas/ /gsal ri mor 'khod pa'i thob thang tsam byung med / /dus de ring spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi nang du/ / dmangs yar langs rgyal lab bdag po ru gyur pas/ /rang dga' ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom ris dang sgyu rtsal /ci da 'a ru 'god pa'i deb ther 'di 'khrungs byung / /

rig /spa nga rgyan me tos ches cher ba'ad pa la bkra rshas bde legs mu/ 8/—la la ming snyan grags med nga 'i dmangs khrod kyi mkhas pa/ / skyes pho mo rgan gzhon thams cad kun yar bzhengs /'al pad ma'i 'dab brgya yangs po ru phye nas/ /sgyu rtsal gyi khrom thos gcod dus de shar so nga dmangs sgrung gi chu klung lhung lhung du 'bab thos dmangs 0zhas kyi mtsho rlabs lang lo nga du 'phyur cos /gtam dpe yi dpyid dpal sang sa nas ba'ad cog /0ba tshig i rnga sgra dar dir du sgrolas cog /rgyal yongs kyi spun zlar sazigs 'bul 'ig zhu dathos / /'dzam gling i khyon la 'grem spel yang bya dgos/snye bod rig pa'i mkhas par dpyad gzhi ru 'don dgos/ mi'i rigs kyi shes rig la lebs skyes shig 'bul dgos /bod dmangs khrod rig rtsal deb ther gyi spa nga ljongs/ /mdog lnga ldan spang rgyan me tog gis khengs nas / / dam ngas yongs kyi shes tshad gong mtho ru spel te/ /yid bsam pa'i dpal yon yar rgyas su gyur cis

༷/2 — —— —— —nyi gzhon bsu ba'i mtshams dzin/bar med mdun du 'phel ba spyi tshogs kyi/ /yang dag dngos po'i chos nyid gzhir bzung ba'i/ /tang gi srid jus dro skyid shar rlung gis/ /le khri'i sa mthor slar yang dpyid dpal bzhad/ /ltar langs rtsi shing me tog khri phrag brgya / /phun tshogs 'byor pa'i myu gu rgyas dang lhan/ /shes rig bsung mngar 'thul la ches rings pa'i/ /mngon 'dod re ba'i 'dzum dkar ci yang dbod/ /snga rabs mes po'i blo gros klung bzhi'i rgyun/ /'khyil ba'i mi rigs ris gnas rgya mtsho'i 'jings/ /mkhas mang rnam dpyod rlabs kyis bsrubs pa las/ /btso sbyang nying khu saser gyi zhun thigs 'bum/ /tshan rig zer dang 'grogs pa'i nyi gzhon 'di/ /bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs su 'char ba na/ / shes bya'i snang ba dkar po'i 'od rnon gyis/ /ches mtho'i bsam pa'i dpal yo na dar ba dang / / sang gi rig gzhung li khri'i 4zer brgya yis/ /shes ldan chu skyes 'bum phrag skyed bsrings te/ /rang ljongs dngos po'i dpal yon dar ba la/ /sazhal dka'i nus pa yun du spel gyur cis /
