86 ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/yin pa'i gna' rabs kyi grong khyer 'di yang skad cig yud tsam zhig la rlabs kyis 'ded par brtsams pa'i 'jigs rung gi khro nyams bstan te/ skabs de'i dbang sgyur ru tshogs kyi tshul dang mi mthun pa'i spyod ngan la tha tshig drag po yang nas yang du bsgrags pa de ni drang bden spu tsam med pa'i spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs de thal ba'i rdul du brlag rgyu'i mi dmangs kyi 'bod sgrar shugs chen gyis rgyab skyor mdzad pa dang kun nas mtshungs pa yin no/ /skyid chu sngon mo mang / 'on kyang / 5ri bo gyi ma la ya mtho yang rtse mo los yod/ chu mo yar klung gtsang po ring yang chu mjug los yod/ bod ljongs mi dmangs rnams kyi sdug bsngal che yang mtha' yod( ces pa ltar bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob rjes tang dang ma'o kru'u zhis gtong gnang mdzad pa'i cun dpung mang bco brgyad pa'i mi dmangs bu phrug dmag gis rgya ma brgya phrag lon pa'i khur po rgyab tu 'khur nas chu khri ri stong gi shul lam ring po gom pa re re bzhin gyis 'jal te chadabar khri yi sa mtho 'dzam gling gi rtse mo 'dir phebs thog dka' ngal khri dang bar chad stong sel nas bod ljongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang mnyam du dbugs lam gcig gyur dang bde sdug mnyam myong gi 'tsho ba bskyal yod/ mtho rim log spyod ru tshogs kyis ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs pa des yud tsam zhig khyed la'ang me skyogs dang me mda'i sgra yis bzhugs bzod ma bde tsam byung yod rung / dmangs dmag dpung pa mnyam gshib kyis skad cig gnyis par thal ba'i rdul du brlags pa ma zad/ lo ngo stong phrag ring mi dmangs kyi mgo bo gnon pa'i spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam lugs kyi lcags sgrog de dum bu mang por bcad nas zhing bran khri tsho brgya phrag yar langs bcings 'grol mthar phyin thob pa de ni mi dmangs tsho'i sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba drung nas phyungs shing / bde skyid kyi rtsa ba tshugs pa yin pas nga tshos dus

rdza/gye/lha 'a i chu/ 87nam yang brjed thabs sa la yod/ mi dmangs rnams spyi tshogs kyi bdag por gyur pa dang / gna' bo'i nyi 'od grong khyer 'di yang ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung gi lte gnas su gyur pa de khyed kyis gzigs dus thugs kyi khro rlabs yongs su 'i nas deng rabs can gyi chu rags chen po brgyud ya yo med par dbu ba'i 'dzum dkar chi' chil bzhad bzhin du dal bu'i ngang nas bshar mar 'bab pa 'di ni dmangs yongs bde la 'khod cing yul lung yar rgyas byung bas khyed thusas yongs su tshims pa de kun nas mngon par gyur to/ /rgya bod spun zla mi rigs mdza' brtse'i dpung pa mnyam gshibs kyis ljongs yongs su 'dzugs skrun gyi mtho rlabs 'phyur ba dang dus mtshungs gna' rabs kyi grong khyer 'di yang sngar yod las ldab bcu phrag ngasa' zhig rgya cher bskyed cing / deng rabs kyi lang chen thog rtsegs can brgya phrag du ma phyogs bzhir ke rer langs pa 'i bar gseng gzhung lam mig mang ris kyi mtha' rnams sngo ljang ljon pa'i phreng ba dang me tog gi ra bas yongs su bskor bdes gna' rabs rig gnas kyi bang mdzod pho brang po ta la dang / gtsug lag khung rnam gnyis sogs kyang sngar bas gzi mdangs rgyas pa ni ji ltar margad kyi gzhong pa'i dbus su gser gyi mchod sdong chen por khang bzang mu tig gi phreng bas kun nas brgyan pa ji lta bar mtshar sdus i 'od zer phyogs kyi tha grur dngom bzhin du mchis/mtho ris kyi gnas la skyengs pa ster ba'i grong khyer gyi lho 'khyud du chu klung chen po khyed ni g.yu 'brug rgyu ba ltar snang zhing / sngon med gsar du bskrun pa'i deng rabs can gyi ngar lcags zam chen glog sgron brgya phrag du mas spa ba de ri /pha lam dkar po'i phra tshom gyis brgyan pa'i rin chen rgyan phreng zhig khyed kyi mgul du sgron pa ji bzhin dkar gsal gyi 'od zer chem chem du 'phro bas mtshan mo'i smag rum pha mthar bskrad pas ma tshad/ nam mkha'i skar tshogs kyi 'od snang

88 ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshog kyi rtsom ri brtsam chos phyogs bsgrigs/—— wa —— zil gyis gnon pa lta bur snang /e ma skyid chu sngon mo sang / mi lo khri stong mang por bed med du lus pa'i khyed kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bab shugs des da lta glog skyed 'phrul 'khor chen po nyin mtshan bar med du bskor nas glog rgyun zam mi chad pa mkho 'don gnang ste/ bzo grwa'i 'phrul chas sna tshogs dbang med bskul nas sngar med bzo las kyi thon skyed dang / zhing las deng rabs can du bsgyur rgyur rmang gzhi 'ding ba ma zad/ grong khyer dang grong gseb mang por glog bzhu'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba 'gyed pa sogs spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs kun gyi ched du legs skyes lo re las lo rer che ba 'bul bzhin pa de yang nga tshos dga' spro'i ngang mthong byung / 'di dag thams cad ni sngon chad bod rnying pa 'i nang rang re'i mi lam du yang 'khor mi srid pa sha stag yin/ da dung khyed kyis rang lus la phangs pa med par sngar bas mang ba'i yur chen dang yur phran stong phrag gi sgo 'phar cig por phye nas sngon chad kyi sa rgod mang por chur rgyun drangs te 'bru rigs sna lnga'i zhing la dang / 'bras ldan shing gi sdum ra/ sna mang tshal zhing gi ra ba/ bgrang yas skyed mos tshal gyi sbyar lcang / ne'u gsing gi rtswa thang sogs skye dngos khri 'bum mang por brlan bsher gyi 'tsho bcud byin nas zhing 'brog si thon skyed ldab 'phar dang / bod gsar pa'i yul ljongs sngo ljang mdzes sdug can du 'gyur bar dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang nyid gting brjed kyis legs skyes 'bul sanang ba de yang nga tshos rtag tu mthong gi 'dugakye skyid chu sngon mo mang / khyed kyis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun dang / bod mi dmangs la bde skyid skrun pa'i ched du dbyar dgun ston dpyid dam/ nyin dang mtshan gyi dbye ba med par lo dang zla ba

rdza /mi ma'i ṣṭha chu/ 83——— — ————bstud nas 'bad 'thab 'di lta bu sanang ba des nga tsho bod kyi mi rigs khag i mi dmangs tshang mar dka' spyad 'bad brtson dang / grim lhod med par rtag tu nyin gcig nang bzhin 'bad 'thab byed dgos pa'i mig dpe bzang po 'ig dang skul lcag tshad med gnang ba gting zab ngang tshor gyin 'dug khyed la snga na med pa'i snying stobs dang ngar shugs de 'dra zhis gang nas byung ba yin nam tshe na/ de ni bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob rjes krung so gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid dang / spyi tshogs ring lusas kyi lam lugs bzang po lo na'i 'og tu byung ba zhis yin pa de khyed kyi lo rgyus thos nas gsal bshad gang legs shig thob byung / der brten nga tsho tshang mas sems thag rbad bcad kyis khyed la slob sbyongastos te rang so so'i sems nus gang yod spyi tshosas ring lugs kyi bod sasar 'dzugs skrun ched du legs skyes su 'bul rgyu'i dam bca' 'ardzog rgyu yin/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob pa'i dus dran 'di ri spyir btang gi dus /re/ /rngos /(1 /rngotho /11/ /15 /re/ /ste( 151dran sa ma na pa ra da ngas la ma na na rlabs na rtsa ba 'a 'gyur chen po zhig yin/ de yang mun nag nas 'od snang dang sdug bsngol nas bde skyid/ dbul phongs nas 'byor phyug rjes lus nas sngon thon bcas su bskyod pa'i 'pho 'gyur chen po'i lam tshad kyi rdo ring lo rgyus kyi deb ther chen ngo 'i nang 'od sto nga rab tu 'bar ba zhig yin/kye skyid chu sngon mo ang rang cas bi ma 'ongs pa ri de bas mdzes sdug ldan la 'od snang ches cher 'phro ba tshig yin/ ngeng sang dpyid kyi rlung sa/sa ra ltar ljongs yo ngas su grags pa'i gtam snyan de khyed kyis gsan thos e byung / bod kyi gtsang po gcig dang chu bo gnyis kyi dkyil khul du rlabs chen bsar spel gyi las sgo rgya cher 'byed pa'i 'char ga'i legs 'god zin pa nge yin

90 ga ba spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi ba rig brtsams chos cag bsgrigs/khyed ni de'i nang gi gtso che ba'i las yul zhig dang gal che ba'i sgul shugs shig yin la/ nga tsho yang dpung bskyod chen po de'i nang gi dril bsgrags dmag sde'i dpung khag cigayin/ rang cag mnyam rub kyi bya gzhag ni bsgrubs pa las bsgrub rgyu mang ba zhig dang / nga tsho thun mong gi nus shugs ni bton pa las 'don rgyu mang bar bsdad yod/ lo rgyus kyi don snying rlabs chen ldan pa'i gsar gtod kyi bya ba de ni dga' tshegs che la/ gzi brjid de bas che ba zhig los yin/ mi ring ba'i sngon du krung dbyang gi spyi khyab hru'u ci cang tse ming sku ngo ma rang ljongs su las don la gzigs zhib gnang bar phebs skabs/ gsar spel gyi las sgo chen po de'i 'char 'bod la thugs 'khur tshad med dang gal che'i mdzub ston gnang ba ma zad/ krung dbyang nas shugs che'i rgyab skyor mdzad rgyu'i zhal bzhes kyang thob pa de ni rang re'i bya gzhag de legs sgrub yong rgyu'i 'gan srung bla na med pa zhig yin/ des bod ljongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi snying stobs dang chod sems la bskul ma ha cang chen po thebs yod/mi rabs rjes mar bde skyid kun pa 'i rlabs chen bya gzhag 'di'i nang du nga tshos khyed dang mdza' brtse'i 'gran bsdur zhig bya rgyu yin/ slad dus rabs nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i lo dang po ste bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang nas lo lnga bcu 'khor ba'i dus chen gyi nyin mo der slebs dus nga tsho phan tshun gyis g.yur du za zhing / phul du byung ba'i grub 'bras la bkra shes bde legs zhus te da phan lo bzhi bcu'i ring gi byas rjes las lhag pa'i legs skyes kyi thog nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus dran de la rten 'brel zhu ba'i ched du da lta nas nga tsho tshang mas 'bad brtson cher skyed gnang dgos/

94 ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshos kyi rtsom ris brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/zhing sdod khang gu dog po de 'dra zhig yod/ thengs snga mar nga rang sgo ra'i g.yas zur gyi thos 'og der nyal khri rkang pa chag kyog rtswa thag gis bsdams pa khyar khyor zhig gi thog nyal nas tha na gnyid kyi dang du'ang sems chung byed dgos pas bag phebs po zhig ma byung / da lta gnas tshang gi bu dang bu mo rgan pa gnyis kyang phal cher gnyen sgrig byas yod tshod yin/ de ltarasnyed dus nang mi 'phar snon byung yod na nga la sgo ra'i zur gyi thog 'og der yang nyal sa rag min shod mi thub/ de bas skabs der ngo shes pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi khyim la dang mi nyung zhing / khang pa legs pas khong la gnas tshang g.yar na nyal sa skyid po zhig yong thub bsams/ yang 'gro bzhin 'gro bzhinade 'dra byas na ga la 'grig skabs der nga la 'khyer rgyu gang yang med rung ye shes dang byams pa sgrol ma gnyis nas rang nus gang yod kyis lta skyong byas byung / khong tsho'i bu rgan pa rdo rje dang bu mo pa dma gnyis kyis kyang rang la a khu zhes 'bod cing / ha cang dga' po byed kyi yod/ mi 'dris na snying nye/ khyi 'dris na dri zhim/ zer ba de bod kyi gtam dpe yin/ thengs 'dir nga la dngul tog tsam 'khyer rgyu yod pas gal te dbul po'i khyim tshang de la g.yol na phyin chad khong tshor gdong pa ston mi shes snyam/ jo mgon gnas tshang gi skor la bsam blo 'khor bas mi dmangs lam gyi 'khor lo'i 'grul bzhud zam mi 'chad pa dang / mi tshogs mthus po'i 'grim 'grul sogs la snang 'jog chen po byung med/ khong sngar gyi gnas tshang de rang la 'gro sgyur blo tham chod dus jo bo dbu skra'i gzhung lam brgyud bar skor nang slebs zin/ gtsug lag khang bi gzhung sgo'i mdun du mchod mjal zhu mkhan dang / brkyangs phyag 'bul mkhan mi tshogs kyis khengs shing / gna' rabs kyi rig rdzas dngos po'i rjes shul lha khang de'i ma dun ljongs ni sngar bas mdzes sdug brjid nyams ldan la/ gser zangs kyi rgya thabs dang / rgyal mtshan/

dzo/rjo mgon gyi dku 'ad 95geri dwags chos 'khor/ spen pad logs kyi mdzes rgyan la sogs pa rnams ni de bas 'od zer chem chem 'phro ba dang / bar skor yongs kyi skor lam ni me long gi ngos ltar snyoms pa'i deng rabs can gyi sdum nag lam bzos yod pa/sayas g.yon gyi tshong khang nang sna mang kha dog mtshar ba'i tshong zog bsgrigs pa mthod/ bar mtshams med pa 'i khrom stegs thog rgyal nang gi tshong rdzas dang /yul gyi thon dngos/ da dung khyim mtshes rgyal khab kyi tshong zog tsag cig sogs khyab gdal du sgrig gshom byas yod cing / skor ba rgyag mkhan dang / tshong zos nyo mkhan/ las don gcod mkhan sogs mi rigs lag bi mi dmangs pho mo thon ga'on 'tshang kha shig shig ngang 'gro ba dang / mi rnams kyi gdong nas 'dzum mdangs rab tu 'phro zhing / 'khor lo che chung kun kyang sgrig srol dang ldan pa'i ngang dal bus bskyod pa sogs ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po'i ngos su 'jam ngo 'i rlung gis bris pa'i gnyer phreng bar mtshams med par g.yo ba dang kun nas mtshungs par dar 'ing rgyas pa 'i rnam pa de dag re re bzhin mig lam du 'char bas jo mgon gyi sems su /969lor lha sar yong skabs kyi gnas tshul rnams dran nas lta bsdur byed dus nye ba'i dus thung zhig gi nang sana' rabs kyi grong khyer 'dir 'gyur ldog chen po 'di lta bu byung ba ni bsam yul las 'das par brten/ yid mtshor rab dga'i rba rlabs lang long du 'byur bzhin mig gnyis mchi zhag gis khengs pa dang / kha so pags pas mi 'dus pa'i 'dzum mdangs phyung ste gtsus lag khang gi sgo mdun du zhwa mo phud nas las gnyis snying sar thal mo sbyar te char chu dus su 'bab pa dang / lo phyugs ga tu lesas pa/ mi nadarang phyugs nad med pa/ dmag 'khrug dang nu ge mi yong ba sogs kyi smon lam btab/ slar yang 'a mo yar rgyan nas rang gis 'khor lo'i sna khrid de 'khyag 'khyog ri srang lam 'ga' 'i ga brgyud sngar gyi gnas tshang

༷6 ga /chab spel tshe brtanastan rtogs kyi ma rig brtsams chos phyogag bsgrigs/yod sar thar rgyag bskyod do/ /sa gnas de gar slebs dus de ji'i khang pa rnying hrul de ni snga mo 'i sa nas bsdad med par rgya khyen che ba'i thos rtseg can gyi khang pa gsar rkyang zhig brgyab yod pa dang / gcig ltar mdzesapa'i shel khra star sgrig gi mdun du me tog khog ma mang po bsgrigs nas bzhag 'dug pa las rgyal sgo'i kha phyogs kyang bsgyur zin pas rdzo mgon slar yang hon thor nas 'gro mtshams bzhag ste ke rer langs bsdad pa na 'khor lo 'then mkhan des/‘ tshong dpon lags gang du skyel dgos sam zer bar jo mgon gyis 'dzum dmul zhing / 6 khyed rang brel 'tshab ma gnang / gnam sa 'gyur ldog byung bas nga rang yang 'thom gyi 'dug ces smras nas khang zur de bskor te par tsam skyod dus rgyal sgo chen po ras dkar gyi tham bu lhab lhub tu g.yo ba zhig mthong /jo mgon gyis/ ‘ khyed rang 'dir yud tsam sgug dang / nga skad cha zhig 'dri bar 'gro'o zer nas sgo nang du 'dzul ba na yangs shing rgya che ba'i sgo ra de'i nang steng 'og phyogs bzhi nas sgo dang sge'u khung mang po gcig la bltas pa dang bzhin bsgrigs nas bsdad pa mthong bas gar 'gro 'dir 'gro med par mgo yor yor gyis phar lta tshur lta byed skabs/ thog khang shar phyogs kyi shas sgor bar 'khyams su gnag cing snum pa'i nag ji'i thog tshon rtsis spras pa'i ka ba'i bar bkag shing gdang la lag pa bzung ba'i bud med bas gro ba zhig gis/cho yi rtsis/ khyed rang a pho jo mabon lasas min nam jizhes 'bod pa thos pa sa jo mgon 'drogs nas glo bur gyen du lta skabs tas tag sanas mo byams pa sgrol ma yin pa ngo shes nas/ nga jo mthon yin/ khyed tsho'i lang pa gang du yod dam ’zhes brjod par sanas mos kha phar 'khor nas ye shes lams/ mgyosas po phebs dang zhes bos ma thag sgo gis nas gnas po ye shes thon yong thog khong gnyis 7 su mgyogs bsdur ba nang bzhin shag sgor gyi jo skas las babs te jo

ga /jo mgon gyi gnas tshang / — 97wa wa —— — —mgon gyi mdun du rgyug yong / ye shes dang jo mgon phan tshun lag pa dam por bzung nas 'tshams 'dri zhu res byas/ gnas mos ni/ dzinang la phebs nas sasungs dang /7 zhes ba da/ jo mgon gyis/ nga la sanas tshang zhis g.yar na shong ba yod dam/ dngos po phran bu zhig mis 'then 'khor lo'i nang bzhas yod( ces shod mjug ma rdzobs par ye shes kyis/ khyed ci zer/ grogs po bzang po sgo rtsar 'byor dus gnas tshang g.yar rogs zer ba rnam rtog za/byams pa sgrol ma/ khyed kyis phru gu tsho bos la grogs po'i jog khres rnams dbor cig nga gnyis nang la phebs/ji mes zer rdzo mabon gyis/ ca las mang po med/nga rang gsum gyis 'khyer thubasha zer bzhin sgo phyir thon nas 'khor lo'i nang gi dngos chas rnams khong sasum yis gang spyogs 'khyer thog bdal gla sprad de khyim nang du phyin/ jo mgon gyis lta dus khang pa'i 'dzin chas rnams gra ha cang 'grig ngo yod pa mthong / ye shes kyis cog tse'i thog phor pa dngul shan 'ig si nang du nas chang ser thing thing mar khu'i mdog lta bu zhig brgyangs yod pa de zhabs dag brgyab nas/ mgrogs por mchod chang zhus/ zer/ sanas mo byams nga sa/ 'grul pa thas ring nas phebs pas sngon la gsol ja srub ma spro po zhig bzo dgos/gzer bzhin bu mo bstan 'dzin bzang mo la gsol ja sasar pa bzos nas da lta khyer shos 〉ces mngags 'ing / gnas mos dkar yol sngo khra 'brug ris can gis gi nang bzos bzos pa'i ja srub ma gang blugs nas jo mgon la phul/ jo mgon gyis ‘ nga'i sems la grong khyer lha sar 'gyur ldos chen po 'di 'dra byung yod 'gro snyam ma byung ba gzad/ khyed tsho'i byim tshang dro mid phan sam sgyu ra ra tshogs po 'di 39bu yod 'gro snyam pa mi de bas mthong ( zhes smras par ye shes kyis/ nye ba'i dus tshod thung thung de'i nang bde skyid 'di ltar yong bsam

98 ga chab spel tshe brtan na gas gyi ma rig ba mas phyog ba gas/ wa pa nga la'ang med/ da cha tang krung dbyang gis nga tshor skyid po byed dgos gsungs pas ngas gang skyid skyid byed kyi yod( ces bshad pa'i gtam zlojug ma rdzogs par gan mo byams pa sa/ ma red tang gis nga tshor rgyug po byed dgos gsungs yod/ phyug po byung na skyid po rang shugs su yong thub(zer bar jo mthon gyis/ mde red/ gnas mos gsungs brda yag po 'duthaka ces rjod skabs yengashes kyis/ ‘ grogs po/ mo la rgyab skyor gnang rgyu med/ phyug po byung tshad skyid po yong ba'inges pa ga la yod/ nga tsho'i a ma ga tshod byug po chags pa de tsam gyis dngangs skrag je cher 'gro bas zad/ tha na mtshan mo nyal ba'i skabs su yang tshong rtsis khor brgyabaras nga yang gnyid khug tu 'jug gi mi sko 'dug de 'drar skyid rgyu gang zhig yod/ ji zer bar gnas mos/ sloskyid po ni rgyu nor la brten nas byung ba zhig yin/ nyi ma gnam la shar tshad chang kho na 'thung bsdad de gang 'tshams nas so so'i mtho bo yang bu'i yin min mi shes pa de 'drar skyid po sas zer chang 'thang bar yang nas dbos/ nas nyo bar yang dmi — rig dngul dgos pa ma red dam( mes brjodanas khong gnyis kyi rtsod gzhi rno ngar du 'gro ba mthong bas jo mgon gyis/ 4ha ha/ hata/ zhes gad mo dbod bzhin du/ yag po 'dug yag po 'dug gang ltar da mdabul phongs la'ang skyidango dang rgyug po'i gtam gleng byed rgyu byung ba de rang yag po 'dug ces rjod skabs bstan 'dzin bzang mos 'og nyir g.yu rtsi'od mdangs 'phro ba 'is khyer nas jo mgon gyi ja dkar nang ja srub ma thug pa dang bzhin zhig blugs pa dang / gnas mo ni thab tshang dwa mgron bor gne len zhu ba'i gsol tshigs gra sgrig byed par phyin/ ye shes dang jo mgon gnyis ma 'phrad par mi lo bcu gcig song ring pan tshun khyim tshang so so'i skyid ga dang 'gyur ba byung tshul sogs brgya bshad stong bshad kyi gtam gleng rdzogs rgyu med pa zhig byas nas

rirdza/dzo ma na gyi sanas tshang / 9 9bsnad/ nyi ma nub rir ma bzhud tsam gis la rkang 'khor gyi thing sgra sgrol pa dang bcas sgo ra'i nang bu rgan pa rdo rje dang bu mo sgon pa padma gnyis snga rting 'dzar 'dzar du 'byor zhing / mnyam du khyim nang yong / jo mgon gyis lta dus khong sanyis ka ni gzugs byad legs la lang tsho dar bas dngos 'brel mthong ba tsam gyis yid dbang 'phrog pa'i pho sazhon mo sa'on kun gyi dpe tshad du brtsis chog pa lta bu zhig chags yod/ gnyis gas glo bur du bcos ma ma yin pa 'i dga' 'dzum lhugawar grol bzhin du/ a khu jo mthon lags phebs 'dugaphebs lam la 'o brgyal ma byung ngams zhes lag pa ya re nas bzung zhing mi glod par rang nyid kyi a khu ngo ma dngos su 'phrad pa lta bu'i dka' zhin byed/jo mthon gyis kyang yun ring kha bral ba'i so so'i bu dang bu mo thug pa ji bzhin byams skyong ngang 'tshams lan 'jal zhing / khong tsho'i las khungs dang las ku'i gnas tshul sogs 'dri bshad byas pa'i mjug tu khong gnyis kyi mgo nas rkang pa'i bar slar yang zhib lta byas thog blo yid tshims pa'i mgo bo smyos lcog byed bzhin par/ bu phrus bzang po khyed gnyis chung dus nas yag po yo nga rgyu'i bzo lta yod/ nga pha yul du sdod dus kyang khyed gnyis kyis 'di gar nga la 'ogs ltar ja dang rtsam pa bskyal yong ba de yang yang sems la 'khor gyi 'dug da ri rtso rje mi dmangs kyi dge chan zhig chags pa dang / bu mo padma lag rtsal gyi bzo mo gcig tu gyur pa des nga yang dasa' spro chen po byung ༈ zhes bshad/ de nas gnas mo'i rogs pa phru gu gnyis kyis byas te gro zhib dkar ngo 'i tha mos mog tha spas chen po byur khengs dang / mar brgyab nas srub pa'i rus thang gar po dkar yol rda dban sang re/ da dung grang tshal sder ma gnyis dang su pan/kho'o tse cha 'grig cha tshang bcas bshamasanas jo mthon la sne len zhus bu rdo rjes a rag legs pa shel dam gcig la phye nas dkar yol gyi pi tsi cha gcig

100 gan /chab spel tshe brtan gun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs ba gas/ —'khyer yong ste pa pha dang jo mgon so so'i mdun du btsugs nas a rag blugs/nang mi rgan gzhon tshang mas/ a pho mchod dang / a khu ba'es/ zer bzhin gsol tshigs dngaskurarag re mos kyis btegs/ tshang ma dga' dga' spro smo'i gtam gleng byas nas sdod skabs gnas mo byams pa sgrol mas/ 4ma pho jo mgon lags/ khyed kyis tshong zog ga re bsnams yod dam/ mar yag po de 'dra e yod zer bar jo mgon gyis/ nga pha yul nas rlangs 'khor la bsdad de khren tur bskyod pa dang de nas lanam gru brgyud nas 'ongs pa yin pas za mar ma gtogs mar 'tshong rgyu 'khyer medaṇa ces bshad/ gnas mos/ 4byas na khren tu nas rgya zog gang 'dra bsnams yod/ zer bar jo mabon gyis1 tshong zos gang yang khyer med/ dus bab yag tu song bas lha sar nga ni rdzo bo rin po che mjal ba dang bar skabs bad khrag gi nad gzhi ldang bas bod sman zhig bsten pa ra yong ba yin/7 zhes lan brgyab mtshams ye shes kyis 0nas mor bltas nas/ smyo kha rog sdod/ khu tshang ma khe bzang bza' rgyu'i bsam blo kho na las 'khor rgyu med pa de 'dra ga nas yin/ khong mchod chang bzhes nas skyid po byas bzhugs su chug ces bshad 'phral gnas mo ngar langs te/ los yin/ go rgyu tshor rgyu med pa'i mi re zung chang btungs nas nyi ma skyel bsam pa las de min gnam 'og gi mi tshang ma khe bzang bza' rgyur bsam blo gtong gi yod/ zer bar bu rdo rjes 0da mo dgod bzhin pa ra da yang pa ma gnyis kyi skyid po dang phyug po'i skor gyis gsung rtsod de tshugs song / sa khu jo ma na lags da res khyed phebs thog 'dir nga tsho'i khyim tshang nang lta stangs mi 'dra ba'i gnad don kha shas yod pa de das gcig gyur bzo rgyu'i re ba yod/ ngas gre ba 'dzer 'dzer gsal bshad zhus kyang pa ma gnyis gas cha 'jos gnang gi mi 'dus ces bsgod pa na ye shes kyis/ chi a pho lha sar grogs po thug nas skyid ngo gnang bar

dzo /rjo ma na gyi gnas tshang / zi 101wa — ————phebs pa ma 0togs rna cog tsha ba'i rnyog dra saman par phebs pa min /0yugs shog rtsod pa mgo gzhag ga'ag brgyab na'ang chog pa 'dus khyed tshor rig gzhung chu tshadayod rung pha ma gcun pa'i bab thob med zer/ de thos ma thag byams pas kyangaka de ga red/ shod stangs nge gcis pu'i thog la nga 'dod pa mthun song zhes ba'ad mtshams jo mgon gyis khyed sanyis de 'dra gsungs mi rung / sdo rjes bshad pa nge ma 'grig pa gang yod/ nga tsho rim bzhin bsam blo brje res gnang chogadi ces bshad par bu rtso rje ni gad mo tsheg ger bsdad nas cang mi smra/ sa srib pa'i skabs gnas mos a tsi 'jigs med lo de ring yang slebs ma byung sha zer nas langs grabs byed skabs rdo rjes/mu ngas btsal yong ( zhes phyir thon te sung la ma mang po brgyud nas brtsad bcad kyang ma rnyed par phyir log yong ba las 'jigs med ni da dung log med /a mas kho ngas 'chun pa mi 'dug deng sang sung la ma gyi 'khyam po sha stas dang mnyam du 'gro gi 'dug naces sems khral byas/ bu mo pad mas sems gso gtong ba las bya thabs bral/ gnas mo byams pa ri tshong zos tshur nyo'i bya ba med na nyin lta ra bar smor nang khrom bton nas nyi ma ma bzhung tsam la ba'i nas phyir los pa dang / bu mo bstan 'dzin bzang mos me gtong chu len sogs khyim las rnams byed pa ma zad/ a ma kha las za ring khrom du bsdad nas tshong gnyer byed kyi yod/ pha ye shes ni skabs re phyi la chang 'thung bar 'gro ba dang sgyumang che ba khyim nang bsdad de 'ogs pa nas chang lo na 'thung bzhin sdod pa las lto yang mi za/ phru gu rgan pa gnyis ri rtas pa ra las lungs so sor 'gro/ jo mgon ri zhogs pa jo mjal zhu ba dang nyin mo bar skor la phyin nas khrom rar lta zhib byed kyin rngo da/ nyin ltar long gis dga' spro skye 'os pa'i sna nga tshul grangs med mthong ba ma zad/ the tshom za ling rang la rang gis dri lan 'debs ci

102 ga /chab spel tshe ba na sun kyi rtsom rig brtsams sna phyogs bsgrigs/wa wa wa mi thub pa'i gnad don sna tshogs shig kyang 'phrad kyi yod/ spyir na khrom ra 'khrug cing tshong zog sna mang gun sum tshogs pa dang / mang tshogs tshos lugs mthun chos kyi byed sgo rang mos ltar byas chog pa/ gzhisastes skye bo tshang ma'i sems kyi dga' snang de gdong gi 'dzum ris nas mthong thub pa/ lhag par zhing 'brog mi dmangs tshos rang rang gis thon skyed byas pa'i yul zog btsongs te dgos mkho yod pa'i dngos po rnams rang 'dod ltar nyo thub pa sogs mthong bas dga' spro tshad med skyes/ 'on kyang rgyal nang gi thon zog mang po zhig la kher rkyang tshong pas rgyal gnyer tshong khang gi gtan 'bebs rin gong las ldab 'phar gyi khe bzang za ba mang dag cig mthong dus/ 'di 'dra rang byas na mang tshogs la phog mi 'os pa'i gyong gun chen po phog gi 'dug snyam pa 'char/ lhag par du mi tshogs stug pos bskor ba'i khrod na/ lag ris lta mkhan/ zer bas mi mang po'i lag par bltas nas/ khyod kyi tshe ring thung dang / bsod nams che chung / don grub dang mi 'grub sogs shod cing / dngul mang po bsdu ba mthong /jo mgon gyis yud tsam bltas nas sdod skabs mi tshogs de'i khrod nas khong gi ngo shes rnam rgyal zer ba zhig yod pa de phyir thon byung zhing / khong gnyis mnyam du bar skor la 'gro bzhin par jo mgon gyis/ lag ris lta mkhan zer ba 'di 'drar cha 'jog e yod/ga ces dris pas khos mgo dkrugs nas/ skyag rdzun sang sang red/ kha nyin nga tsho'i grong pas 'ur gzhog bslangs nas ngas kyang dngul sgor gcig pad de lag ris lta 'jug skabs khos/ khyed rang lo bdun cu don sum 'tsho ba ngas khas blangs chog zer bas/ dang thog nga yang dga' sob sob cig byung / bsam blo gtong bzhin du de 'dra nges gtan ye yin snyam nas de ring yang bskyar ngas dngul sgor zur 0nyis bskyal te lag ris bstan zhing / nga lo sa tshod sdod pa 'dug ces dris par/ khyod lo lnga bcu nga

rdza/jo mthon gyi gan tshang / chi 103——— la wa gnyis sdod thub zer byung / nga'i lag salas pa ni 'di rang yin/ lta mkhan ni kho rang red/ khungs lung spu tsam mi 'dug / ces zer bar jo mgon gyis/ khos 'di 'dra byas nas dngul mang po ga tshod 'phrog ṣka med dam/galab skabs rnam rgyal gyis/ nyin rer kho la dngul sgor bdun cu brgyad cu tsam 'bab kyi yod skad 'dug zer/ de bzhin skabs re/ 'das log yin zhes mi shod rgu shod byas te 'bul ba len mkhan dang / blas rdzun ma/ mo ma rdzun ma sosas 'dra min sna tshogs kyis lung brtag byed khul gyis mi gzhan la chos lusas kyi rim gro 'di dang de byed dgos zhe sa skul 'ded gtong malan yod pa dang /da dung ya mtshan pa zhig la de snga bod nas 'bri chu shar rgyud du bros yong ba'i jo mgon gyis mthong myong yod pa'i mi 'khyam zhig yod pa des sham thabs dmar po dkris pa'i thog stod thung ser po zhig gyon te sang sar brgyugs nas mi la dbang ster ba dang srung mdud byin nas bla ma yin khul byed par brten/ mi khag gcig gis kho pa khyim du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur dang skyabs rten 'bul ba sogs mthong dus jo mgon gyi sems nang tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus ni gsal thag chodayin na'ang / mi re zung gis srid jus lhug gtong gi go skabs dang bstun nas spyi tshogs rnying pa'i bshu gzhos gtong thabs lag gcis slar yang bed spyad de mang tshogs kyi bsam blo dkrug pa dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dang thon skyed gang cir gnod pa'i shusas rkyen ngan pa mi sko nyung ba zhig thon gyi 'dug snyam yang bya thabs dang shod thabs ma rnyed par rang gi gnas tshang du log yong gi yod/nyin zhig gnas tshang du khong tsho phyi dro'i lto chas za skabs rgyab phyogs kyi sge khung 'ol nas bud med cig gis/ a mkhyams pa lags( zhes 'bod pa thos 'phral gnas mos langs nas bltas shing / khong gnyis mig dir dir gyi

/04 gagi /chab spel tshe ba na surna tshogs kyi rtsom ris brtsams chos casas bsgrigs/ —skad cha gang 'tsham zhig bshad na rjes sanas mo 'dzum dmul dmul ngang tshur yong bar ye shes kyis/ su redadam/ ci zer( zhis dri skabs byams pas/ a cas tshe chos red/ rlangs 'khor gtong mkhan zhig khren tu nas 'byor pas dkar yol che chung do po 0nyis khyer 'dug pa mnyam du ldeb nyo e byed zer byung /deng sang da ra yol de gras dkon po 'dug tshang mas hab thob rgyag nges red /da lta nga la dngul mang po rang med pas bu jo rje yong na g.yar thabs blta rgyu yin zer/ ye shes kyis/ dngul med na khral 'gel mkhan med pas ma nyos na 'grig ces bshad par gnas mos/ jus gtogs mi dbos zer/jo mgon gyi sems la dngul ngas g.yar na 'grig kyang pha bu gnyis kyi blo la e 'bab mi shes snyam nas snang med kyi tshul du bsdad/ dgong dro bu rdo rje khyim gyi sgor 'dzul ma thag a mas/ rdo rje/ da res khyod kyis nga la dngul sgor nyis brgya tsam zhig g.yar thabs byed rogs/ nyin bcu nas ma 'gyangs par skyin pa sprad chog 3ces brjod de dkar yol do po gnyis a cag tshe chos dang mnyam du sdeb nyo byas nas tshong rgyag rgyu'i skor bshad/ rdo rje'i blo la ma babs kyang a mas nan bshad byed pas yud tsam bsam blo zhig btang nas/ pham ma lags/tang bis grong mi tshong pa nyi tshe ba tshor gzhung bral mi dgos par 'tshong las tsag cig gnyer chog pa'i lhug gtong srid jus kyi dgongs don rnams khyed kyis gsal po mkhyen song ngam( zhis dris pa ra a mas/ los shes/ tshong bsgrub nas phyug po chags pa byed rgyu de yin zer/ rdo rjes phyug po chags pa bya rgyu ni gtso bo thon skyed gong 'phel gtong dgos pa las khe bzang kho na bza' rgyu de ga la yin/ nga tsho spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lusas nang 'tsho ba skyel gyin yod pas phyug po chags pa byed rgyu de yang lugs dang mthun pa zhig nges par byed dgos pa'i rtsa don gal chen po de bsnyel rgyu med( ces lab par a mas mgo smyog

ge sha /jomagonagyi 0nas tshang / 105 lcog byed ba'in du red tshang ma ha go song / zer/ rtso rjes/ rlangs 'alor la lo pas rgyal khab kyi snum gron btang nas smer gyi tshong zog dpor ba de yang lugs dang mi mthun pa is yin rung da cha lha sar 'byor zin pas gang ltar khe ba'i lag pa 'grim rgyu yin stabs nga tshos nyos nas rin song gzhan las khe ba zhig la 'tshong dgos/ da res thengs gcis ngas dngul g.yar thabs byas chos ces khas blangs pa dang / de so ma thag don der jus gtogs gang yang mi byed pa'i jo mthon gyis yar langs te gcin pa gtong bar song / rdo skas 'os tu cung zad sgug pa na bu sdo rje mar babs yong bas jo mgon gyis rang i am phrag nang gi sked dkris rko ba'i dngul khug pa ṭa can de la phye nas mi dmangs shog sgor nyis brgya tham pa bton te/ gdangul 'di na yong ces rdo rje la sprad/ sdo rjes/ thusas rje che/ nyin shas la sa ma 'gyangs pa ra skyin tshab 'bul gyi yin/ zhes dngul blangs/ jo mason yar los nas yud tsam song rjes rdo rje yo nga zhing / a ma la dngul sprad pas a mas dga' mgu yi rangs kyis blangs/skabs der nyi ma nub rir bzhud kyang gnas mos lam seng rgyus phyin te tshe chos dang mnyam du da ra yol do po gnyis de sdeb sto byas/ sa nga nyin gyi tsha cing khar bstan 'dzin bzang mo bar skor khrom sar phyin te a ma sto chas bza' bar 'bod du 'gro sabs a mas/ lasar du nyos pa'i rda dban cha rer sgor gsum re dang ja dkar cha rer sgo ra bzhi re nas bcog rgyu med/ ces mngasas par bu mos skad chung ngus/ rda dban cha rer ma gnas sgor gcig dang ja dkar cha rer sgo gcis dang sgor zur bzhi las sprad med par de 'dra blangs na gcen po khong bro za gi ma med dmas zhes shod skabs a mas zur tshig tu khrid nas/6 lkugs ma kha tshums/ byim tshang la bsam blo gtong mkhan nga ma gtosas med /ngas zer ba de byas na 'grig mi ces mis log lta ba'in du song / tshul de das

/06 ga /chab spel tshe brtan kun tshams kyi rtsom ris ba mas chos phyogs bsgrims la la —bu mo chung bas gcen mo pad mar bsod pas pad ma'i sems kyang blong blong por gyur/ de nub rdo rjes gcung mo pad ma gdong nag cig gor bsdad pa mthong bas ya mtshan skyes/ khong ni gso gshis bzang spyod gtsang gi gung gzhon tshogs mi zhig yin pas rgyu mtshan med par rnam 'gyur de lta bu ston mi srid snyam/ rdo rjes/ padma 'dir shog dang / zhes rang gi nyal khang du khrid nas skad cha shod res byas/ pad mas/ yod res dkar yol gyi thog nas a mas khe bzang sgor mo brgya phrag lhag tsam za rtsis 'dug da dung dkar yol khag gcig zhing khul dang 'brog khul la 'bru dang mar brje rgyur bskur ba rtsis na khe 'bab des kyang mi tshad/ gcen pos ma rtsa g.yar thabs byas pa de yang 'grig ye 'dug gzhi rkang pa pas thub tshod kyi las ga'ang mi byed par chang kho na btungs nas sdod pa dang khyim gyi dngul dngos gtor brlag gtong ba sogs la bltas na ma mar yang dngos gnas khag mi 'dug des rkyen pas bstan 'dzin bzang mo yang slob 'bring dma' rim thon nas khyim las dang tshong las tsag cig gi dang 'tshud de shes yod slob sbyong gi go skabs shor ba bcas rang khyim gyi gnas tshul 'di dag ni deng bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun la phan pa gang yang mi 'dug 'on kyang mizhes mig chu lhung lhung 'bab bzhin mu mthud nas skad cha shod mi thub pa mthong bas rdo rjes pad ma'i phrag par cag cag byas nas/ gcung mo lags/ khyed kyis de ltar bsam pa ni yongs su 'grig pa zhig yin/de'i thad nga la'ang sems khur chen po yod/ da res tshong rtsa g.yar thabs byas pa de ma 'os pas ngas khyed la skyon zhib bya rgyu yin/ spyi tshogs ni khyim tshang re re byas nas grub pa zhig yin pas rang khyim gyi don gnad thag gcod 'os shing 'tshams pa zhig bya rgyu 'di yang spyi tshogs hril po dang deng bzhi 'dzugs skrun la 'brel ba yod pa zhig los yin/ nga tshos sngon la kha tsha dgos gtugs su bsgrub

ga /rjo mgon gyi gan tshang / /07———— la — dgos pa'i bya ba 'i bu 'jigs med 'khyam ngo 'i spyod ngan las myur skyob bya rgyu de yin/ gnad don gzhan dag rnams rim bzhin so gsedabyas chol ces brjod de gros mol sazab nan byas mthar khong gnyis gas thog mar 'jigs med kyi gnas tshul brtsad zhib bya rgyu'i bkod sgrig dang las bsos byas so/ /nyin zhes brtsad zhib byas pa brgyud 'jigs med kyi sanas bab ni nyen tshabs che tsam chags yod pa shes/ dang thos kho la a mas ha cang gces gces byas pa dang pa pas kyang tsha gcun gang yang ma byas/ slob grwa'i nang zing 'tshub lo na slong mkhan gyi phru gu dang mnyam du 'dres nas yun ring song rkyen kho'i spyod pa je gyong du gyur/ kho slob 'bring dma' rim thon nas mtho rim slob 'bring nang btang rung / mi ba'i shos kha'i dug rgyun phog pa'i slob ma nyung shas dang mnyam du gang sar 'khyams shing phyog 'dzin grwa'i dge thon krang lasam kyis khyim bdag la 'brel ba yang yang byed pa dang / kho pa gang sar btsal te slob grwar khrid nas ngang ring gis slob gso thengs mang byas kyang khos 0 la nyan/pha ma gnyis kyis gzhogs 'degs yag po ma byung bas mthar kho pa snga lo slob grwa dang kha bral te spyi tshogs thog 'khyam nyul byas nas bsdad/ da cha kho'i bzo lta ni skra lo ring po dpung pa'i bar du bzhas amar rtog dra bshad nas nyo sgrub byed du bcug pa'i sos thung ser khra dung chen kha zhig dang / stod thung ljang khra spre'u'i shubs lta bu sked pa nyag nyag cig rgyan nas sacus ril shig shig gis 'gro zhing / ha lam rang nyid krung go'i mi zhis min snyam pa red/ dbyar dus gling kha'i nang du nyin mtshan skyel ba dang / dgun dpyid ja lang dang za khang du nyul zhing / mtshan mo ni bar skor ram yang na snum nag lam chen 'gram gyi glog bzhu'i 'od snang 'og bzo lta so so dang 'dra ba'i 'khyam po 'ga' zhig mnyam du 'dzoms nas par 'gro tshur 'ong byed mkhan bu mo gzhon nu tshor brnyas bacho

108 ga /chab spel tshe ba na sun tsho sa gyi ma ris brtsams chos zugs bsgrigs/wa wa —— —— bzung 'ded byed pa dang / ma rtsa ring lusas 'jig rten gyi 'chal pho dang smad 'tshong ma'i skyug bro ba'i 'bas blo'i lad mo 'khrab nas mi rnams zhe mer dang bsun snang skye ru 'jug pa ma zad/ don dam du brku 'phrog dang log g.yem gyi go skabs 'tshol gyin yod/ 'jigs med bslu brid byed mkhan gyi khram pa de tsho ni lo bcu'i ring gi dus zing nang du rdung gcog 'phrog gsum byas te rgyas za rgyas 'thung dang gzhung sger gyi rgyu rnar bar bzos rku rgyag nas skyid po rgyasas pa byed malan de tsho'i gras yin/ kho pa tshos da lta'i brtan snying mthun sgril gyidus bab bzang ngo 'dir snying khong rus pa'i gting nas mi 'dod pa byed cing / phu dkrug mda' dkrug byasanas spyi tshogs thos zing cha zhis slong thub na ci ma rung snyam pa byed/ der brten mi de tshos gang sar 'khyams nas chang rag tshad med 'thung ba dang / rgyan yod kyi sho spas rgyag pa/ bud med la brnyas bcos byed pa rku ma brku ba/ yig skyur sbyar 'grem/ dkros gtam 'grem spel sosas sdug rigs nyes tshad tshang ma byed kyin yod/ phyi tshul du chang 'thung zhing pho mo cha sgrig gi zhabs bro rgyag nga sogs rul sungs kyi brid thabs de dag bed spyad nas skyid 'dod lang shor gyi gzhon nu pho mo rnams rim bzhin khram pa'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi phyogs su 'then nas sbyi tshoms kyi sgrig srol dkrus pa dang / khrims 'gal nyes spyod kyi nang gzhug tu 'jug gi yod/ kho tshos 'jigs med la'ang dang thog kha bslus rgyas stangs dang / nang mir mgo smor gtong lugs/ dngul dngos brku 'khyer byed stangs sogs gom pa rim bgrod kyis ngan slob byas te kho pa'i gshis spyod zla re bzhin je ngan du 'gyur du bcug nyin zhig khrim pa'i 'go gtso sna ring zer ba des 'jigs med la ba da don/ 5deng sang lha sar gnam yig babs nas lo gsum gyi nang tshud mi tshang ma thi 'gro rgyu red/ bskal pa stong ba'i dus la slebs yod/ zer ba de tshor mi mang pos yid ches dang skrag snang

— rna /jomathodakyi sanas tshang / ri /ldobyed kyin yod/ mi rnams kyi bsam blo zang zing dang phugs bsam med pa jig bzo rgyu 'di ni nga tsho'i las nar phan thogs chen po yod/ khyod kyi pha ma gnyis la'ang don detsho bshad nas dngul dang dngos po mang tsam rag pa bya rgyu de sgrub 'os pa zhig ma red dmas zhes ngan bslab brgyab pa red/ 'jigs med kho ni nyin gsum bzhi nas khyim la thengs re tsam las 'khor gyi med/ yong ba'i skabs su pha ye shes kyi chang phor la hab thob rgyag pa dang / a mar dngul dang dngos po 'di dang de dgos tshes rnyog dra bshad nas gang thob de 'khyer gyis 'ja' yal ba ltar 'gro/ jo mabon gyis 'jigs med thog ma mthong ba'i nyin der phyi rgyal gyi mi zhig slebs byung snyam pa'i mur sanas mos bu 'jisas med /yar shog zer ba de thos pas jo mgon hang sang nas la mis hu rir sadangs te kho'i mtho mjug yongs la bltas nas mgo dkrug dkrug byed/ lo'i rnam 'gyur mthong ba tsam gyis jo mgon kha grags 'dod med par gyur kyang pha ma gnyis kyi brtse dung zab mo yod pa tshor bas kho la/ 6 bu spyod lam khyad mtshar po 'di 'dra byed mi rung pa 'es sems bzang gi kha ta mang po byas na yang khos sna shud brgyab nas/ lha khyed byang thang gi mis deng rabs kyi gzhin nu'i bsam blo dang 'tsho ba'i bde skyid rtolas mi thub/ ngas kyang khams skad rab bee rob be nge 'dra bo/ gi med/ zer zhing rkang pa gcig thog gcig bskyal nas shang gang gi gzhas gdangs bcug pa'i shu glu len bzhin rkang mabo dkrus dkrug dang khrel dgod shig shig byed/ a mas mig chu gtong ba'in ngu ma lab kyi 'u thug pa'i bslab bya mang po brgyab mthar/ pyid cha khyod rang btson khang la slebs rgyu gcig dang / pha ma rlung nad kyis shi 'jug pa zhig bzo ba 'dus ces zer/ pa phas ni/ sayugs zhog mi nyan pa la kha ta byed pa las/ lko ba skam po lag pas mnyed na dga'/ zer bas g.yugs zhog ces bshad par 'os gad mo bgad

110 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshog kyi marigab masacho rda rgyas bsgrig /nas/ 5pa ma gnyis kyis go yod shag red/ deng sang lha sar mi tshos sems 'khur dang bsam blo gtong sa ni/ gnam yig babs pa'i dbongs don de ma gtogs rgyun gtan gyi skad cha de rigs la do snang chen po byed mkhan med/nga khrims khang la 'gro long dang khyed tsho rlung nad kyis 'chi long zhig yong ba mi 'dug ces bshad/ a mas skad cha de rgo ma thag mig chu phyis nas/ kha nyin khrom la gnam yig babs pa'i skad cha dar dir zhig go yang zhib cha shes ma byung / de 'dra dngos gnas e yin( zer/ pa pas kyang / slongs chang khang nang snga sa nas go byung / der brten dka' ngal brgyab nagaci yong / nyin gcig skyid po byung rung khe bzang yin snyam/ chang mang tsam 'thung don yang de yin/ zhib phra'i nang don gang 'dra 'dug gam( zhes dris par 'jigs med kyis sna ring khos bslabs pa ltar/ gnam yig zer ba'i log spyod kyi yig bskyur de'i nang don zhib cing rgyas par bshad/ ma ma ni nyan bzhin nyan bzhin dngangs skrag je cher skye ba de mthong dus khos kyang de bas gdug cab dang bden pa yin lugs kyi dkrog gtam khag gcig bzos nas kha snon brgyab/pa pha ni gdong nag lhug ger mgo 'thoms pa bcas kyi go skabs de bzung ste 'jigs med kyis/ slod cha 'di 'dra'i dus la slebs dus kyang pha ma gnyis kyis nga la gshe gshe btang na phyin chad 'gyod ba skyoba'i rgyu las med/ bar skabs ngas sgor gyidage rgan bsten nas lag rtsal kha shas bslabs pa yin/ zhar nor za khang la phyin nas dngul bun khag gcig bzos pas/ de dag ma 'jal na tshe phyi ma khag po yong nges red/ da res a mas dngul gang thon zhig sprod rogs/ ngas bu lon 'jal nas da cha 'jig rten spyi la chag sgo yong nye ba'i skabs 'dir pha ma gnyis kyi sar 'bral med bsdad de shi na mnyam shi zhig byed bsam gyi 'dug ces smras shing / rang nyid kyang sems sdug yod khul byas/ ma

ga wo mgon gyi g.yol mong / chi //— wa wa wa— — — —ma ni par tsam tshur tsam phyin nas las 4 thal mo sbyar te/ dkon mchog mkhyen( zhes yang yang 'bod/ pa pha yang shugs ring nar nar 'byin bzhin chang phor ba stud nas 'thung bzhin mno bsam gtong / jo mgon ni gnas lugs bshad na khos kha rtsod lag 'dzing byed thag chod red snyam ste tshams pa ra zhig grog gin bsdad nas cang mi smra/ skabs der ma mas brel brel 'tshub 'tshub ngang cha sgam bsngosas nas dngul sgor lnga bcu bton te 'jigs med la sprad nas/ dngul 'di gi a mas lus sems gnyis ngal gyi dka' sdus spyad pa'i thul nag sos 'tshos yod/ 'onashāming khyod pha ma'i pang du log rgyu'i bsam blo 'khor ba de rang la bltas na phangs semasamed/ bu rang mgyogs po phyin nas bu lon rnams 'jal te lam seng a ma'i nang la log shog ngas khyod bsgugs nas sdod rgyu yin/ pha ma bu phrug tshang 'dzoms byung na spyi'i god chas ni 'dzam bu gling gis 'khur dgos pas bya thabs ci yod bzer/ des na 'jigs med kyis dngul lor grangs ka brgyab nas stod gos kyi khug mar blugs/ rnam 'gyur la bltas na da dung nyung drags pa lta bu zhig byas te kho rang bi de snga'i gyon chas re bzung yang mnyam du khyer nas phyir thon no/ /kho song ba dang gnas pho ye shes kyis/ 5jo mgon la gas/ khyed kyis gzigs na/ gnam yig de sang 'dra yin nam/ga zer bar jo mgon gyis tshags par klog mtshams de par bzhag nas mgo dkrug dkrug byed bzhin par/ rung ni yid ches med/ de lta bu'i gnas lugs yong ga la srid/ nga de snga grwa pa byas pa sa chos lugs kyi dpe cha 'ga' shas lta myong / sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab nang du/ sanam yig de 'dra yong tshul rtsa ba nasagasungs med/ dngos 'brel chos lusas mkhyen mkhan gyi bla ma dang dge bshes sogs su zhig la bka' 'dri zhus kyang de ma bin yin pa gsal bzad gnang bi red/ khyed 0nyis kyis dran gso zhig gnang dang / bod

112 ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshog kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/zhi bas bcings 'grol thob rgyu'i snga nub ste rang re lo nyi shu yas mas la son pa'i skabs su rirgya nag ri bo rtse lngar/ gnam yig babs pa de dge slo nga bsod nams rin chen gyis bshus nas bkram pa yin zer ba 0cig shing par du brkos nas bod ljongs stod smad gang sar khyab ma song ngam/ de dus nga rang yang lo chung stabs skrag snang che tsam byung bas dpe cha de yang yang klog ba yin/der brten 'jigs med kyis bshad pa'i/ gnam yig zer ba'i dang don mang po zhig de nas bshus pa lham mer dran gyi 'dug 'on kyang de rjes bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas rang ljongs kyi rnam par yar rgyas byung zhing / bod kyi mi 'bor yang mngon gsal dod pos 'phar snon chen po byung ba las/ bza' rgyu yod la za mkhan med/ zer ba sogs dus ngan dang ltas ngan 'di dang de yong zhes bshad pa de tsho 'ja' ltar yal nas mi cho'i bzhad gad kyi yul du gyur pa de ni bod mi rgan rabs tshang mas mig mthong lag zin gyi don dngos shig ma yin nam( zhes mas par gnas pho ye shes gnyid sad pa ltar gyur nas rang gi dpral bar thal lcag cig gzhus thog tag tag med/ dngos 'brel de rang yin/ mun 'thom nga lta bu 'di 'dra byas na mig yod bzhin g.yang la gzags rgyu red zer/ gnas mo yang tshur yong nas/ de dus dngos gnas gtam 'chal de 'dra zhig byung thag chod yin/ zer zhing / khong 0sum pos de snga'i gnam yig dang da lta'i gnam yig gi bshad tshul dran gso dang dpyad bsdur byas te ji tsam bkur ba de tsam gyis kun mthil gsal po mthong bas 'jigs snang dngangs skrag gi rnam pa de rim bzhin yal nas ha ha dang hu hu zer bzhin bzhad gad kyis khyim dang dro skyid kyi snang ba 'phel bar gyur/gnas mos/ sdug shi rgyag rgyu de tshos mi la dngangs skrag de 'dra bzo dgos don gang yin nam/ zer ba jo mgon gyis/ de ni ha cang gsal po yin/

gan/jomagonagyiganamatshangaka wa wa rtse// sngotang krung dbyang nas 'di lo nas bzung lo sasum gyi ring thon skyed gong 'phel btang nas bod du dbul bcos phyug 'gyur byed dgos pa'i mdzad phyogs srid jus rab dang rim pa bston gnang ba de das gis mang tshogs yongs la dku la slong thebs nas hur brtson gyi rgyu rkyen yod tshad dbyar mtsho rgyas pa ltar 'phel zhing / zla thas nang rnam pa bzang po zhis thon 'go tshugs pa de la gtor bshig gtong rgyu'i ched du spo pa tshos tag tas lo gsum de'i nang 'jig rten rtsa stong du 'gro nges yin zhis dkrog gtam bkram nas mang tshosas kyi bsam blo zang nge zing nge bzos te thon skyed dang phyug 'gyur byed du mi 'jug par ske gcod rtsis byed pa de di tsha ga spyod kyi dmigs yul ngo ma yin pa gsal thas chod mi 'dug sam/ zhes brjod par khong sanyis gas/ de rang red/ mi dmangs kyi dgra bo de tshos lkos g.yo 'di 'dra bshom gyi yod pa red ces bshad/ de nas jo mgon gyis/ ‘ bskal pa stong rgyu zer ba de ni ri bong gnam rdib kyi sdug bsngal zhes pa'i dpe ltar yin/ 'on kyang khyed sanyis kyi bu chung ba de'i bya spyod ni dngos sanas blo mi bde ba zhig red/ deng skabs rdo rje dang bu mo padma gnyis gas khong skyob thabs kyi 'bad brtson byed kyi 'dug khyed pha mas phru gu gces lang du gtong ba'i phyogs zhin de spangs te sdo rje dang pa dma gnyis la gzhogs 'degs yag po zhig ma byas na rjes su 'gyod pa skyes kyang phyis drasas pa zhig yong nyen 'dug ces shod skabs rdo rje dang padma rkang 'khor rer bzhon nas sbo rar 'byor zhing / rdo rje'i nyal lang nang 'dzul grabs byed dus jo mthon gyis khra ma'i nang nas/ ‘ khyod gnyis 'di gar shos dang / ji zhes bos/ khong gnyis der slebs pa dang jo mgon gyis/ chi da lta nga tsho gsum yang bu 'jigs med kyi skor la gros mol byed bzhin yod/ khyed tshos brtsad zhib byas nas ci 'dra 'dug pha ma gnyis la zhu dgos/di zhes bshad nas mtshams stor byas/ ngo

114 ga /chab spel tshe brtanasan tshogs kyi rtsom rig ba rdodis chosaphyogs bsgrigs/rje dang padma gnyis kyis spyi tshogs nang kho'i bya spyod dang / 'khor sa/ bslu brid byed mkhan gyi mi sna/ de tsho'i rtsa 'dzugs dang de'i ngo bo/ nyes spyod kyi nang du 'jigs med kyang zhugs 'go tshugs yod tshul sogs kyi gnas lugs rnams re re bzhin bshad pa'i mjug tu rdo rjes da cha 'jigs med kyi gnad don nyen tshabs che nges su slebs 'dug khram pa 'i skyid sdug de'i nang du lo'i gzugs po byed ka tshud tshar 'dug dge rgan krang lags kyis kyang thugs g.yeng chen po gnang nas nga tshor shugs brgyab nas tshur 'then dgos zhes yang yang gsungs byung / khram pa'i tshogs khag de'i 'go gtso dang / nyes spyod/ khongs mi sogs kyi skor zhib phra spyi bde las khungs nas gsal rtogs sanang grub 'dug 'jigs med da lta rtsa 'dzugs de rang gi longs mi ngo ma zhig chags med stabs nga tshos skyob thabs mgyogs myur byed dbos/ spyi bde las khungs nas kyang myur skyob thub pa'i rogs skyor gnang gi yin zhes gsungs byung /7 zhes bshad/ padmas kyang mig chu gtong bzhin/ da ni 'gag rtsar slebs 'dug nga tsho nang mi tshang mas mdung shugs gcig sgril gyis myur skyob ma byas na phyin chad nga lan byod lan bshad nas phan pa med/ pha ma gnyis nas phru gur gces skyong gnang na phugs kyi bde skyid la phan pa zhig gnang dgos 'dug ces lab skabs a ma yang kho'i nyes spyod kyi tshad gzhi sogs gsal po ha go bas hang sang nas khong khro dang 'jigs snang 'gran pa bzhin du skyes te/ rang gi phru gu byams thal gces lang du btang ba des ngan 'bras tshabs chen de lta bu bzos pa mthong zhing / de ring slar yang sgor mo lnga bcu sprad pa de yang kho pa phar 'bud 'ded btang ba zhig tu gyur 'dug snyam/ blo 'gyod chen po skyes te mgo rtsog spyog byed bzhin ngu ba las thabs gzhan ma byung / pa pas/ da phan nga tsho pha mas tsha bcun gang yang ma byas pa ma zad/ khyod gnyis kyis kho la slob gso brgyab par

kau /jomagonagyiganas tshang / ri 115yang bkag 'gog byas pa de dngos gnas 'grig mi 'dug da cha kho myur skyob bya thabs 'jam thub gang 'dra byed dgos rung khyed gnyis kyis byed rkyang gyis/pha ma gnyis gas de la rgyab skyor bya rgyu yin( zhes smras/ de nas gnas mor kha bltas te/ 5byams pa/ gang 'dra 'dug zer bar a mas kyang ngu lab kyi ngang /5da ga rang yin/ khos de 'dra byed kyi yod 'gro bsams ma byung ( zhes brjod/nang mi rgan gzhon dang jo mgon bcas tshang ma de'i skor par bshad tshur bshad kyis bsam blo sacig mthun byung nas 'di 'drarang de 'dra bya rgyu'i gros bsdur legs par byas/ de'i gnangs nyin gza' nyi ma'i chu tshod bcu pa tsam la sanas mo byams pas bu 'jigs med 'tshol bar skyod skabs/ glos brnyan khang zhig gi sgo 'gram na mi tshogs stug po 'tshang kha shis shig byed pa 'i zur zhig tu lo dang khram pa gsum rub rub byas nas langs bsdad pa mthong / a mas par 'gram la ma bcar bar 'dzum dmul dmul gyi ngang nas/ 'jigs medalta ces bos te lag pas g.yab g.yug brgyab pa na/ 'jigs med kyis tshur bltas nas yong grabs la khram pa de gsum gyi nang nas lo na rgan pa mgo skra sog sog bar snang du ring ba dang // 'gram pa gnyis la spu tshom nag 'ol 'ol ba'ag pa/ lag mgo gnyis ka sgos kyi khug ma'i nang blugs nas phan tshun gyi mi tshosas la 'os mig cig cig tu lta mkhan zhig 'dug pa de la par lta bzhin sgug de ri phal cher kho'i bka' sgus dgos pa gsal ngo ra mtshon/ mi des 'jigs med la mgo rtsog tsam byed pa dang dus mtshungs lag pa g.yas pa bton nas sor mo gsum sgreng tsam byed pa la sa kha ma grags/ 'jims med de 'phral a ma'i 'gram du yong / mi de tsho mthong ba tsam gyis a ma 'i sems nang khong khro'i rba rlabs lang long du 'phyur na'ang phyi tshul du zhi 'jam gyi rnam 'gyur ston gang thub byas te/ bu/ khyod kyi dngul bun 'phrod song ngam/ zhes dris/ 'jigs med kyis las

116 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun gsakyi marigab pasachosaphyogasabasgrigs wa pas mjing pa 'phur bzhin du/ skud dung khag gcig 'dang mawong ( zer/ a mas/ na 'dang ma song ye/ 'o na nga tsho'i khyim gyi sgra sdud 'khor lo de skad gsal po rang mi 'dug pas dngul skyon la sprad kyang chog ces lab dus khos/ gde byung na phal cher bu lon 'phrod thub pa sa nga la sprod dang zer/ a mas malam seng nang la len du shog da lta kho tsho phyi la phyin nas bsdad med ཿces bshad de kha bskor ba dang kho rjes su 'brang bzhin par/ gcen po dang gcen mo bsdad med dam( zhes dris par a mas/ med/ kho tsho yod na sgra sdud 'khor lo ster du 'jug gi ma red/ mgyogs tsam 'gro'o zer zhing / ma bu gnyis khyim du 'ongs te sdod khang gi sgor 'dzul ba na pa pha dang / jo mgon/ gcen mo bcas bsdad yod pa mthong 'phral 'jigs med kyis ltag log rgyag rtsis byed skabs sgo'i rgyab nas gcen po rdo rjes kho'i lag pa ya gcig nas dam por bzung ste yar khrid nas gdan gyi steng sdod du bcug 'jigs med kyis lta dus/ pa pha ni khong khro bzas nas rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar por gyur pa'i mig gnyis rang la 'bur tshugs su lta ba dang / a ma ni 'gyod gdung gi rnam pas rab tu non bzhin mgo bo cha sgam la gtugs nas mig chu gtong ba/ gcen mo yang rgyun ldan dang mi 'dra bar so phreng mu tig gi do shal kha sgo'i bang mdzod nang lhag med du bsdus shing / mdzes zhal gyi zla ba khro bdung sprin dag gis bsgribs nas gal te gtam tshig 'ga' shas shig gleng na mchi ma'i char rgyun lhung lhung du 'bab rgyu'i bzo lta 'dug 'on te bsams dka' ba zhig la rnam kun zhed snang che shos bya yul gcen po rdo rje ni gdong gshis 'gyur med pa ma zad/ da dung dkar yol zhig gi nang ja srub ma gang blugs te 'jigs med la sprad thog kha skom yod pa 'dra/ sngon la ja 'di thungs dang ( zer nas 'dzum dmul dmul byed pa dang / jo mgon gyis gad mo tsheg tsheg ngang / bu 'jigs med nang la

ga /jo mthon gyi gan tshang ri /17— ——— wa —yong bar tshang mas dga' po byed kyi yod( zer ba bcas khyim mi'i rnam 'gyur rgyun gtan las ldog pa des kho'i sems la rnam rtog gi ri mo mang po zhig zang zing du 'char/ yud tsam song ba dang pha ye shes kyis/ makwa ye nga tsho'i khyim tshang ni sngon chad dka' sdug gis nyin mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i dus su yang lugs mthun gyi lto bzas/ khrims mthun gyi gos gyon nas sason thabs byed mkhan zhig yin/ khyod ni nang mi su dang mi 'dra bar 'khyam nyul gyi 'tsho ba skyel zhing /da cha nyes spyod kyi 'dag dong nang zags na'ang da dung lam nor ldog shes byed kyi med/ nyin ma de ring khyod kyi ngan rogs su yod dang spyod ngan gang byas kyi gnas tshul rnams sasal la dag pa zhig ma bzos na de lam du mi 'jog thag chod yin( zhes shod kyin shod kyin skad shugs je che dang je ngar du song /'on kyang 'jigs med kho la khram pa'i slob saso sang 'tsham zhig thebs yod pas 'jigs snang bya rgyu par ba' ga ma yin yin mdog gis/ ngas khrims dang 'gal ba'i las ka gang yang byas med/ deng sang nyes med la nyes 'gyel sus kyang byed thub kyi ma red/ nag nyes ma bsags par rolas pa su zhig rtsis sprod dgos/ chang 'thung grogs ngo ni pa pha rang la'ang gcig min gnyis min yod pa red/ ces zer bas pa chan long khyo za thag chod nas yar langs te rdung rtsis byed skabs jo mthon dang padmas bkag pa dang / rdo rjes 'jigs med bkab nas 6tshang mas/ de 'dra byas nas gnad don thag gcod mi thub/ ces bshad de ye shes rang sar sdod du bcug gcen po rdo rjes sgam brling ngang 'jigs med/ de ring khyod kyis rgyun gtan ltar nang nyams kyi skad cha gang byung shod mi rung / nga tshos yun ring nang khyod kyi gnas tshul brtsad zhib byas pa yin/ spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags la gtor bshig dang / dkrog gtam bkram nas mi sems dkrug pa/ spyi'i sgrig lam bshig pa sogs de tsho khrims dang

118 ga /chab spel tshe brtan kun tshos gyi ma rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/— —wa wa mthun pa'i bya spyodakrenanam gsal pobashadar khyod kyisogs po de dag ni rtsa 'dzugs chad pa'i khram pa'i tshogs khag gcig dang / g.yo thabs sna tshogs spyad nas khyod lta bu'i skyid 'dod las g.yol gyi gzhon nu rnams maso skor bslu brid byas te nyes spyod kyi bya ba'i nang gom pa re re bzhin da nas kho pa tsho'i dpung khag rgya bskyed byed bsam mkhan spyi tshogs kyi gnod 'bu sha stag yin pa nga tshos gsal po shes byung / da lta'i gnad don ni stod kyis lam nor ldog shes byas te g.yang sa nas rta kha skor dang mi skorade yin/ yang bskyar bshad na cad kyi rkang pa ya gcig mi dmangs khrims khang gi nang du rang nyid kyis spos zin pa de mgyogs myur phyir 'then byed 'dod yod med de red/ ces shod skabs 'jigs med kyis/ dzipha ma spun mched kyis nga'i gnad don la brtsad zhib byas te nga btson khang du skyel 'dod yod na nga la 'gyod pa med/ las ka de dag spyi bde'i las byed pa'i las 'gan red( ces da dung zur log log byas nas sdod pa mthong 'phral gcen mo padma khong khro gnon ma thub par yar langs nas/slokhyod btson khang du skyel mkhan khram pa'i tshogs khag de red/ nga tshos skyob gang thub byas rung 'dod ba med par spyi bde'i las byed pa rang dgos na ngas khrid yong ( zer zhing / rdo rje'i nyal khang nas mngags gtong khang gi so'o krang tshe ring lags gdan 'dren zhus te der slebs/ stod thung dkar po dang / gos thung sngo nag zhwa mo keb zhwa gyon pa'i so'o krang de mthong ma thag 'jigs med kho skrag snang chen po skyes nas yar langs pa dang lus po yongs rdzogs nas rngul chu phrum phrum thon/ 'on kyang so'o krang ni 'dzum mer mer ngang kho'i dpung par lag rngu sa cag cag byas te/ 5sdod dang / 'jigs snang byed mi dgos( zhes bshad/ skabs der dge rgan krang lags kyang nang du 'dzul yong / 'jigs med kyi bsam par da ni yag po byung ma song / dge rgan krang lags la ngas kha

ga /jomagonagyi na da/ — 119lan mang po slog myong ba ma zad/ da dung nye char khong rang rkang 'khor ba'on nas 'gro dus ngas rogs pa kha zas dang mnyam du rjes 'anged btang nas rdo 'dzos kyang gzhu myong / de ring khong 'di gar glo bur yong ba ni nga la 'khon lan slos rgyu'i ched du yin pa thas gis chod snyam/ kho ni mun pa'i thos tu smas rum 'thibs pa bzhin gyur nas mtho bo smad cing phrag pa glod de bsdad/ dge rgan krang lags ni 'tshang la brgyab nas 'jigs med kyi 'gram du bsdad cing /kho'i mgo la byil byil byed bzhin du/ 'jigs med khyod la ngas bslab bya jig rgyas bsams te yang yang btsal rung khyod 'khyam po de tsho dang rtag par mnyam du sdod pas nga rdung yong snyam ste g.yol nas 'gro dgos byung / de ring 'di gar nang mi tsho dang sa khul gyi so'o krang la khyod kyi bar la ma mi 'os pa'i spyod ngan 'ga' zhis byung ba de dag ngas slob phrug la slob gso do dam bya rgyu legs sgrub ma thub parang kha bral thabs med stabs 'gan phyed ka nga la yod pa'i skyon zhib zhu ba dang phyin chad dang mi dang mnyam du gzhosas 'degs byas te khyod mi bzang po zhig chags thub nges kyi 'gan len byed par yong ba yin/ zhes brjod pas 'jigs med la smra mi shes pa'i sems 'gul tshad med thebs na yang kha nas tshig gcig grags ma thub par mig chu dbang med du shor/ so'o krang yis/ 'jigs med/ da phyin chad gang 'dra byed rtsis yod dam/ skad cha drang po zhig thod dang ( zhes bshad par khos sngar byas rgyab skyur dang phyin chad pang len zhu rgyu yin )zer// so'o krang gis/ 5gnad don ni cad kyis khram pa'i tshogs khag de dang dbye mtshams ngo ma zhig gcod 'dod yod min la thug yod de yang la stong pa tsam gyis go mi chod pas ngas khyod la skad cha 0cig 'dri rgyur lan drang bden zhig rgyag dgos/ de 'dra byas na gang 'dra 'dug sam( zer bar khos/ nga la 'od rgyu yod pa 'i ga yin na zhu gi yin/7 zer

120 ga /chab la tshe brtan gan tshog kyi/me rig brtsams cho phyogs bsgrims so'o krang gis/ 5khyod la shod rgyu yod pa zhig rang 'dri rgyu yin/ de ring chu tshod gsum par khyod tshos ga re byed rtsis yod dmakha nas dris par kho dngangs bzhin/ 5de de( zer skabs a mas/ 5ngas khyod 'bod skabs phyogs sprang mgo sog des khyod la mdzub mo gsum bstan nas mgo gug tsam byas song ba de chu chod gsum pa dang 'brel ba yod pa ma yin nam/ don de gsal po shod dgos( zhes brjod mtshams 'jigs med gyis ngu gin ngu gin/ 6mdang nub sna ring gis zer don/ de ring chu tshod bzhi pa tsam la tshong pa dar rgyas kyi bu nyi ma zer ba zhig nub phyogs nye 'dabs nas ca lag cig blangs te pho brang rgyab ngos brgyud phyir log yong rgyu red/ khos 'khyer ba de bong chen po med rung tshang ma chu tshod red/ nga tsho chu tshod gsum pa'i thos klu khang gi jig 'gram du bsgugs nas de 'phrog bcom bya rgyu yin zer zhing / da dung nga la khyod las sar zhugs thengs dang po yin pas khos dngos po mi sprod pa sogs byas na the tshom med par gri brgyab ste langs rgyu med pa zhig bzo dgos/ khyod la blo khog dang 'jon thang ci 'dra 'dug de ring blta rgyu yin zer ba ma zad/ nye char a mas ster ba'i dngul nas gri 'di nyo ru bcug byung rte zhes khams gri khre tse gang tsam shubs sbrags shig sked pa nas bkrol te cog tse'i thog tu bzhag pa ma gnyis dang jo mgon sogs ni hang sang nas hur rer lus/ so'o krang sos 6skad cha drang po bshad na yag po 'dug tang gis gzhon nur slob gso byed rgyu'i las don gi zhib tshags ngang ring gis byed dgos zhes nga tshor mdzub ston gnang yod/ khyod tshos gang zhig byed kyin yod pa de nga tshos snga sa nas shes byung / de ltar min na khyod a mas 'gag rtsa'i dus su 'then thub thabs med/ gal srid khyod rang mi gsod bya bar zhugs na skyob bsams kyang bskyabs khag po yin/da phyin khyod khram pa de tsho dang 'brel thag gcod ye thub( ces dris pa ra

ra /jomagonagyi sanas tshang / /2/'jigs med kyis/ 'brel ba los gcod/ lo tshos gal srid rku 'phrog gi gsang don de sus phyi la gyar na mi de sa steng 'di ru 'jog gi min zhes mna' yang bskyal tshar song jizer/ de nas so'i brang gis kho khrid nas zur du slob gso mang po brgyab pa dang / 'jigs med kyis kyang rang nyid kyi mthong thos dogs gsum tshang ma khong la bshad cing sngar 'gyod phyi sdom bya rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag sa srib skabs khyim mi rgan gzhon tshang ma mnyam du 'dzoms nas 'jigs med bskyabs thub par dga' spro tshad med skyes/ kho pas kyang mis chu snyelhung lhung 0tong bzhin rang gi snga phyi'i nor 'khrul la 'gyod bshas byas te nang mi tshang mar dgongs das thugs bden zhus/ sang nyin de rang nas bzung dge thon krang lags kyis slob grwa'i las mtshams bzhag ma thag 'jigs med kyi khyim du yong nas kho'i rig gnas dang tshan rig gi slob tshan rnams bskyar sbyong gsab khrid shugs chen byas pa ma zad/ ring por ma thogs par 'jigs med kyis slob rgyugs sprad nas mi rigs slob grwa che mor dga' spro'i ngang zhugs thub pa byung / thengs 'di'i don rkyen gyi thog nas pha ma gnyis la'ang sems 'gul gting zab thebs shing / tang gi mdzad phyogs dang srid jus lag la go ba sngar dang mi 'dra ba zhig lon/ jo mgon la'ang slob gso chen po thebs nas ye shes dang sad cha thod res byed skabs dus bab bzang po 'di lta bu'i 'og nga tshos kyang thub tshod kyi bya ba bsgrubs nas pha yul 'dzugs skrun la legs skyes phran bu ma phul na ga la 'grig ces bsam pa gcig mthun byung / ye shes ni de snga nas sdo gshag las rtsal mkhas pa zhis yin stabs nye 'dabs kyi bras rtsar rtso ga'ag par phyin/ ye shes kyis/ dngos gnas thub tshod kyi las la byas na 'u sa khams bde la sems kyang skyid po 'dus chang kho na btungs nas nyal bsdad na gzugs gzhi je sdug tu 'gro ba'i tshor snang byung lta 'es zer/ de ltar ye shes

122 ga /chab spel tshe brtan kun tshogs kyi rtsom rig ba mas chos rgyasas bsgrigs/——kyis rang gi las rigs de rgyud 'khyongs byas pa dang / byams pas kyang lugs mthun gyi tshong las sgrub/ bu mo bstan 'dzin bzang mo'i slob sbyong yang bskyar gso byas te gcen po dang gcen mo'i rogs khrid 'og chu tshad yar thon mgyogs myur byung nas dge 'os slob grwa'i nang 'gro thub pa bcas la brten bu rdo rjedang / bu mo padma gnyis kyang blo bde bag phebs ngang sems nus yongs rdzogs gcig sdud kyis deng rabs can bzhi'i ched du so so'i las rkang thog byas rjes sngar bas che ba 'jog thub pa byung ste/ khong tsho'i khyim tshang ni sngar bas mthun sgril dang / rgan bkur gzhon skyong / hur bsri phyug 'gyur/ nang mi tshang ma lus bde sems spro/ 'tsho ba gun sum tshogs pa bcas mi smon rang skyid kyi mig dpe bzang po zhig tu gyur to/ /de nas a pho jo mgon yang rang gi nad gzhi sman bcos la phan skyed mngon gsal can thon zhing / khyim tshang gi dgos mkho rnams ma tshang ba med pa bsgrubs pa'i thog nang mi rgan gzhon tshang mar thun mong ma yin pa'i bod kyi yul zog zhwa gos lham gsum gyi legs skyes gya nom sto sgrub sogs byed sgo rnams legs par zin te/ slar yang gong dkar gnam gru thang nas dngul mdog can gyi bya khyung de la bzhon zhing / chu 'dzin dkar po zho gsar ltar 'khrigs pa'i gseng dbar nas rab mdzes gangs ri'i la thod kyi sbyi bor lta bzhin pa ra rang gi skyid pa'i pha yul du bde ldan ngang phyir log go /

— — — — kha sta la po / de de da ge ji na khyo dbyuge ḍa dzha /tsha na —tsha la tshe ) skya lasnye / — tsho go — nga shā ri — ci ci 4 — — — — ri / 'i — rme ——— — — ci — — — — ri ji nga byu〉dru rdu skochor tsho la ni si com gyi na sa ru / da 54 ji spyo lardo la ri gar sna / rngo (tsho — — — — sa ci laspra 7 — chi pari nga cho ne chos rā 9 /li/ 4 leng 4 chi me po skutsha shāsdi nga cas ge risgongaX / ’ sto ci 2/ci/ rdo

nee /25gsar brje'i rig rtsal gyi lam ston sgron sme/wa wa ma'o kru'u zhi'i ( yan an rig rtsal bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog gi gtam bshad 〉 spel nas lo bzhi bcu 'khor bar dran gso zhu/med byung gsar brje'i gnas mchog yan yin du/ /rmad byung gsar brje'i slob dpon ma'o kru'u zhis/ /rmad byung rig rtsal rnam bshad 'di gsungs nas/ /rmad byung nyin 'dir mi 'o bzhi bcu 'khor/ /thung thung ma yin gsar brje'i bgrod lam de/ /drang min skye ba lnga pa'i khog ris ltar/ /'khyag 'khyog brgyud kyang mdun nas mdun phyogs su/ /'phel ba dngos po'i chos nyid su yis 'gog /mi yul rtsom rig sgyu rtsal ji snyed pa/ /sang ga'i klung gi bye ma dang mtshungs kyang / /rang rang ngo bo byed nus chos nyid kun/ /la ge mthil a ru ra bzhin gzhung 'dir bstan/ /deng rabs mi yi rigs kyi 'jig rten 'dir/ /rig gnas rtsom rig sgyu rtsal sang dang sang / /gral rim srid khag so sor gtogs pa las/ /sgyu rtsal ched kyi sgyu rtsal med ces bstan/ /de phyir 'byor med gral rim rig rtsal yang / /sang gi gsar brje hril ngo 'i cha shas te/ /ji ltar 'phrul 'khor chen po'i 'khor lo'am/ /bcus sa/zer lta bu yin tshes le nyin gsungs/ /'khyag 'khyog phra zab rig rtsal khung bu'i nang / /ljan smin rtswa ltar 'dzings pa'i bshad tshul kun/ /bden don phra mthong che shel 'di spyad tshe/ /sna tshogs srin 'bu'i rang gzugs so sor mngon/ /tshul 'dis rig byed kun gyi

196 ga /chab spel tshe brtan can tshogs kyi rtsom ris brtsams chos phyogs bsgrisas/gyu wa wa wa ——— — ——— —wa wa byed po zhes/ /snga rabs 'jig rten grags pa'i gser mngal can/ /'di na rang gi bya ba med mthong nas/ /stong pa'i mkha' la ting 'dzin gnyid du yu ra/ /mar le ring lusarme me shel nor bu'i bcud /gcig bsdus 'od sto nga 'bar ba'i rnam bshad 'di/ /spyi tshogs ring lugs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal kun/ /spel ba'i mdzub khrid bsam blo'i nyin mor byed/ /ces bsngags brjod kyi tshig gi me tog 'thor bas lam yangs por phye ste 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje mkhas can blo mthun ma'o tse tung mchog gis spyi lo1942lo'i zla ba 5pa'i tshes23nyin (yan an rig rtsal bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog gi gtam bshad / sanang nas lo bzhi bcu tham pa 'khor bar dran gso zhu ba'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i tang gi rig rtsal lam phyogs mtshon pa'i gsung rtsom 'di la blo nus gang yod bton te don dngos dang zung 'brel gyis slob sbyong nan tan zhu rgyu ni/ mig sngar rang ljongs su spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi tshad mtho'i bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs sgrun byed ched rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi las don gong spel gtong ba'i bya gzhag la cha mtshon na med du mi rung ba'i gtso bo'i slob tshan 'ba' zhig yin pa tshor gyin 'dug spyir na gsung rtsom 'di'i nang gsar brje'i rig rtsal las don pa rnams la langs phyogs kyi gnad don dang spyod tshul gyi gnad don/ las ka byed yul gyi gnad don/ las ruka'i gnad don/ slob sbyong gi gnad don bcas rtsa don rang bzhin ldan pa'i gnad don rab dang rim pa ra rgyas bshad tshar du dngar ba zhig gnang yod pa ma zad/ lhag par du nga tsho'i rig rtsal de su dang su la zhabs 'degs zhu byed cig yin pa'i rtsa ba'i gnad don dang / gang 'dra byas nas zhabs 'degs mu dgos pa/rtsom rig sgyu rtsa'adigyi 'byung khungs gang yin pa sogs kyi skor rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang skabs de'i rang rgyal gsar brje'i don dngos thung 'brel 0nang ba'i mdzub ston mi sems 'gul ba du ma zhig deng skabs kyi ris rtsal las 'gan

ga /ga ra brje'i rig la gyi lam ston sgron me/ 127——— ————— —wa dngos dang sbyar nas mu mthud slob sbyong zab nan byas na/ rig rtsal las don nang i gnad don mang po zhis rim bzhin thag gcod bya rgyu dang / nga tsho'i bsam blo gcig gyur yong bar phan 'bras chen po thob nges red/ dper na/deng skabs tang si mi rigs srid jus kyi 'od snang rab tu 'phro ba'i 'os rang cag bod mi rigs kyi rtsom ris sgyu rtsal gyi rjes shul myur skyob dngag shul 'dzin/gsar rtsom bcas kyi bya ga'akha thad mi rnams kyi ngos 'dzin byed stangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa ra mngon/ de'i skor rang nyid la'ang yang das pa'i lta tshul gsal po dang brtan po 'i0 chags thub med/ der bsten 'brel yod mdzub ston 'ga' sgos drangs te mnyam du slob sbyong zhu rgyu'i re ba yod/〈gtam bshad 〉 nang nga tshos nges par du rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal gyi shul rgyun phul byung yod tshad kyi rgyun bzung thog bzang ngan dbye 'byed kyis de tsho'i nang nas phan pa'i rigs yod tshad bsdus nas nga tshos dus de dang yul de'i mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang gi rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal gyi rgyu cha rnams spyad nas rtsom rig gsar skrun byed skabs kyi dpyad bzhir 'dzin dgos zhes dang /mang tshos bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gral rim dang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rig rtsal gyi rtsom rig yin na'ang snga rabs kyi mi dang phyi rgyal gyi mi'i ris rtsal gyi rtsom rig rgyun 'dzin mi byed pa dang dpyad gzhir mi bzung ba gtan nas byed kyi ma red/ yin na'ang rgyun 'dzin byed rgyu dang dpyad sa/zhir 'dzin rgyu de rang nyid kyis gsar skrun byed rgyu'i tshab la gyur na gtan nas 'grig gi ma red/ de ni tshab la byed nyan pa 0cis gtan nas ma red ces gsungs pa 'dis bsam blo'i phyogs lhung gnyis la do snang byed dgos pa'i mdzub sto na gnang ba ma zad/'gag gnad yin pa'i bzang ngan dbye 'byed dang phan gnod kyi tshad 0zhi de ri rang snang gi kun slong tsam ma yin par mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i khe phan yin pa smos ma dgos pa ste 〈 gtam bshad 〉 nang sa re ga re yin na'ang

128 ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshog kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos rgyags bsgrigs/nges par du mi dmangs mang tshogs la dngos gnas phan pa yin na ma gtogs de yag po zhig la brtsi rgyu yod pa ma med ces gsal por bstan yod cing / da dung nga tshos gna' rabs kyi rig rtsal shul 'dzin byed dbos don sang yin pa dang shul 'dzin ji ltar byed dathos pa'i thad la'ang 〈gtam bshad 〉nang nga tshos krung bo dang phyi rgyal gyi sngar gyi dus rabs kyi rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal gyi shul rgyun phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal gyi srol rgyun bzang po rnams kyi rgyud 'dzin dbos/ yin na'ang rgyun 'dzin dgos pa'i dmigs yul mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi ched du yin/ sngar gyi dus rabs kyi rig rtsal gyi rnam pa de nga tshos bed spyod mi byed pa min/ yin na'ang rnam pa rnying pa de tsho nga tsho'i lag par slebs rjes sgyur bkod dang nang don gsar pa kha snon byas na gsar brje'i rigs shig dang mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu byed cig la 'gyur thub kyi red ces gsungs 'dug pa ltar/ deng skabs lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams gsar pa 'dir cha mtshon na rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal gyi bya gzhag 'dis gtso bo mi rigs mimathun sgril chen po sra brtan gong 'phel du gtong ba dang /rang ljongs 'di nyid spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsam pa'i dpal yon dar zhing rgyas pa zhis yong ba'i don du 'bad 'thab bya rgyu de ni bod kyi risas khag mi dmangs kyi rtsa ba'i khe phan che shos nyag gcig yin stabs/ kha phyogs de bzung nas 'bad brtson byed dgos par ngos 'dzin zhu bzhin yod/ mi rigs kyi rig rtsal khyab gdal dang song mthor gtong rgyu'i gnad don thad la'ang nga tshor phyogs re ba'i lta tshul sna tshogs yong gi yod par mngon/de'i thad ma'o kru'u zhis ris rtsal khyab gdal dang yar rgyas gtong rgyu de gnyis la gtad du ma bzhag par rtsod sgrub kyi lta stangs yang dag pa zhig 'dzin dbos pa'i skor la rgyas bshad rab dang rim pa mi sems la zug pa zhig gnang 'dug

ga /gsar brje'i rig rtsal gyi lam ston na me/ ri 12 9la wa wadaper na (satam bshad 〉 nang nga tsho'i rig rtsal ni gzhi rtsa'i thos bzo zhing dmag sasum la zhabs 'degs zhu yas shig yin na/ khyab sadal satong rgyu'ang bzo zhing dmag gsum gyi phyogs su khyab gdal satong dbos pa dang /yar rgyas gtong rgyu'ang bzo zhing dmag gsum gyi chu tshad nas yar rgyas satong dbos zhes dang / 6 yin na'ang khyab gdal gtong rgyu'i las 7 dang yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i las ka gnyis rbad de kha bral gtong rgyu yod pa ma red/ com rig phul byung khag gcig da lta nas khyab gdal gtong thub pa ma zad/ rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi rig gnas kyi chu tshad kyang rgyun mi 'chad par mtho ru 'gro gi yod pa med/ gal te khyab gdal gtong rgyu'i las ka de yun ring por chu tshad rang 'jalas gcig la lus pa yin na slob gso byed mkhan dang byed yul gnyis ka rgya ma phyed dang sung brgyad nang bzhin khyad par med pa zhig chags kyi ma red dam/ khyab gdal gtong rgyu'i las ka de 'dra la snying po ga re yod dam zhes sogs sasungs pa de dag ni rang ljongs kyi mis snga'i gnas tshul dang 'tshams pa zhig yin snyam/mi rigs kyi rig rtsal ched la sa pa smos ci/ tha na la sa zhor gyi rtsom ris pa tshos kyang mar le ring lugs dang ma'o tse tung dgongs pa nan tan gyis slob sbyo nga byas te lta tshul rnying pa sgyur bsod dang / bzo 'ing ma nga tshogs kyi sa nas slob sbyong zhu rgyu de ni su zhig yin rung snang med rtsa ba nas byed rgyu med pa zhis yin pa'i myong tshor byung / (gtam bshad smi nang rungs slob sbyong zer bshad pa'i gnad don ni mar khe si le nyin ring lusas slob stong dang spyi chogs nas slob stong byed rgyu de red( da lta blo mthun kha shas la mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi rtsa ba'i lta tshul yo da pa ma red dper na/ mar khe si'i ring lusas kyi rtsa ba'i lta tshul gcig ni gnas pa des 'du shes thag sacod kyi yo da pa de red ces dang / khengs skyung chen po'i sgo nas mar khe si le nyin ring lugs slo ba

/30 ga /chab chusatshe bcan sun tshoms gyi rtsom ris brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/———wa ——wa wa— —wa —sbyong byed dgos kyi red/ rig rtsal gyi las ka byed mkhan tshos rig rtsal gsar sgrun byed rgyu slob sbyong byed dgos pa ni bden pa yin pa bshad ma dgos pal red/ yin na'ang mar khe si le nyin ring lugs ni gsar brje pa tshang mas slob sbyong byed dgos pa'i tshan rig cig yin tsang rig rtsal gyi las ka byed mkhan rnams la'ang dmigs bsal yod pa ma red cesagasungs pa ma zad/ da dung mang tshogs mtshon thub pa zhig byung na gzhi nas mang tshogs la slob gso byed thub kyi red/ mang tshogs kyi slob phrugatsos na gzhi nas mang tshogs kyi dge rgan byed thub kyi red/ gal srid rang nyid mang tshogs kyi bdag po zhig dang mi dma' gras kyi sgang la bsdad pa'i sku dras cigakhyas na lo tshor nus pa chen po gang 'dra zhig yod na'ang mang tshogs la mi dbos pa zhis red ces gsungs pa la sogs pa'i mdzub ston mang po zhig gis rang nyid kyi ngoga'adzin song mthor gtong ba dang / bsam blo sgyur bkod bya rgyu/ spyod tshul yo bsrang byed pa bcas la thog ma'i phan 'bras che tsam thob 'go tshugs pa byung /mdor na/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i 〈yan man rig rtsal bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog gi gtam ba da 〉 ces pa 'i gsung rtsom 'di ni mar khe si ring lugs kyi ris rtsal gyi rigs pa 'i gzhung lugs dang skabs de'i krung bo'i gsar brje'i las len dngos gnyis nga 'brel gnang ba'i ma'o tse tung dgongs pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ rtsa don rang bzhin ldan pa'i slob ston mang che tho ni mis snga'i rang rgyal gyi rig rtsal bya gzhag khyab spel dang gsar kun bya rgyu'i thad la'ang mdzub khrid kyi don snying gal chen ldan yod pa ma zad/ tang krung dbyang gi bka' slob ltar nga tshos rtsa don bzhi mtha' 'khyongs thog rig rtsal gyis dmangs la zhabs 'degs dang spyi tshogs ring lugs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu don thog tu 'tshul ba dang / 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rang dbang can gyi bsam blo'i phyogs lhung bkag 'gog bya rgyu sogs la rigs pa'i gzhung lugasakhakyi rmang gzhi bzang po

ga /gsar brje'i rig rtsal gyi lam ston sgron me/ 131—wa wa zhig rim bzhin 'ding thub rgyur phan 'bras thob nges bcas la brten rang ngos nas mu mthud slob sbyong rgyun 'khyings zhu rgyu yin/ 'jig rten gsal —byed gtam bshad cha gter 'jis// skye rgu'i blo yi ra ri kun sel zhing ///dngos thog bden 'tshol rig rtsal bdud rtsi yi//phan tshogs snang ba dkar pos khyab gyur cig/ci ga

132 wa lngewa ka bshad rtsom rig skor chung zad gleng ba/bod yig gi phyi mo gsal byed kyi yi ge sum cu la ka mad ces zer zhing /de'i bo rim gzhir bzung nas bshad pa'i rtsom yig la kha skad ltar na ka bshad ces grags pa dang yig srol la ka li'i phreng ba star du bsgrigs pas ka phreng zhes zer gyi yod/ rtsom srol 'di ni rang cag bod mi rigs kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa'i rtsom rig cig yin la/ bod rigs mi dmangs kyis ha cang dga' po byed pa 'i rtsom tshul zhig kyang yin/ gang lags she na/ ka bshad ni stabs bde'i rtsom thung i gras su gtogs shing ka brda'i bo rim nges pa can ltar bsgrigs pa sa de la rang 'khrid kyi rang bzhin ldan stabs gzhon nu shes yon can rnams rtsom rig la thog mar 'jug pa'i sne khrid lta bu'i byed nus 'don pa dang / dus mtshungs ka bathad rtsom yig gi tshig don de dag mi rnams kyis yid la bzung ba'am/ dran gso dang ngag skyor sogs byed bde po yod pa'i rkyen gyis yin/ bod du ka bshad rtsom rig dar nas da phan lo ngo brgya phrag 'ga' shas song yod cing / rtsom tshul 'di ni snyan ngag gi gzhung ltar byas na sgra rgyan gyi nang tshan yi ge nges nga can gyi rnam grangs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i khongs su gtogs pa tsam yin par 'dod/ rtsom rig gzhan dang 'dra bar ka bshad la'ang snyan tshig dang / 'bol com/ dmangs khrod kyi ngag rtsom solas khyad par ci rigs pa zhig yod pa ni smos ma dgos/

ga zhabashadartsomarikoskoracung/sdo thab/ /33dang po/ ka bshad la ka phreng sgrig stangs mi 'dra ba du ma yod/1 tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar rgyun ldan gyi spyir btang ka bshad ni ka mad sum cu go rim ltar tshigs bcad rkang pa so so'i thog mar bkod de sde pa re la sho lo ka re re byas thog ta dang a gnyis bskyar zlos re byed pa'am yang na chang pa mtha' ma gnyis yi ge nges med du byed pa gang rung sis mjug sgril te sho lo ka brgyad la bsdus nas 'bri ba mang bas 'di la dper brjod dgos don med/'on kyang 'dir sasal bsgod zur tsam zhig bya dgos pa ni/ rang re'i bod yis gi srol lugs ltar na yi bo rkyang pa kho nas ming tshis gang yang ston mi nus pa yin te rtags kyi 'jug par rjes 'jug bi dgos pa bsgod nga 'i ryā bas sum ci'i phyir 'jug pa byed ce na/ yi che'i khongs nas ming dbyung ste/ ming gi 'ongs nas tshig phyung nas/ tshig gis don rnams sto na par byed ces gsungs shing / sum cu pa las sngon 'jug yod dam med kyang rung / ming gzhi'i yi ge sang yin la/ gnyis 'brel yod dam gsum 'brel yod/ a li bzhi la sa gang ldan yang / rjes 'jug bcu po ma zhugs na/ ming gzhan sbyor ba yod mi srid ces sogs gsal ba ltar mdor na yi ge sang zhig la'ang rjes 'jug med na ming dang / tshig brjod pa bcas ston mi nus par gsungs pas dper na kha dang / nga / nya sogs lta bu ni yi be rkyang pa dang de rigs la kha' dang / nga' nya' zhes 'a mtha' zhugs rjes gzhi nas smra ba'i sgo dang / bdag nyid/ mig mi 'dzum pa bcas kyi ming du 'gyur ba yin mod/ 'on kyang bod yig la bkas bcad rim pa brgyud yi se zor yang ba'i ched 'a mtha' bsdus pa ra grags pa'i don gyi thob tshul 'di ka bshad 'bri skabs nges par du mkhyen dgos pa yin

134 ga chab spel tshebartan sun chog shu rtsom ris 0rtsams sa phyogs bsgrigs/ṅge/2 don la 'a mtha' thob rung deng dus 'bri srol med pa'i ka li'i yi ge rkyang pa can gyis go don mtshon pa zhig rnyed dka' ba'i skabs su/ ming gzhi'i yi ge gang yin pa des ka phreng bi go bcad de sngon rjes mgo 'dogs dbyangs yig sogs sbyar ba'i ka bshad 'bri grol yang yod pa dper na/ nor bzang gi yum gyis bsu chang zhu dus dka 'a las byas pa can gyi a ma'i bu chung nor bzang ༈ zhes dang bu mo brgya las lhag pa lha sras mdzes ldan lha mo( yang rtsa ba rtse na spyod pa'i gtsug rgyan nor bu'i phreng ba(zhes pa lta bu 'bri sla tsam gyi rtsom tshul 'di ltar yang yod la/ ngag rtsom gyi ka bshad nang du ni 'di rigs de bas mang ba yod pa bshad ma dgos/kyi ka nasatho bar go rim ltar bsgrigs pa'i rgyun ldan gyi ka bshad tshigs rkang sum cu tham pa bris pa'i sho lo ka phyed dang brgyad kyi mjug mthud de slar yang a nas ka bar lugs ldog tu bsgrigs nas sho lo ka bco lnga'i bdag nyid can du 'bri ba'i wol yang yod/ de la ka li lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu bsgrigs pa'i ka phreng zhes zer ba yin/4 chungasatho tsam yin pa'i ka bshad rtsom tshul gzhan zhig ni/ ka nas a bar sde pa re rer dbyangs kyi yi ge bzhi po go rim ltar sbyar ba tshigs rkang so so'i dang por bsgrigs pa'i srol yang yod de/ dper na (rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor gyi byung ba brjod pa 〉yi nang du gi su g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgya bod dpung / khu tshur mtshon cha sna tshogs deg bzhin du/ ge sar bdud 'dul lta bur chas pa'i tshe/ ngo tsha kha skyengs gor khu rgyal blon rnams/ zhes sogs spyi lo 1791lo'i yas mas su gor bod dmag 'khrug skabs kyi byung tshul rasas bsdus 'khod pa'i ka phreng dbyangs bzhi sbyar ba cha tshang gnyis tsam gsar rtsom gnang ba lta bu yin/ da dung bon grong pa tshe brtan ye shes kyi rtsom btus (bon grong

ga ka bshad rtsomarin racung naglengab/ wa13sngechab shos 〉 ces pa'i lanang gsal byed kyi yi ge re'ar yang dbyangs bzhi rim pa bzhin sbyar nas ka phreng bzhi sgrig sho lo 7 sum cu can gyi rtsom rig kyang yod pa thos/5 yang tshigs bcad rkang pa dang po'i thos mar ka dang mtha' mar la zhes de ltar rim pa bzhin bkod pa'i ka bshad rtsom srol zhis kyang yod de/ dper na de snga'i dmangasatsād kyi ngag rtsom zhig la dka' las brgyab kyang 'bras bu med pa tshe sngon bsko ba'ag yin shas kha zhes pa lha bu bo myong / da lta rang res dpe mtshon tsam brjod na/ dka' ba'i las la mig bis g.yol zhing ja chang phyogs su sadangs pa'i khu/ ga dus yin yang slob la mi brtson de 'dra'i grogs po mi 'dod nga / ca tso'i gtam gyis rang gzhan mgo bskor mtha' 'bras chu yi lha ba'i cha/ ja ro ji bzhin bro mchog dang bral dri ngan gzhan 'go rul ba'i nya/ zhes pa lta bu ci rigs pa gsar rtsom byas chog6 gzhan yang ka phreng tshigs bcad so so'i thog ma lo nar sgrig pa tsam ma zad/ dbus la sogs pa gnas nges pa can gang rung du bkod kyang chog pa yin te dper na/ 'gyur med rab brtan ka ba lta bu'i blo can bzhi'i ched du kha tsam ma yin par/ dka' nyen che sar ga dus yin na yang / stas ltar mchong bang yi grogs po mchog ces pa lta bu la sosas pa de das ni ka bshad rtsom stangs mi 'dra ba kha shas dpe mtshon tsam du gleng ba las/ risas mi 'dra ba da dung yod nges bcas mdor na rtsom pa po so sos rtsom rig i shul rgyun la rang gi shes rtsal gyis rjes su dpa ga ste ngo mtshar zhing de bas yid du 'ong ba'i ka bshad kyi rtsom tshul gsar satod byed chog la/ byed kyang dgos pa yin te dbor na/ phaka ma la dang kha ba'i dum bu ga bur mdangs ltar nga yi lhas bsam rab dkar ba/ zhes sde pa re la tshig rkang re byas nas 'bri ba lta bu sogs mdor na rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gzhan dag dang 'dra bar ka bshad 'phel
