136 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi rtsom rig ba ma chos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyas su gtong ba'i 'gro lam la'ang tshad bkag dang mu mtha' med pa ni smos ma dgos so/ / gnyis pa/ mi rigs kyi rtsom rgyun bzang po shul 'dzin dang dpyad gzhi'i ched tsam du rang gis mthong thos blo la nges pa'i sngar gyi ka bshad khrod nas dum bu 'ga' shas shig drangs pa gsham gsal/1 snyan tshig gi nyams 'gyur ldan pa'i ka bshad dper na sman ri ba blo bzang rnam rgyal gyi (nyams 'char rgad po'i dri lan 〉zhes pa las ka li'i ngos su gnyer ma'i phreng brtsegs rlung gis bris pa'i rdzing chu bzhin/ kha yi so bud kha chu'i dra bas thong ga'i bzhin ras brlan zhing bsher/ ga bur ltar dkar mgo skyes lan bu sma ra rnams kyang de la 'gran/ nga la sngar med gsar spros byed pa 'i rgad po khyod ni ga dus 'ongs/ jizhes pa lta bu dang / yang rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor gyis ka la ming ku'i dbyangs ltar yid dbang 'gug pa'i gling bu/ kha ljongs rol mo'i rgyan gcig tam bu ra yi sgra dbyangs/ ga ru'ang gzhan 'gran ma mchis snyan 'gyur ldan pa'i pi wang / nga cag bde zhing skyid pa'i dga' ston dus su 'gyur shos mi ces pa la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /2 'bol rtsom gyi ka bshad skor la dper na/ ma sa pa bon grong pas khong gi nu mo g.yang 'dzoms la ka bshad las drangs pa'i yig dpe zhig gnang ba'i nang du pa ṭa'i ris la 'al skyengs 'jog lta'i phyag sor 'du byed shing gleg

ga /ka bshad rtsom rig skor cung zad gleng ba/ 137—wa —————— — ———wa ngos su ngom par mdzad la zhal mi tsha/ pha rol spyadashas lu rtsabazhin du ka ra bu ram rgun 'brum das ni gzigs ma thag tu gtsang bzhesarang / ba la phyar ba bkab pa ji bzhin 'a le yo le'i na bza' la ni thugs kyi dkyil nas dgyes tshor ston/ ma ru mgonag che legs byung na'ang bug pa phug nas mgul gyi rgyan du 'dogs par mdzad la the mi tshom/ zhis sogs gsal yod/ 'bol rtsom 'di rigs ni ljongs phyi nang gi bod rigs sa khul mtha' dag tu go thub cing /yigasol dang mthun la/ tshig sbyor rna bar 'jebs pa dang / rtsom nyams ldan zhing ba'ad sad 'phel ba bcas rang res dpyad gzhir 'dzin 'os pa zhig mi 'dug gam/de bzhin ka leb drung yig gis spyi tshogs rnying par 'phya dmod byed pa'i ka bshad nang zhwa mo zur gyon rta lcag nam mkha' la 'phyar ba'i/ za 'dre skar ma rkub kyos mi ser gyi gseg rdar/ 'a lad de tshor yon tan dri ma tsam mi 'dug ya med mig log sacig sacig gad mo rang shor byung / ba'es sogs mang tshogs rang gi skad cha spyad nas btsan shed malan la mthong chung byed phod pa'i snying stobs mtshon zhing / brjod yul gyi skyug bro ba'i bzo dbyibs mngon sum du bton te klog pa por bzhad gad 'phel du 'jug pa de lta bu brtsams pa brgyud rtsom mkhan rang gi bsam blo'i dga' sdang gsal por mngon pa bcas bsngags par 'os pa'i rtsom ris cig yin snya ma/3 dmangs khrod ngag rtsom gyi ka bshad ni bgrangs kyis mi lang bar sa sanas gang sa gang du khyab sadal ngang yod kyang / yi ger 'bod med la/ ngag skyor thub pa'ang je nyung du 'gro ba bcas 'di risas la tshang mas do snang gis rtsom tshul legs gras rnams cis kyang yi gor 'khod pa zhig dbos gal 'dusa'adir dpe mtshon tsam du bran g.yog cig nas rang tshul brjod pa'i ka bshad bdag blor gang nges rnams bkod par/ dka' las che la don go chung ba rin

138 ga /chab dirabartanasunatshogasakyirnam rig brtsams chos rgyas bsgrigs/ spungs sde drung g.yog la bsdad/ kha gang skar ma'i 'bab sgo med pa hag ste khal bltas pas shes/ ga nas bsams kyang rma lo bdag ni yun ring sa 'dir ga la sdod/ nga la dpon po'i bka' bkyon 'di ni lang shor kha yi glu dang 'dra/ ca lag khyer nas don bud phyin na rgyal khrims btsan po'i khongs su gtogs/ cha lugs ngan yang rma lo bdag ras de 'dra zhus pa'i srol yang med/ ja lata cang brtsi dad che ba skye yul lung pa dbus kyi rtogs/ nya srog ma bral mtsho mo ma skam 'di ga tsam la dgongs pa zhu/ ta tha sa ta'i yon tan 'di ni tshe sngon smon lam shugs kyis byung / tha mi la dang dman chung bu mo blo thag bcad pas chod sa med/ da lo rin srungs sde drung che mos gos dkar lus la bsko bzhag stsal/ na so ba'on pa'i rma lo bdag rang sngon chad 'di 'dra gyon ma myong / pa pha a ma'i brtse dung yod med dbus stod dbus smad kun gyis shes/ pha spun nang kha shis min byung nas yul phyogasa'adi ru gyar dgos byung / ji zhis pa 'di'i mjug cha phran gyi rna lam du ma son pas klog pa po'i khrod gsan thos yod pa mchis na 'di gar phyag bris gnang rgyu'i re ba yod/ gong gsal nang don thad skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi bkag rgya'i dbang gis bran g.yog gi sdug bsngal gting zab po zhig bgrangs thub med kyang / rang yul spangs nas gzhan yul 'grim dgos pa dang / de gar yang yun ring 'tsho gnas mi thub pa sogs brjod bya gtso bor byas yod pa de'i thog nas bod rnying par dbul phongs la mdun lam med pa gsal por mtshon gyi yod/ ta sde'i tshig rkang re zung la dbos pa ma mchis kyang / dmangs rtsom 'di rigs yi ger ma 'khod stabs rang gis gang thos cha tshang bris pa yin/ da dung 'bol rtsom dang dmangs khrod kyi ngag rtsom de rigs la dran skyen pa dang / tshig stor 'brel chags pa/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos sogs tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i dpe mtshon gyi nus pa ldan pa ji snyed cig mchis rung / kho bo ni thos rgya ha cang chung khar rnam dpyod kyi blo gros kyang shin tu

chirdza /ka bas rtsom rig skor cung zad gleng ba/ 139dman pas 'dir bdams 'god byas pa 'i dpyad ga'i rnams kyang gnad du 'khel ba ngang phun sum tshogs pa zhis byung med do/ /gsum pa/ ka bshad rtsom skabs do snang byed dgos pa 'ga' shas/rang res ka bshad kyi rtsom rigs gang zhig 'bri na yang gtso bo ka phreng gi yi ge de dag re re bzhin nges par du godon ldan pa zhig dang / tshig don sang ci gong 'os mthud sbyor legs shing / snyan 'jebs tshis gra stoms po zhig yong gang thub la do snang gzab nan gnang dgos/ rtsom ris de'i sgyu rtsal gyi tshad gzhi ltar byas na thad gar klog skabs ka phreng ched sgrib byas pa'i tshor snang tsam med par tshig sbyor rang bzhin gyis grub pa lta bu 'ig 'bri thub pa 'i 'bad brtson byed dbos pa yin/ de ltar byung na rtsom pa po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom rtsal gyi rang bzhin des klos pa po rnams kyi yid la zad mi shes pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi ro mchog dang / ngo mtshar ldan pa'i rtsom nyams kyi rtse dasa' skrun thub pas ji tsam bklags pa de tsam gyis yid dbang 'phros shulas je cher 'gyur zhing / de la brten nas brjod bya'i nang don rnams kyang snying la sim pa thob pa 'ig yong srid kyi red/ gal srid de lta bu zhig 'phral mar sgrub ma thub rung / dang thog ka li'i yi be rkyang pa de tshor gang ltar go don dang tshig gi 'brel ba nges can zhig cis kyang ldan dgos pa ni ma mthar gyur pa 'i re 'dunashag yin/ deng sang ka bshad gsar rtsom gyi dar srol je cher 'gro ba 'di ni rang stongs kyi ris rtsal sdum ra dar rgyas su 'gyur ba'i mngon tshul ches bzang po zhis yin pa ma zad /mang che ba chab srid dang sgyu rtsal gang thad nas dga' spro skye 'os pa zhis mchis med/ 'on kyang ka bshad la la tshig don 'brel mi thub bzhin du ka mad kyi go

140 ༄ /chab0tshebartanasanatshogs kyi snam rig brtsam / chos phyogs bsgrigs/rim 'grig tsam kho na don du gnyer nas ma na mu tshugs kyis bcug pa lta bu dang / tha na ka phreng i yi ge re zung la go don ci yang med pa tshig i snyigs ror snang ba sogs de rigs kyis klog pa po'i yid la zhi 'tsher dang bsun snang skye ba zhig las dga' spro'i tshor ba bskrun mi srid pa sa gnad 'dir rang cag tshang mas thugs snang chen po zhig gnang dgos pa 'dus snyam/sand don bton rjes bya thabs la gros bsdur bya rgyu ni don gyi snying po yin stabs rang gi bsam tshul phran bu zhu rgyur/ spyir na com yig yag po zhis 'bri thub pa'i thabs shes smor slob dpon chen po 'u 'u shun gyis gsung myong ba ltar dpe deb mang tsam klog rgyu dang 'tsho ba ngo ma'i nang gting zab zhugs te rgyun bsrings lhod med kyi sbyang brtson kho nar brten dbos pa las/ de min gyi thabs 'phrul gzhan med pa ltar ka bshad yag po 'bri thub pa'ang de las ma 'das pa smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang 7 bshad rtsom rig gi dmigs bsal cha rkyen dang da yod gnad don la gzhigs na/ nga tshos do snang byed dgos pa gnyis mthong ba'o dang po ni/ phun sum tshogs pa 'i bod kyi skad yig rgya mtsho lta bu'i khrod na yi ge mang pa dang 'brel ba'i ming tshig ji snyed cig mchis pa sa rang res 'tsho ba ngo ma'i nang zab 'jug gis gsal byed yi she rkyang pa can gyi ming tshig de rigs la dus dang rnam pa kun tu do snang byas te yid 'jog dang / de dag gi go don rnams ma 'dres so sor rtogs pa ra bya rgyu'i thad dmigs bsal gyi brtson zhib byed pa brgyud rang nyid kyi klad pa'i nang ming tshig gi rgyu cha phun sum gang tshogs shig gsog 'jog bya rgyu de yin/ de ltar byung na gzhi nas ka bshad kyi rtsom rig rgyas bsdus ci 'dra zhig rtsom pa ra 'dod rung cung bde blag ngang sgrub thub kyi yod pa red/ gal srid de las ldog ste rang gi blo mdzod nang ming tshig gi rgyu cha dgosanges shig med par ka bshad snyan po zhig 'bri bsam pa ni bod kyi gtam dper ltar rgyu gtong mi dbos pa'i lta dbu chen po zhis

rdza/ ba da rtsom ris skor chung zad gleng ba/ ri 141— ge la jibazhengs thabs ga la yod/ 'di ni ka bshad legs par brtsam rgyu'i gal che'i cha rkyen zhig yin snyam/des na deng skabs gzhon nu shes yon can mi nyung ba zhig ji re bar/bod yig com rig gi thos ma 'i 'jus sgo lta bu ka bshad kyi rtsom tshul la brten nas rang ljongs su spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzums sgrun byed pa'i bya gzhag nang blo nus legs skyes su 'bul rgyu'i bsam 'dun kha tsha dgos btugs shig mngon pa 'di ni dngos 'brel dasa' spro dpag med skye ba zhig los yin/ der brten ngas bod kyi skad yis ris gzhung rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas thog mar yi ge rkyang pa can gyi ming tshig rdzogs mtha' med pa zhig yod pa de dag gsog 'jog byed dbos zer ba de thos skabs/ snying stobs brtson shugs dang ldan pa'i blo gsal rnams blo rgya che ru 'gro ba las g.yo 'gul thebs mi srid mod/ 'on kyang chod sems de tsam med pa'i gzhon nu la la spom tshig chen po de thos ma thag ngang bsring byed mi thub par sgyid lus gi bsam tshul skye ba'ang yong srid snyam/ der bsten khong tsho'i hur brtson gyi rang bzhin la srung //// //nge /ji/ /rdo// //)///nge /jisnye/ /ces /|/ //)rdong thub da 'a ra da sa sa na pa 'phral la bya thabs gzhan ga brjod pa ni/ snga rabs dang deng rabs kyi mkhas pa du mas 'tsho ba ngo ma'i nang nas 'tshol bsdu dang phyogs sgrig gnang ba'i bod yis bi tshig mdzod dang /dag yig gsar rnying mang po zhig da lta dpe skrun gnang yod pa rnams kyi nang ka sde so so'i thog mar yi be rkyang pa can gyi ming tshis go rim ltar bkod yod pa de dag thur bkol byed pa'am/ yid la bzung ba yin na ka bshad gsar rtsom skabs dka' ngal mi nyung ba zhis thag gcod rgyur phan thogs mong srid/ da dung ming gi mngon brjod nang gresal ba'i yi se rkyang pa can gyi ming tshig rnams kyang 'os babs kyi spyod shes pa bya rgyu dang / dus mtshungs bod kyi brda rnying nang nas cung rgo bde ba dper na rgyu nor lam ka ca ji dang / bzhad gad kyi sgra la

142 ga /chab spel tshe ba na sun sa kyi rtso rig ba ma chos phyogs bsgrigs/ — —— ga zha( rgyus med pa la 1cha medaka btsod mdog la ja hong rte ngan pa la tha ran( go cha la ya lad/7 ces pa lta bu'i rigs kyang ka bshad la spyad chog pa ma zad/ dmangs khrod kyi kha skad nang nas kyang dper na/ ka re ko re dang / kha ne khon ne/ ga be gob be/ nga be ngog ge zhes pa lta bu'i ming tshig 'di rigs mang nyung la ma bltos pa gsal byed kyi yi ge tshang ma dang 'brel ba'i thod srol yod pa de dag kyang skabs dang bstun nas sbyor mkhas po byung na rgyan du 'gyur zhing / tha na yi ge rkyang pa can gyi ming tshig gi khongs su gtogs pa'i bod kyi yul gru bye brag pa'i phal skad 'ga' zhig tshun chad bed spyod gtong srol sngar nas mthong ba de dag phyogs gcig nas rtsom pa po'i skabs 'phral gyi dka' ngal sel thabs tsam yin srid la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas dpyad na ka bshad kyi ming tshig phun sum je tshogs dang / rtsom tshul gson nyams ldan pa/ tshis sgrub kyi mthun sbyor 'debs yul gyi khyad chos mtshon pa sogs kyi dge mtshan du ma yang mchis pasalegs par da shes na/ mi rnams kyi rjo ba 'phel ba dang ba' da gad dbang med du 'chor ba sogs rtsom rig sgo mdzes rgyan du 'gyur sko nus pa yin te/ dper na skyidazur lags kyi ngas rtsom ka bshad du grags pa zhig la/ ka pa lanas sru gtogs te/ kha yi thur du btsugs pa 'dra/ ga nas bltas kyang 'dre 'dra ba nga la gnod pa ma skyel cig /ces brda dang mngon brjod sogs kyis ma bcings par phal skad kher gtsang yin rungar bar 'jebs la 'brel ha cang chags pas bklags ma thal mi rnams bzhad gad 'chor zhing /brjod yul de mgo bo dmar thing nge ba/ kha spu ring po zang zing can lta na mi sdug pa zhig snyam phal gyis 'char ma zad/ tshigs rkang ma 'a ma de'i thog nas kho ni skabs de'i sa gnas srid gzhung rnying pa de'i nang gi dpon rigs dbang shugs chen po yod pa gcig shugs la bstan thog mi de rigs ni gnod byed kyi sadon 'dre dang 'dra bar phyi'i rnam pa'am nang gi ngo bo bzung du 'brel pa'i

wā ka bshad rtsom rim skor cung zad gling ba/ ri 143 ——dpe dang dpe can gyi mtshungs chos gsal ba 'khod pa 'di lta bu'o/ /gal te spyod stangs dang mthun sbyor 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig ma byung na ldog phyogs kyi 'bras bu thon srid pa ni smos ma dgos pas gtso bo skabs dang bstun shes pa shin tu sal che bar snang ngo / /do snang byed dgos pa gnyis pa ni/ deng sang rang re mi mang po zhig gis ka bshad rtsom skabs gsal byed kyi yi ge so so tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa re re'i nang go rim ltar 'jug thub tsam kho na'i bsam blo satong ba las/ rtsom bzhi'i brjod bya hril ngo ra gzhigs nas ka phreng gi yi ge rnams bkod sgrig dang phan tshun mthud sbyor byed stangs la cha tshang ba'i blo bkod bya rgyu phar bzhag tha na tshigs bcad rkang pa gong 'og i 'brel mthud tsam la'ang yid 'jog ma thub par brten tshig don la la 'brel dka' ba dang / ka li'i yi ge 'ga' shas ji ltar byas kyang bab 'brel mi chags pa sogs kyi gnad don yang yang 'phrad pa ma zad/ des rkyen pa sa rtsom yig hril po'i tshis don rnams mi sems la zug cing / snyan 'jebs dang ldan pa 'i ga chags rgyur yang shugs rkyen thebs kyi yod pa red/ sngar gyi mkhas pa tshos 'di'i thad la dmigs bsal gyi thugs snang mdzad pa mtshon gyi yod de/ dper na sasal byed kyi rkye ge la la spyod dka' tsam byung ba'i skabs su tshigs bcad snga ma de'i smad cha 'bri dus dka' gnad de la bsam gatshigs kyis 'jus dka' ba'i yi se de 'gro yu la snga sa nas bskrun gyi yod/ (nyams 'char rgad po 'i dri lan 〉 nang dza dzor cha ba'i rang bzhin 'then la re zhig lang tsho dgun dus kyi/ wa mo ji bzhin bde 'khyug gnyis ldan bsam pa'i gra lo rgyas par mdzod/ 7ces 'jog dka' ba'i wa yig de thabs tshul de ltar spyad nas bkod sgrig 'os 'tsham zhig sanang yod pa lta bu yin/ lar nas tshig rkang gong ma 'bri dus 'og ma'i 'tshus yul la bsam sa'i gas dang / 'og ma 'bri dus gong ma'i tshig 'gros la bstun rgyu 'di ni ka

144 gag /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos phyogs bsgrims/——bshad rtsom rig gi tshig don mthud sbyor 'brel chags yong ba'i thabs lam gal chen zhig yin par mngon no//de ltar bod yig ka bshad rtsom rig skor rang blor gang 'char cung zad gling ba 'dir skyon dang nor 'khrul gyi rigs nges par yong rgyur 'brel yod blo mthun tsho'i skyon brjod dang yo bsrang zhu zhing / 'bri ba'i kun slong ni rang rigs gzhon nu slob gnyer ba tsho'i blo gros kyi rtsol shugs de rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi lam du phyogs par spro ba 'dren pa'i pho nya tsam du re ba lags pas/nga tshos rtsom rig sgyu rtsal la 'jug pa'i som pa dang po 'di brgyud nas rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi lhun po'i rtse mthor rgyun mi 'chad pa 'bad pas 'dzegs te/ mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba dang spyi tshogs ring lugs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i la phyogs mtha' 'khyongs byed pa'i rtsa don 'og mi rigs kyi rig rtsal bya gzhag 'dis mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig bcas ldan pa 'i bod gsar 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du gzengs su thon pa 'i legs skyes 'bul dgos so/ /

— —— ———— —————————— —— /(sdobod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpo'i skor chung zad gleng ba/ma gzhi nga tsho'i dus deb dang tshags par sogs kyi thog bod kyi 0tam dpe phyogs bsdus gnang ba dum bu kha shas mthong byung / spyir na bod mi risas kyi gtam dpe'i khyad chos ri/ par bltas na dpe tshig ha cang stabs bde dang spyir btang can lta bu zhig yin rung / don dngos la ska da cha gzhan dag mang pos kyang mtshon par byed dka' ba'i nang don te dper na mi dang / mi'i bsam blo'am/ gshis rgyud/ bya ba dang / spyong tshul la sogs pa rtog 'dzings che ba'i brjod bya rnam pa sna tshogs pa de dang de dag sga ngo bo'am/ khyad chos/mjug 'bras sogs kyi tshul gang dang gang yin pa rnams gtam dpe so sos ji ma ji bzhin mi rnams kyi blo ngor bde blag tu 'char ba byed thub pa de yin zhing /gzhan yang skabs re thad kur gsal rjen du brjod mi bde ba'i don gnad la la gtam dpe'i sgo nas ston skabs rna bar 'jug bde zhing 'brel chags pa/brjod don ngo ma gting zab tu go nus pa sogs mdor na gtam dpe ni dmangs khrod shes rab kyi nying khu gal che'i rigs thig yin/ lhas par du bshad dgos pa zhis la bod kyi gtam dpe khas gcig ni/ spyi tshoms kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa'i snga rabs kyi sgrung dang ngo mtshar can gyi gtam rgyud la sogs pa'i snying po gnad bsdus byas pa zhig yin pa de das gi 'byung tshul shes na/ mi rnams gting zab zhib tshags kyi bo ba len yul zhig tu 'khrid de sason nyams ldan pa'i tshor snang la brten nas dpe don gyi sbyor bar bsam gyin bzhad gad 'phel

146 ga /chab rṣa tshe brtan phun tshogs kyi ma rig brtsams chos rgya sa bsgrigs/ zhing / tshig bsdus che ba'i gtam dpe de tshor yid dbang 'phrog shugs je cher 'gyur thub pa sogs blo rig sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin zab mo ldan pa zhig yin par snang / 'on kyang de snga spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam lugs des dmangs khrod kyi rig rtsal 'di rigs la dgos nges kyi gdeng 'jog dang snyan grags gang yang ma sprad pa'i shugs rkyen 'og da phan dpyad zhib dang 'grel bshad bya rgyu ha lam byung med/ mi rabs nas mi rabs su shul bzhag byas pa'i gtam dpe de gras mang po zhig da lta'ang mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba ngo ma'i dang spyod srol dar po yod de/ dper na bong bu bslangs pa'i dga' tshor med par/ gzhu gu bkog pa'i ya la zhes pa dang / gdangos grub mi dgos mdzog mgo glod rogs gnang zer ba lta bu sogs nga tshos rtag par go rgyu yod/ ma gzhi yun ring goms pa'i dbang gis da lta'i char dpe tshig de rigs kyi go don rags pa tsam rtogs shas che rung / gzhon skyes tshos gtam dpe de tsho'i 'byung khungs gsal po shes min cha ma 'tshal zhing / gal te cha rgyus med na ne tso'i mi skad ltar go don de tsam mi lon pa ma zad/ gtam dpe'i sgyu rtsal gyi bro ba ni de bas myong mi thub pa smos ci dgos/ de ltar na nam zhig de dag ji ltar 'phrul 'khor las ltar ba'i gcus gzer ltar 'byung khungs dang spyod yul mi shes pa nang bzhin kha rgyu go rgyu med pa'i tshig dum du gyur nas rim bzhin mi mngon pa'i dbyings su thim srid kyi red/ der brten 'di lta bu'i rigs la rang re'i rgan rabs tshos do snang zhib tshags byas te gang shes 'grel bshad bya rgyu 'di'ang dmangs khrod mi rigs kyi rig rtsal myur skyob byed pa'i khongs su gtogs yod snyam/ 'di gar rang gis thos shing dran pa'i gtam rgyud dang 'brel ba'i gtam dpe 'ga' zhig zin bris su 'god rgyu yin/ dge yong ga ra man skyel zhes pa'i go don ni/ mi bzang rdzu can gyis

rig /bod kyi dmang khrod gtamadape'i skor cung zad sbong ba/ 147—————wa wa—— ——— wa ————————wa wa——————— ——wa rgyu nor len thabs byed pa'i spyod ngan la zer 'don byed pa zhig yin/ de ni 'dul ba'i gtam rgyud cig las byung bar grags shing / go bde bar bshad na sngon dge slong zhig rgyal po'i pho brang du gdan drangs par khos kha lag zas zin pa 'i rjes su gang sar shis brjod kyi me tog gtor skabs/ rgyal po'i bang mdzod kyi nang saser ṭam mang po sa la rang dgar thor bsdad pa mthong zhing /dge slong de phyir song nas rgyal po'i bang mdzod kyi gser ṭam la sems chags te thabs shig bsam mthar/ khos 'khar sil gyi mthil la spra chil zhig sbyar zhing / lag tu spu rkang gcig thogs nas slar yang rgyal po'i pho zang nang 'dzul te smras pa/ da gin rgyal po'i bang mdzod nas kho bo'i lus la spu 'di 'byar 'dug pa rang gnas su ma bskyal na bdas ni dge sbyong yin stabs ma byin len gyi nyes sang 'byung bas spu 'di sngar gnas su skyes dgos yod ces thos ma thagargyal blon rnams rab tu dad nas bang mdzod kyi sgo phye ba na/ khos bag yod zhi dul gyi rnam pas dal bur bskyod bzhin du gser ṭam gcis gi khar 'khar sil gyi mthil btsugs nas de spra tshil la 'byar ba dang lag tu thogs pa'i spu rkang de dar zab kyi phung po zhig sga thog bzhag ste rang gnas su log nas gser ṭam thob pa yin zhes pa'i gtam rgyud kyi snying don rags bsdus byas pa zhig yin no// smugs pa'i lcang gcod 7ces pa'i gtam dpe'i go don ni/ lugs dang mi mthun pa'i bya ba la nan tur gyis 'jug pa'i mi mthong ba tsam gyis glen sko pa'i rang rtags mngon sum du ston pa de rigs la 'phya ba zhig yin/ de yang dmangs khrod kyi ngas sgrung gcig la/ snga dus mi glen pa zhig gis lcang sdong chen po gcig la 'dzegs nas yal ga'i rtse ngos su rang nyid zhon te rtsa ba'i phyogs de gcod kyin yod pa na/ mi zhig lam de nas brgyud de 'gro bas mthong skabs glen pa de la/ khyod kyis 'di ltar bya mi rung / nam 'ig shing gi yal ga de chad

148 sku /chab spel tshe brtan phun ga kyi rtsom rig brtsam chos rgya sa bsgrigs/pa dang dus mtshungs khyod rang g.yang du kung rgyu red ces kha tabyas par glen pas/ g.yang du lhung bar ci yod zer/ mi des gad mo dgod bzhin/ g.yang du lhung na shi gi red ces smras/ glen pas/ shi bar ci yod zer/ sems bzang gi bslab byar mi nyan par klan ka 'tshol stabs mi de yang ci shod 'di shod ma byung bar/ shi na rting pa ser po chags rgyu red ces brjod nas lam du phyin to/ /glen pas mu mthud shing de bcad pas dus yun nges can zhig song ba na shing gi yal ga de tshag sgra dang bcas chad cing glen pa g.yang du lhungs/stabs legs pa zhig la kho spang steng du zags pas lus ma bsnad tsam byung /'on kyang 'phongs sa la brdabs pasazug gzer bzod ma thub pa ra spang thog tu yar rgyug mar rgyug mang po zhig byas mthar rim bzhin na zug 'jags par gyur/ khos da gin 'grul pa des bshad pa'i skad cha gzhi nas dran te mgyogs myur rang gi rting par blta dus/ spang rtsi chags pas ser por gyur pa mthong skabs da ni kho bo dngos 'brel shi zin 'dug snyam zhing de gar nyal nas bsdad do zhes pa'i ngag sgrung las drangs shing / yang sa skya legs bshad kyi 'grel pa ra/bram ze mchog sred kyis rgyal po'i bu mo gser mchog ma rang la dang ba mi ston par brten de mgo rmongs par byed pa'i ched du glen pa zhig 'tshol ba'i tshe ba lang ji gzugs bzang zhing 'du shes blun pa zhis shing sdong zhig gi steng na rtse mo'i ngos su rang nyid bsdad de/ de'i rtsa ba gcod cing 'dug pa la brtags pas glen par shes te de 'khrid nas zer ba'i gtam rgyud dang yang 'brel lo/ de min yang skugs pas spyang bcos byas na/ mngon gsal gzhan las dod ces pa'i gtam dpe ni brjod don gong dang mi 'dra bar go bde'o/ /slobang bu ba ngas pa'i dga' tshor med par/ gca gu bgog pa'i ya la zhes pa 'di'i rgo don ni/ par lhag bsam rnam dag gis phan btags kyang /

ga bod kyi dmangasastod gtam dpe'i skor cung zad gleng ba/ri 149 ——cung zad ma 'grig na tshur le lan bda' ba'i khrel med kyi spyod tshul la zur za byed pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ de yang gong du bshad ma thag pa'i dmangs khrod kyi ngag sgrung de'i mjug mthud pa las byung ba zhig yin te glen pa de spang steng du nyalanas bsdad yod pa'i skabs/ yang mi zhig gis bong bu gcis 'ded bzhin lam de nas 'ong ba na glo bur du bong bu de bye 'dam gyi nang du shor nas stod brtegs na smad 'dam du bying ba dang / mi da btegs na stod bying nas mi des stobs kyis ma stsogs par dka' dub chen po myong ba'i tshul de glen pas mthong ngo / glen pa de ni lus shugs ha cang che ba zhig yin pas khos gad mo dgod bzhin par slong shi ba ma gtogs/ bong bu slong stangs de 'dra ma red ('di yang gtam dper bathad srol yod )ces smras par mi des/ khyed thi mi 'dug pa 'di ltar smra bzhin mchis na/ nga la rogs pa 'ig gyis dang zer/glen pas rkang mthil kho la bstan nas/ ltos dang nga shi zin pas rkang pa'i rting pa ser po chags mi 'dug gam zhes brjod par/ mi de yang rkang rjen mar spang gshong brgyud nas 'ongs pas rang sga rkang mthil glen par bstan te/ 'di ni spang rtsi chasas pas ser por gyur pa yin zhes bzad skabs glen pa bzhi nas yid ches shing par langs nas/ g.ya' 'o na khyed kyis bong bu'i stod 'then zhig ngas smad 'then chog zer zhing bong bu'i gzhu gu dam por bzung ste shugs gang yod brgyab nas 'then pa na/ bong bu skam sar bde blagangang thon pa dang dus mtshungs gzhu gu chad nas glen pa'i lag par bzung yod pa red/ bdas po des khyed kyis nga'i bong bu'i gzhu gu bkog song bas skyin pa 'jal dgos zhes pa'i gtam rgyud de las byung ba yin/ stobang bus ga ga thags klon ba 5zhes pa ni de snga yon tan med pa'i bla ma dang 'jon thang med pa'i dpon po sogs kyis phyi tshul du jig nyams ston pa la

150 ga /chab spel tshe brtan kun tshogs kyi ma rig brtsam chos zugs bsgrigs/—wa wa wa wa'aphya dmod byed pa'i gtam dpe zhigasan/ de'i gtam rgyud dngos ni/ sngon yul zhig na mi g.yo sgyu che zhing le lo can zhig la sgo rgyugs bong bu gcig yod pa de'i gso chas sgrub ma bgyid par kho la gzis gi pags pa zhig yod pa bong bu de la g.yogs nas ri 'dabs kyi zhing kha'i nang glod de gzhan gyi lo tog zos pa na/ dang thog zhing pa rnams kyis gzig 'dug ces phyogs der 'gro ma phod pas re zhig ci dgar zas brnyed na'ang / rim bzhin lo tog la gnod 'tshe chen po byung skabs gzig gis ljang pa za ba'i srol med zer zhing yul gyi mi rnams 'dus nas rdo rub bsgrub ste de gsod skabs gzig lpags kyi 'og nas bong bu'i ro thon pa 'i sgrung gtam de dang sbyar ba yin/ rang tshul dmar rjen du thon nas zhabs 'dren zhus pa la bong bu thon song zer ba'i gtam dpe yang de las 'phros pa yin no/ /sa skya legs bshad du'ang / 5ha cang g.yo sgyu mang drags na/ re zhig grub kyang mtha' mar brlag gzig lpags bkab pa'i bong bu yis/ lo tog zos mthar gzhan gyis bsad ces g.yo sgyu'i bya ba byas na mthar phung ba'i don dang sbyar ba'i gtam rgyud de drangs yod/ ldan ma'i stong zer ba ni spyi tshogs rnying pa'i dun lon lta bu ji tsam 'jal rung khyer dus med pa'i chag sgo la shod pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ de'i 'byung khungs ni gling se sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi nang / ge sar rgyal pos phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dgra sde rnams thams cad btul zin pa'i mthar khong rang 'di nas tshe 'pho bar dgongs te ri bong zhig tu sprul zhing ldan ma spyang khra'i mdun du 'ongs pa na/ ldan mas de ge sar gyi sprul pa yin pa ma shes par mdang zhig 'phangs te ri bong de bsad pa red zer/ de la brten nas ldan ma tshang gis mi rabs nas mi rabs bar rgo sar gyi stong zhes pa'i khral zhig lo ltar 'jal dgos zer ba'i sgrung gtam de las byung ba zhig yin/ de snga bod rnying pa'i

neeg /bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i skor cung zad gleng ba/ ngu/— wa —wa wa —wa khrims yig gi nang tshan (bsad pa stong gi zhal rtse 〉tshes par yang stod tho thog rgyal po hor gyis bsad/ ro dang gser gnyisa'abanyam 'gyogs byas smad she sar rgyal po ldan mas bsad/ dus da dung stong la khyer dus med ces lung drangs nas bla chen dang dpon chen bsad pa 'i stong sna gzhal thabs bral ba zhig yin pa'i sgrub byed du rtsis yod yo rti'i zhed ba ba ga mong 7zhes pa ni bya ba gang zhis legs sgrub yong ba'i gdeng tshod dang cha rkyen med bzhin du dngos su grub zin pa ltar byas nas zhib za'i khog rtsis 'di 'dra dang de 'dra zhis rgyas mkhan la 'phya dmodabyed pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin te/ de yang dmangs khrod kyi ngag sgrung zhig la / snga dus mi dbul po pha bu gnyis la sgo phyugs bya de pho mo gnyis la sa gzhan yong yang med/ phas bshad par/ ngas bya mo 'di'i sgo nga rnam sa bsags nas bya phrug bsnyal/ de las bya mo mang rab cis thon na slar yang sgo nga bsnyal te sgo nga mang po tshong 'dus su btsongs nas dngul mang tsam sasog thub tshe bong ro zhig nyos/de la pha bong legs pa gcig sbyor sprad byas te o ti'i yas ngo zhis skye nges yin zhes smras pa'i tshig mtshams der slebs dus/ bu chung chung des rma rti'i yas ngo de la nga zhon gyi yin zer ba na pa pa hang sangs te skad shugs drag pos// de 'dra byas na nga'i rma rti'i sked pa bcag yong zer nas bu la thal lcag tsha thal chod 0cig gzhus pa red ces pa'i kha sgrung nas chad pa zhis yin/5dngos grub mi ngams ma ga mgo gling rogs gnang jizhes pa ni dang thog re ba chen po zhig bcangs nas dngos po'i rgyu gron nges can zhig btang rung /mthar thug de las khe sposas yong rgyu par ba'ag rgyang gun chen ngo phog rgyu'i bzo lta yod par cod pa'i gtam dpe 'ig yin pa de a ku ston pa 'i ci nga nas byung ba zhis yin/

152 ga /chab spel tshe brtan kun tshog kyi thorig brtsams chosamya sa bsgrigs/————— — — — —————— ma khu btang btang mang la/ shor shor mang zhes pa3 rtag tu sbo shob kho na shod rgyur dga' ba'i mis/ ngas btang dang ngas 'jon zer yang don dngos dang 'phrad dus 'jon thang gang yang med mkhan gyi rigs la 'phya dmod byed pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ de'i 'byung khungs3/ skad grags yod pa'i bod rigs dmangs khrod kyi rtsom rig chen po (gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉gi nang du 4khu khro thung zer ba'i mi sna zhig yod/ khos nam yin rung rang nyid la blo khog dang dpa' rtsal gang min tshad yod tshul gyi sbo shob chen po bshad yod rung /donadangos dag bo dang thug dus pham nyes dang zhabs 'dren zhus pa'i lo rgyus mang po 'khod pa de dang sbyar nas byung ba zhig yin/ de skor nga tshos ha lam gling ge sar gyi sgrung dpe gang zhig bklag pa'am nyan pa yin na lam seng shes thub pas 'dir zhib phra bris med/ mar dkrog phul nas dgongs ba lu ba zhes pa ni/ thog mar bya ba zhig sgrub rgyur rang gis 5bas blangs kyang / gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog gam yang na bsam gzhigs byas pa'i mjug tu sgrub bya de phyir bshol byed pa'i go brda mtshon byed cig yin/ de yang dmangs khrod kyi ngag sgrung sacig la/ snga dus ban de zhig la sgo phyugs ba yo gcig yod pa de brlags te ri klung gang sar 'tshol du song yang ma rnyed cing / kho thang chad pa dang kha skom grod pa ltogs nas ci bya gtol med du gyur/ mdun du blta skabs ha cang mi ring ba'i sa na mi tshang chen po zhig yod pa mthong / kho de gar bskyod de khyim tshang de'i sgo 'gram nas u lags zhis bos pa na/ sge khung gi nang nas a ma bas dro ba nee la lnga ba chen po yod pa zhig gis mgo nyug tsam thon nas ci byed zer/ kho la don gzhan bshad rgyu med pas lha bcos sanang ye dgos zhes bshad/ khyim tshang de ni yul gyi phyug po chen po zhig yin la/ a ma de yang 'byor pas rgyasas ming dang

rilta /bod kyi dmang yod btam dpe'i skor cung zad gleng ba/ 153wa wa——— ———— —————dod che ba gcis yin stabs rab tu dga' zhingan lnga bcos byed dgos yod/khyod mgyogs po yar phebs rolas zer nas nang du bos te kho la bza' btung gi sne len gzab cing rgyas pa bshams/ khos bza' btung la tshim par 'o ngas spyod bzhin du sba bcos bya thabs kyi skor la bsam blo yang yang btang / de nas mos lba bcos byed par yo chas ci 'dra dgos zer bar khos/ stabs bde po yin/ chu dkar yol gang dang sbra tshal lheb pa gcig 'khyer shog smras pa ltar de das gra sgrig byas pa dang / a ma de'i mtho bo lo rang i pa nga du bzhas nas nyal bcug rdza tshal de chu la sbang ste sba ba'i thog phur phur btang zhing yang bskyar chu nang sbang nas phur brdar yang yang btang ba na/ lnga ba phyid nas mdog kyang dmar skyar gyur zhing tsha zug chen po bzod bsran mi thub pa byung bas bud med des/ khyed kyis sba bcos ji tsam gnang myong ngam zhes dris par khos/ mang ngo byed ma myong mi gnyis la byedastong zer bar mos/ khong tsho gang 'dra byung song ngam zhes dris par khos/ mi gcig ni shi song / gzhan de ni dgongs pa zhus song zer/ yang snying sba bcos byas nas drag pa gcig kyang byung med stabs mo yangagasas ste dgongs pa zhu na ci 'dra bya dgos zhes brjod par khos las sla bo red/ dgongs pa zhu dus mar dkrog gcig phul na de gas 'thus zer/ mos 'o na nga yang tshazug bzod thabs mi 'dus pas dbongs pa zhu rgyu yin zhes kho la mar dkrog sacig sprad de dgongs pa zhus pa red ces pa'i ngag sgrung las mched pa'i gtamadape zhig yin/ yang a khu ston pa 'i sgrung gi bshad srol gcig la'ang a khus phyus po klad dmar ba zhig la skra 'dzugs rgyu byas pa las byung ba'i bshad tshul yang 'dug pa/ don la khyad par med/ deng skabs mar dkrog 'bul gyi yin zeran bya ba de byed kyi min zer bar bo thub kyi yod /gzhan yang / 4 gdong rgyal po'i nor bumazer ba ni mi dang bya ba gang la

154 ga /chab spel tshe brtan kun tshog kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos rgyas bsgribs/wa wa — ——— bshad na'ang thog mar nus pa'am re ba ha cang chen po yod pa lta bu zhig snang yang dus tshod nges can nang nyams zhib ji tsam byas pa de tsam gyi ldos phyogs su 'gro zhing / re ba stong zad du gyur pa'am/ yang na 'gyur bzhin pa/'gyur bzo yod pa de rigs la zer ba de'i gtam rgyud dngos ni nye char dpe skrun byas pa'i (nyi chos bzang po'i sgrung 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb de'i le tshan dang por 'khod pa ltar yig tshogs kyi rgyur bsams 'dir bskyar bshad byas med/gong du bod kyi dmangs khrod sgrung gtam dang 'brel ba'i gtam dpe'i mtshon byed nyung shas tsam bkod pa 'di dag mang che ba ngag sgrung la brten sa khul so sor bshad tshul mi 'dra ba'ang yod srid pas legs bcos gnang 'os mu rgyu dang / da dung bod rigs gnas pa'i yul phyosasagang sar 'di lta bu'i dpe mtshon bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig mi mngon pa'i tshul du khyab nas bsdad yod/ de dag gi khrod nas tshig don bzang ba rnams 'dems sgrig gnang rgyu'i skul ma zhu rgyu yin/she de yang mi rigs so so'i dmangs khrod kyi rig rtsal shul 'dzin byed skabag mi rigs kyi rig rtsal ni gtso bo mi rigs de rang bi mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis gsar du bskrun pa zhig yin pa'i bden don de gsal por mtshon pa byed dgos/ mi la las dmangs khrod nas byung ba'i gtam dpe dang gtam rgyud kyang mkhas pa re zung gis gsar gtod gnang ba lta bur sgro 'dogs byed pa'i bag chags rnying pa de mu mthud nas spel gyi yod/ dper na/mas ces rgyal po 7zhes pa dang / gzig pags bkab pa'i phong bu zhes pa la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud mang po zhig sa skya paṇḍi tas gsar du gsungs par ba ba ni/yig rtsa ma chod pa ha cang gsal po yin/ (sa skya legs bshad 〉kyi dang du 'khor sdug rang yang bsad ces grags( wa yis khur po bskur zhes thos/ 6bskal pa'i bar du 'gras la ltos/ snye bde ba thob ces sngon rabs ma/

༄ /bod kyi dbangs khrod gtamadape'i skor tsung zad gleng ba/zi 155—— ——zhes bya ba la sogs pa de 'dra mang du yod pas tshig zin gyi thog nas khong gis spyi tshogs kyi khrod du rlung ltar grags pa'i 'jis rten gyi sngon byung gtam rgyud sna tshogs dper bkod de bslab bya byed pa'i dmangs khrod kyi rtsom tshul de rigs spyad nas mang tshogs la slob ston gnang malas pa'i dge mtshan de mthong thub kyi yod pa dang / dus mtshungs 'tsho ba ngo ma'i gson nyams mtshon pa'i gtam rgyud de dang de dag gi rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs nyas cig ni rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi rlud nas 'ong ba zhig yin pa de gsal por mthong dgos pa yin/de ni mi dmangs kyi ris rtsal las don pa gcig la cha mtshon na rtsa ba'i gnad 'alag cig yin snyam/ da dung do snang bya dgos pa gzhan zhig ni mi rigs kyi rig rtsal shul 'dzin byed dus nges par du snyigs 'dor bcud len dang /gna' bzang deng spyod kyi snying don la rtog dpyod zab nan byed dgos pa de gal chen po 'dug snyam/ 'dir dpe mtshon zhis drangs na nye char gsar bsgrigs kyi dpe deb cis gi nang / rgya bza' kong jo bod du bsu skabs kyi gtam rgyud btus pa ra/ 6der rgya rjes blon po ma sar rgya yul du sdod dgos zhes ma btang bas re zhig sdod pa ltar bcos te na brdzu byas nga na/ rgyal pos sman pa btang ba rnams kyis mi shes pa'i thabs byas so/ rgyal pos mgar la khrod rig pa can yin pas/ khyod kyi nad 'di la cis phan dris pas/ dar zab bsresas pa'i thal ba sgro ba gang dang / tsanda bsregs nga 'i sol ba'i mdung shing /'u ga gi mtsher khrag grod pu gang sogs dgos 'es mi 'grub pa'i la sa mang po byed du bcug nas rnams brngos te sa bon du 'debs su bcug pa sogs rgyal po la ngan mang po byas so// tshes sogs chos 'byung la la'i nang bris pa'i lo 'phros don dngos dang mi mthun pa de rilas bris 'dus pa 'di la ngas bltas na dase mtshan che ba ma mthong / de lta bu lo rgyus dngos kyi nang byung

156 gagi /chab spel tshe brtan rgyun tshog kyirtsom rig brtsam cho sdogs bsgrigs/srid dam mi srid ce na/ bltas pa tsam gyis gang byung gi long gtam yin pa sus kyang shes thub pa ma zad/ de bas gal che ba ni gtam rgyud 'di gras kyis mi rnams la 'char snang bzang po gang yang 'jog mi srid pas phyin chad nga tshos bsam zhib bya rgyu lhod g.yeng du ma shor ba byed dgos pa 'dug snyam pa bcas ni/ bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal shul 'dzin dang / myur skyob/gong mthor gtong ba'i bya gzhag 'di skyon bral ngang mgyogs myur yar rgyas che tsam yong ba'i lhag bsam gyis bskul nas bris pa lags so/ /'on kyang rang gi mthong thos dran tshul gang yod brjod pa 'dir yang skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig yong srid pa ni g.yol thabs bral ba ste ji skad du gzhan skyon phra yang mthong ba ste/ rang skyon sbom po de ltar min/ dngos gzhan gsal yang rang snod kyi/ grib ma mi bsal sgron mes mtshon zhes gsungs pa de ni rmongs rgan kho bo lta bur mtshon na rgyun ldan gyi rang bzhin zhig la brten klog pa po blo mthun tshang mas skyon brjod dang yo bsrang yong ba zhu lags/ /

0 〈 tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu 〉 dang 'brel ba yod pa'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos 'ga' zhig brjod pa/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho sku gzhon nu'i skabs ljags rtsom gnang bar yongs su grags pa'i mgur glu ni rang cag bod rigs dmangs khrod du rgya khyab dang shugs rkyen ha cang che ba'i ris rtsal rtsom rig gi gras thig yin pa ma zad/ de snga rgya yig dang dbyin yig sogs su bsgyur te da pe sgrun byas nas rang rgyal dang / phyi rol gling chen gzhan la'ang khyab pa sa rgyal khab phyi nang gang sar skad grags yod pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig i gras shig kyang yin/ spyi tshogs gsar rnying gnyis ma'i nang rgya rigs kyi rtsom rig mkhas pa 'asa' zhig gis mgur glu de'i smor la dpyad brjod sos/sa byase mod pa'ang go rgyu 'dug lhag par nye ba'i lo yas nang tang gi mi risas srid jus kyi 'od snang rgyal yongs sa ga'i chen po'i thos slar yang 'phros pa'i 'os mi rigs dpe skrun khang dang / mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang bcas nas sla ra yang (tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu 〉 bsdu bsgrigs kyis dpar du bskrun te 'grem spel byas yod pa de dag nas bod mi rigs kyi rtsom ris sgyu rtsal shul 'dzin dang / gsar com gyi bya gzhag thad phan yo da kyi dpyad gzhi mkho 'don byas par brten rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu byed kyin yod/ 'on kyang mig sngar rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi gros gleng nang blo mthun re zung gis nge'i sko ra la

158 ga /chab sto tshe brtan sun gsakyi mari brtsaXchos ga bsgrigs/ —wa lta stangs mi 'dra ba'i dogs gzhi bton pa ste dper na/ nye dus dpe kun byas pa'i (tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu 〉de dag la dpyad skabs gzhas tshig gi grangs 'bor thad yang snying sho lo ka lnga bcu lhag yod dam/ yang na bdun cu lhag yod/ brgya dang nyi shu lhag yod dam/ tha na sum brgya drug cu yod sogs cha bzhag mi 'dug ces dang / yang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i gsang rnam ste (thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags dpal bzang po'i rnam thar 〉nang gsal ba'i khong gi mdzad spyod dam gsung mgur sogs dang mgur glu gnyis phan tshun bkur na/ bla ma de lta bu'i zhal nas chags sred kyi 'chal glu tha shal 'di 'dra gsung ga la srid ces pa/ da dung tshamagur glu zer ba 'di ni/skabs der sog po lha bzang khang gi phyogs gtogs kyis khong la ma nyes kha g.yogs 'gel phyir dkrog gtam rdzun bzo byas pa zhig min nam snyam zhes pa la sogs pa lta bu yin/ des na thog mar mgur glu'i gzhas tshig grangs tshad dang / cha shas kyi dang don mi mtshungs pa zer ba nas gleng bslangs te mthar thug mgur glu hril po de rang khong ngo mas gsungs pa khas mi len pa'i tshad du bskyal yod/ bshad tshul gsar pa de rigs thon par brten lo rgyus dngos la cha rgyus med pa 'i bod rigs blo mthun 'ga' zhi/ga gi sems la'ang the tshom za zhing / gnad don 'di'i thad rtsa ba'i thos nas gsal la ma sasal zhig chags song snyam pa'i rnam 'gyur yang mngon gyi 'dug der brten tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu zhes pa de yang snying ngo ma yin dang rdzun ma yin dpyad zhib cig bya smyu ni/ bod kyi rig rtsal glu gzhas kyi rgya mtsho 'di nyid 'phel rim gyi lo rgyus nang cung gal che ba'i gnad don zhis yin par mngon/ nga rang bi lta tshul la jimagur glu ni khong sku ngo mas ljags rtsom gnang ba zhig yin par dogs pa spu tsam yang byed dbos don med snyam/ 'on kyang byon yongs la

ga /(tshangs dbyang rgya mtsho'i mgur glu 〉dang 'byel ba'i lo rgyus kyi don /ngos 'ga'/ 159wa wa — —shugs rkyen yod pa'i lo rgyus kyi rig rtsal rtsom rig 'di lta bu zhig la yin min gyi dbye zhib byed skabs rang snang gi 'dod tshul kho na bshad pa tsam gyis mi 'grig par dus skabs de rang gi 'brel yod lo rgyus kyi don dngos 'a0'a zhig dang /snga rjes kyi brgyud rim sogs la dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi zhib 'jus byas na lha yid ches pa dang / 'dre kho thag chod pa zer ba'i dpe ltar bsdoms tshig gcig yong srid/ der brten 'dir yis rdzob la ma 'dzems par skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi yig rigs dum bu kha shas dang / 'brel yod dpyad gzhi'i don dngos cung zad bcas drangs te rang gi lta tshul de'i grub cha don tshan gsum la phye nas gsal bshad zhu rgyu yin/dang po/ tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho nyid 'o rgyus kyi dus bab ci 'dra zhig gi 'og tā la'i khri la 'khod pa/tshang mas shes gsal ltar spyi lo /682lor tā la'i ci phreng lnge pa sku sashegs pa 'i rjes/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos nang 'khor nyung thas la dam bsgrags kyis yun ring gsang rgya dam po gnang 'ing / de yang tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa sku'i bcad rgyar bzhugs pa'i tshul bcos nas sngar rgyun ltar sasol chas gzim chung du 'bul ba dang / bka' bsgyur dang b.la' shog sosas rgyun btan ba'in mgron brgyud kyis sanang ba/ mdzad sgo lag la na bza' sadan 'dren zhu ba/gne srid kyis gtsos rgyus can rngams bcad 'os tu yod pa ltar byas nas nang bcar phyir thon byas pa ma zad tha na sog po'i sbyin bdag gal che'i rigs 'asa' shas la dmigs bsal gyi mjal kha mi gnang ka med skabs/ rnam rgyal

160 ga /rmu spel tshe brtan phun tshog kyi ma rig bsam chos rgyas bsgrig /grwa tshang gi grwa gras sde pa bkras rab pa zer ba dgung lo dang zhal khyim sogs tā la'i nyid dang 'dra che ba zhig yod pa des 'dra brdzus byas te mjal la gtong —tshul dang / gsang rgya yun ring drags pas gzhung zhabs kyi nang dogs 'char cung zad skye bzhin yod pa'i thog skabs de'i gnas chung sku bsten tsherabang dpal 'bar zer bas 0zim chung sku gsol zhig gi skabs gsang gnas de shes tshor byung ba brgyud gsang rgya 'chor grabs byas dus smin grol gling gter ston rin po che dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho nang gros kyis smon gling gdung sras padma 'gyur med ces pa tā la'i bla mar skra phud 'bul ba yin khul grags che bzos te lha sar phebs nas sater ston yab sras gnyis gzim chung du bcar zhing / bkras rab par skra phud phul ba dang / de rjes gdung sras chung chung des tā la'i sku dbyibs dang mdzad tshul sogs phyir bsgrags gcig las gnyis brgyud kyis tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa dngos su mjal ba'i gnas tshul gang sar khyab rkyen 0zhi nas dogs pa sel zhingaka gsang rgya bskyar srung thub pa zhe / theb /mi)sgo /sa 11 /sgo rten ces /sprertsesgo /spo ces cesargyu/thang dkuzub thabatheg zab zud zung jing thab shākhu zud ngas zug zug 2/ 〈 zug pa/ 'dus pa rtsal gyi rnam thar las 'phros pa 'i byung ba brjod pa gdung ba'i mun sel 〉mes pa'i nang zhib phra 'khod yod/ gnas tshul nge lta bu'i 'og tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid rtsad gcod dang ngos 'dzin ni mngon chung ngang sasang rgya btsan po'i bya thabs spyad de byas pa zhig yin/ de yang sde srid kyis chos rje zil gnon rdo rje dang / sdo pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs mngags gtong byas te dus skabs de'i rmi sa mas su gathegs pa'i bla ma ring po che ngag dbang snyan grags dang / shar lang no mi han gyi sku skye rtsad 'tsholakhyed malan yin pa ltar bcos nas sang sar bskyod cing / de rjes mon rta dbang bla ma dang / mtsho sna rdzong sdod rgya yag pa dang spo shod pa sogs nas snyan zhu phul don/ mon la 'og yul sasum

ga /〈tshangs dbyangs rtsa mtsho'i bgur rtsa nyidanga'abre ba'i lo rgyus kyi rdon dngos 'a 'a /6/wa wa — — — du pa rig 'dzin bkra shis bstan 'dzin dang ma tshe dbang lha mor chu pas (/68lhalo)zlasatshes /nyin khye'u ngo mtshar can zhil bltamasasatshul 'byor pa bzhin sde srid nas lha blar gsang lung dang zan brtag zhus pa rtse ma thun bzang phebs byung don mtsho sna rdzong la phyi rgyar sding po che'i 'os sprul du kha g.yar thog sbir grags gang chung gi sgo nas 'phral du mtsho snar gdan 'dren gyis rgyang grung sbi gsang gang che dbos tshul bka' rgya btang bar/ mtsho sna rdzong sdod gnyis nas lam seng mtsho snar gdan zhu byas te bkod rgyar bo ba log sgrub kyis yab yum sras bcas do dam gang ches bzang btson lta bur rgyun ring bzhag pas 'o brgyal byung tshul sogs sde srid rang bis brtsams gnang ba'i (du ku la'i 'phro mthud rab gsal gser gyi snye ma 〉 zhes pa'i shog ngos 13 120bar du sasal/nga tshos lo rgyus kyi dum bu de tsam zhig la dpyad na yang / tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho bla ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin byas pa'i nyin de nas bzung khong rang yab yum dang bcas 'gro 'dus smra brjod sogs rang dbang gi 'tsho ba dang yongs su bral zhing / 'jigs nyen dam bsgrags kyi 'os tu skyo gdung gu dog si tshor ba yun ring myong ba'i nang 'tshar longs gnang ba des khong thugs byed rnyed tsam nas bla sprul gyi 'tsho ba skyel rgyur spro snang sru tsam yang med pa'i skyo bsun zhen log gi sa bon 'ba' zhig btab yod pa de gsal rtogs thub nges yin/de rjes khong dgung lo bcu bzhir la gtad pa'i spyi 'o 1696bod me byi lor sde srid kyis nyi ma thang pa 'i zhabs drung ngag dbang gzhin ma pe cin du ched kyi ra mngags btang ste sgong ma khang shir tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa sku 0shegs pa'i gsang brtol snyan seng dang 'brel yang srid po ta lar gdan zhu chog pa zhus thogaspyi lo 697bod me glang lo'i zlamatshes29nyin bzhi nas bod yongs la gsang rgya bkrol ba'i khyab bsgrags dang 'brel lo de'i zla 10tshes26nyin tshangs dbyangs

162 ga /chab sposatshe brtan sun tshogs kyi ma rig brtsam chos phyag bsgrigs/— — wa wa rgya mtsho po ta la'i bzhugs khrir mnga' gsol zhus/ skabs de'i chab srid kyi gnas tshul ni yam yom che tsam yod de/ sde srid kyis gcig sacod lta bus tā la'i sku greng lnga pa sku gshegs pa de yun ring lo ngo bco lnga tsam bar gsang rgya gnang ba dang / tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid kyang glo bur du phyir bton pa bcas kyi skor ching gong ma khang shi'i thugs la mi 'thad pa byung ba ni dper na rjes su btsugs pa'i zhol khang ser rdo brkos kyi yi ger mu pas tā la'i bla ma sku gshegs pa lo bcu drug gi bar gsang nas rang dgar spyod pa zhes sogs gsal ba las mtshon pa ma zad/ sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs nang khul du'ang rna bar mi 'gro ba'i rnam 'gyur ci rigs thon yod de sde srid rang gis brtsams pa'i (rab gsal gser gyi snye ma 〉(gsham du bsdus ming du (gser snye 〉zhes 'god rgyu )nang du'ang gzhung 'bas khag gcig nas da bar gsang rgya gnang ba zhes mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi sna shu bud pa sogs byung zhes gsal zhing / sog po yon bdag gi thad la mtshon rung / skabs de'i yas mas su gu shri'i sras bstan 'dzin da la'i khang gi sras bgres pa bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal dang gzhon pa lha bzang lang gnyis nang khul ma mthun pa byung lar/ sde srid kyis bar gsed gnang ste lha bzang lang mtsho sngon du slos pa dang / dus mtshungs mtsho sngon du yod pa'i sos po dpon khag tsho yang nang khul ma 'cham par zing cha che zhing / da la'i da'i ching gis da yan hong tha'i ji bslu thabs kyis bsad pa sogs stong 'khor gyi tshogs 'dur legs lam ma byung ba/ thun gar phyags nas tshe dbang rab brtan gyis sde srid kyi gnang sgo gang sar skyon 'dzugs kyi gleng gzhi mang ba'i khar/ lhag par gsar du phebs pa'i yang srid la log mthong ci rigs byed pa sogs phyi nang gang thad nas gra ma 'gris gi rgyu rkyen du ma gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung tshul sogs gsal ba'i mjug tu

rig /(tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur sku 〉dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos 'a 'a /6 3—— — 6phyi nang bya spyod gang cir gong sa mchog thugs 'tshig pa lta bus/ da ni slob sanyer byas zhan 'dra sasungs te thugs skyid lug mdzad par sde srid dang /snye sku mdun pa sogs nas snyan skul ji zhus la gsan dgongs med pa (〈gser snyen )zhes 'khod pa de thog nas long tā la'i khri la 'khod pa'i rjes su'ang khor yu ga gi gnas tshul lam du ma lhongs pa'i 'grel rkyen ji snyed cig 'phrad pa de dag gis sku gzhon nu'i dus byung ba'i skyo bsun gyi thugs ngal sel rgyu ltar bzhagade bas dza drag dang gting zab pa'i skyo bdung gi phyogs su khrid pa bcas ni tshangs dbyangs rgya mchos tshul 'chos kyi rgyun sril dang mi mthun pa'i mdzad spyod sna tshogs shig skyong ba'i phyi rol yul gyi cha rkyen du gyur nga nge nga tshos mthong thub bo /gnyis pa/ tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho po ta la'i khri la bzhugs skabs gzhan dbang bi chings rgya las thar thabs dang / rang dbang brtson len gnang ba'i mtshon tshul lo rgyus kyi don dngos 'ga' zhigade yang / ma'o kru'u zhis cadangos gtso'i rtsod sgrub rigs pas phyi rkyen ni 'gyur ldog yong ba'i cha rkyen dang / nang rkyen ni 'gyur ldog yong ba'i gzhi rtsa yin pas phyi rkyen gyi nus pa de'ang nang rkyen la brten nas thon gyi yo da par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod ( 〈 'gal ba'i rnam bshad 〉 )ces sasungs pa ltar gtso bo ni khong rang nyid kyi thugs sa sa de mi gzhan gyis bzo bkod dang len

164 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi mari ba mas phyogs bsgrims —byed rgyur mi dgyes pa dang / rang dbang gi mdzad spyod skyong rgyu kho na don gnyer mdzad mkhan zhig yin stabs dgung na rim son dang chabs cig rang tshugs kyi gnang sgo spel shugs je cher gyur te sde srid sogs nas gsal 'debs dang /thabs sgo gang gzab kyis gcun thabs gnang rungade bas ldog phyogs su gyur par brten mthar khong rang gi mkhan po paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes mchog nas slob ston gnang rgyur re bcol zhu dgos pa sogs byung yod// de'i skor paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa'i rang rnam (spyod tshul gsal bar byed pa 'od dkar can gyi phreng ba 〉nang sde srid rin po ches gsung shog phebs lasal/ gong sa rang gi mdzad pa ra ci zhus kyang gsan bzhes med cing /blos 'khyud dka' ba'i bka' phebs pa de khar gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i thugs 'dun 'dug pas dngos kyi snyan 'bul dang / de thog thugs rdzogs ba'es na bsams snyan 'bul yang yang zhus par/ bla ma los mjal gsungs pa las/dus zhus par gsal ba mi gnang ba bcas kyis rim 'gyangs gyur bar/ nye lam 'o na de ga byas chog nga rang gis kyang zhu yig dang bcas skog gzhon gnang rgyu zhes dpyad bzo dka' ba'i gsung shog dang / de mtshungs zla ba de kha'i mjug tsam la thams cad mkhyen pa 'i thugs dam phebs pa'i nang de ga nas bka' rim pa ra phebs byung ba zhu lan phul ba ltar/ nged rang gong ma'i shul zin tshogs dbu sogs su 'gro rgyu blo 'dod mi 'dug sde pas 'di gar spyan 'dren gyis bka' chos solas zhu dathos rang zer ba bla ma mjal bar mi spro rgyu mi 'dug pas gdan 'dren pa 'di ba song bas char chu ma rgyas gong phyir phebs chog pa 'dug pas yong dgos tshul skos grong nas 'byor yang babs mi legs gshis/ 'gro ma 'dod nas cung zad lams mi bde tshul gyis slar mi ring bar yong chog pa sogs gses bkrol zhu yis rim par phul yang / paṇa

chig /dzotshangs dbyang rgya mtsho'i mgur sku 〉 dang 'brel ba'i lo sa kyi don dngos 'ga'/ 165chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi skyabadung sogs mjal bar chibs bsgyur gnang rtsis yod tshul solas phebs par/ yar chibs bsgyur bskyangs rgyu skabs su ma che bas 'phral du bcar chos pa'i zhu yig rim can dang bcas dam slong 'dar pa rdzong bda' byas/ ngos zla drug pa'i tshes gsum nyin 'di nas thon te byang brgyud 'gro rtsis yin kyang / dga' ldan rab rgyas su slebs skabs dbo slong phyir 'khor brjod gsal/ chibs bskyel zhu ma thub pa ra chibs bsgyur thag chod 'dus tshul byung ba/ lam seng rong la ma brgyud 'ag sanyis song mtshams yar 'brog 'dab lung du thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal thams cad mkhyen pas myang brgyud nas phebs rgyu dang / phran ngos rong brgyud nas phyir log ste tshes bco lnga nyin bkra shis lhun por 'byor/ tshes nyi shu nyin thams cad mkhyen pa ston 'khor bkra shis kun porarabs sor 'khod/ 'ji gar rgyun sang ring bzhugs ngos tsholas dbur sasung chos dang / zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu yin tshul solasagasol 'debs zhus par don smin bka' bzhes ma byung zhing sku zhabs rin po che sku dngos kyi ma/dzad tshul ston par/ nged rang ngos nas snyan 'bul zhus par ma zad/ sde srid rin po ches dbus rgyal yum/ se 'bras dka' 0sum gyis snyan 'bul nan zhus khar/ bdag nyid nas sngon du gsol ba btab pa bzhin mtha' dbus gdul bya'i snang ngor bstan 'gro spyi sgos thams cad la thusas rjes ma bor ba'i mdzad pa rnam thar mtha' das mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po ji bzhin gyi tshul bzhes dang / dam nga 'i chos kyi 'khor 'o bskor ba'i gsol 'debs nan chasas rten sasum zhu phyag 'bul gsum byas rung / bka' bzhes ma sanang zhi nga / 'ur stabs kyi rnam pas phebs te nyi 'od phyi nas sku phyag gsum gnang ste bla ma'i bka' bcag pa mthol lo bshags gsungs ba spel mar gnang nas phebs pa sogs bya thabs ma byung ba dang /

166 ga / ba spel tshe ba na gun tshosas kyi rtsom ri brtsams cho phyog bsgrig /— — pha ga rjes su'ang zhu yig rim pa dang bcas mu nan gang che byas kyang ma smin khar/sngar thob kyi rab byung dang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa phyir 'bul ma smin na nged bkra shis lhun po rang la kha gtad de rtsebs pa don gdam la'i gsal dgos phebs pa blos ma 'khyud pas sde srid rin po che nas gsol 'debs kyi grogs su rdzong bda' gnang ba de mo sprul sku/ sems pa sprul sku/ stag rtse zhabs drung / rgyal sras lha bzang / se 'bras kyi slob dpon/ spyi gnyer bcas gros bstun nas mgrin gcig tu gsol 'debs zhus pa dang / sger gyis rim zhus bcas par bka' phebs je zhan las ma byung zhing / snga sor de skor gyi gnas tshul 'bras spungs spyi sor stsal ba sde srid rin po che nas 'dir gnang ba sogs dgongs gzhi dpyad dka' zhing / gleng sna tshogs dang / don gdam ga'i bka' mtha' sdug de bzhin phebs pa bcas thugs rdzogs lta ci smos rab byung sngar bzhes spyo kyang shugs ma thub kyis dor sanang dang / mthar sku skya chas su mi bsgyur ba dang / mi ring ba bar ma rab byung thugs rdzogs bzhes te chos kyi 'khor lo bsgor ba sogs nged rang gis dbus tshang mas gsol 'debs zhus kyang ma smin pa sa sde srid rin po cher ji byung gi gnas tshul zhib pa gul/ gzhis ka rtser bzhugs zhag bcu bdun bzhugs te phyir phebs jizhes gsal yod thong gsal gyi don rkyen byung ba'i lo dus ni spyi lo 1702bod rab byung bcu gnyis pa 'i chu rta lo'i dbyar dus te/ tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dgung grangs hril ngo bcu dgu'am/lo ngo nyi shur phebs pa'i skabs yin cing / paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pas 'dir dge lugs grub mtha'i la rgya gzhir bzung mdzes mtshon gang thub gnang ba smos ma dgos kyang / rang nyid tā la'i sku phreng drug pa'i yongs 'dzin yin stabs mdzad spyod 'di ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi 'gan 'khri g.yol thabs med pa zhig bsnams yod par brten/ rtsa don rnams gsal bshad ma gnang ka med byung

ga /(tshang dbyang rgyasatsho'i mgur glu 〉dang 'brel ba'i tsho rgyus kyi don dngos 'ga'/167———————— ——yod/ nga tshos dum bu 'dir zhib rtog byas na tshangs dbyangs mtshos chos srid zung 'brel lam lugs kyi chings zhags las 'grol chod 'thab rtsod lo 'ga' shas gnang ba nge rtse mor son nas 'gog rkyen mtha' dag sel thog rab byung gi sdom pa dor te dngos su na bza' skya chas bzhes shing / 'dod yon gyi rtsed dgar rang dbang gis dgyes rgur rol ba'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos de gsal rjen du mtshon gyi yod/ skyed dung skabs nge'i sanas tshul la khu slong zhig byas na gong du pa rṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa 'i gsung rnam nang nyi 'od kyi phyi nas sku phyas gsum gnang ste bla ma'i bka' bcas pa mthol lo bshags sasungs pa spel mar gnang nas phebs zhes gsal ba spel mar sasungs pa zer ba ni nyung mthar yang bka' mol tshig gnyis re mos kyis bskyar bzlos this/ yod dgos pa los yin/de skor skabs der bkra shis lhun por 'bras spungs kyi 'thus mir phebs mkhan sgo mang mkhan po ngag dbang brtson 'grus te/'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng dang po de'i (rnam thar ngo mtshar skal bzang 'jug ngosas 〉zhes pa 'i shog ngos 47mdun 'khod par/ khong ris song sa rin ngo cher phyag sasum 'tshal te khyed gangs can gyi skyabs gnas sacig pu yin pas bstan 'gro kun la brtse bas dgongs te de ltar mi gnang bar zhu 'es gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs zhus kyang / 0dul bya'i bsod nams dman pa 'i dbang gis gsan dgongs ma gnang bar nyin bcig pa'o chen rin po che'i gzim chung bi mdo nas sku phas sasam 'tshal nas da nga'i dge tshal i bslab pa phal yod rdo zhes rig sko riri rig 2juḥ/ rari gsung shugs chen pos mu gnang nas de nas bzung na bza' skya chas bzhes/zhes gsal bas des na gzim chung nyi 'od kyi mdo nas sku phyas gnang skabs bla ma'i bka' bcas pa mthol lo ba las/da nga'i dbe tshul gyi bslab pa phul

/68 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyisham rig brtsam chos phyog bsgri ༈ —wa wa—wa walnge wa ————wa wa—wa rkewa —wa wa—yod do gsungs pa gnyis spel mar gnang ba ra 'phrod cing / de bzhin paṇa chen rin po ches rnamathar na bza' skya chas su mi 'gyur ba gsol 'debs zhus kyang ma smin jizhes gsal ba ltar de nyin nas bzung na bza' grwa chas phud de skya chas ba'es pa de yang gsal po byung yod/3 'o na khong gis na bza' mchas bzhes dus sku'i cha byad ci 'dra zhig yod dam snyam na / dus mnyam pa 'i bla ma sle lung bzhad pa rdo rje zhes mtshan snyan yongs su khyab pa de'i gsung rnam (sle lung rje drung blo bzang 'phrin las kyi rang rnam skal bzang dga' ston 〉zhes pa'i shog ngos33rgyab/ khong dgung lo chung ngu'i skabs ‘ rgyal dbang rin po che'i sku mdun du skra phud 'bul bar phyin/gsol dpon mkhan pos gong sa rin po ce'irnam sras gan mdzod kyi 'asag tu phebs yod pas mjal khar shog bka' 'dri gnang byung na sku skye chung bas yong mi 'gro/ rgan pa tshos zhus gsungs pa de nged rang gis zhus chog pas thusas mnyes/ nge nas mthul khar phyin par gong sa rin po che gos ling sngo skya'i lu ba thag srab mo zhig bzhes/ dbu skra snyan gsham la slebs tsam dang / phyag sor thams cad la phyag rgyan sogs bzhes pa'i sku ga'ogs g.yas g.yon rnams su sku 'khor rnams na bza' ya ma gzugs sna tshogs dang / mda' dong dang /phyag chod sogs bsnams te bzheng bzhugs 'dug rgyal dbang mchog nas/gsol dpon chen mor sku rtsed kyi rnam pas// da res rje drung sprul skur/ a ne ting ting sgrol ma 'dos rgyu yin zhes sku rtsed mdzad de lam seng rdzong rgyab tu phyag mdar phebs song zhes gsal yod pa de las kyang / nga tshos skabs de'i khong gi sku'i cha byad dang / mdzad spyod/ gsungs tshul sogs ci 'dra yod pa rags tsam zhig rtogs thub/4 ma gzhi tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos tshul 'chos rgyun srol gyi bsdams

rig kyi khungs dbyangs rtsa macu'i mgur rmu 〉dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos 'a 'a/ 169——wa wa bcings la ngo rgol gnangan yang / sde srid sogs kyis da dung dngos skag zhi drag gang thad nas sta ngas 'dzin dang 'gog rkyen mu mthud byas par brten 'gal ba dza dras tu gyur te tha na mi 0sod khrag sbyor gyi don rkyen yang lhag yod pa/ dper na skabs der snyan grags che ba'i rnying ma'i bla ma smin gling gter chen ( ter bdas gling pa 'gyur med rdo rje )gyi slob mas (che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi rnam par thar pa las 'phros pa'i byung ba brjod pa gdung ba'i mun sol 〉zhes pa'i nang 'khod par/ de'i tshe rgyal dbang rin po che'i mdzad pa ra pod sog gi mi rigs mcho ngo sa log mthong dang / skur 'debs ci rigs yo nga gi yod pa ra sde srid rin ngo ches phyogs gcig nas gdan sa'i slob dpon dngagalas sne sogs la nang don bka' slob gnang ste rgyal ba'i mdzad par log mthong mi yong ba'i ched tshogs dang chos rar dbe 'dun rnams 'a gsal 'debs na mar zhu dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang gi yod pa dang / phyogs gcis nas drung 'khor mthar rgyas nas kyis sku zhabs bslad pa yin pas das rang med pa bcos na slobs che ba yo nga zer nas sde srid che mo dang / mda' dpon dga' chags pa / dar byung nas/ drung yis bstan 'dzin dbang po/ a pho lnga 'dzoms sogs bka' gros mdzad/ sku zhabs rdzong rgyab tu phyag mdar phebs/ mun mtshams su gsung glu dang bcas log phebs skabs mthar rgyas pa lam nas sasod rtsis la/ de nyin sku zhabs nas bzhes pa'i na bza' mthar rgyas nas la rga/yogs pa gnang / khong gi bos sayog por g.yosas pa sa nor te dga' chags pas g.yog por gri brgyab nas bsad/ de nor ba shes nas mthar rgyas nas la la'an zhig nas gri gzhus par dga' rab rmas te 'gyel yang sasod ma thub/ der brten sgrog cha shin tu che zhing rim gyis mkhyen te a pho lnga 'dzoms zangs rna me 'bar mar bskyon te rdzong bskor la khrid/ ga'an

/70 ga /chab spel tshe brtan phun tshog kyi rtsom rig ba mas chos cag ba tho / rnams khrag sbyor gnang / de nas 'go nyes lta bu'i 'khrug zing chen po dang /khyad par sde srid chen mor sku zhabs nas mi mnyes pa'i tshul mdzad mices gsal yod/ de'i thog nas skabs der khong gi mdzad spyod des yo khyom dang sbir grags chen po ji tsam zhig byung yod pa'ang nga tshos tshod dpag byed thub/5 tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho ni thugs bag yangs pos rtse dga'i 'dod yon gyi 'tsho ba spyi dang / bye brag sku gzhas kyi sgyu rtsal la mchog tu mnyes pa zhig yin/khong gis sku 'khor rnams 'khrid nas rtag par rdzong rgyab tu phyag mda' sanang bar phebs pa dang / mun rub mtshams su mgur glu dang bcas phyir log gnang gi yod pa'i tshul gong du gsal ba tsam ma zad/ sku ngo mas mgur glu gnang ba dang pags ljags rtsom mdzad pa'i skor (sle lung rje drung blo bzang 'phrin las kyi rang rnam skal bzang dga' ston 〉nang 'khod par/ 6gong sa rin po che chos 'khor rgyal nas tshur lam lhun grub khang gsar du gdan 'dren mdzad song bar chos 'khor rgyal nas nam langs la phebs pa mar lam chu bzang /chos lung sogs brgyud de zhol du tsha rting khar chibs kha bsgyur byung / de nyin nyin 'khyongs kyi bar bzhugs shing / thog steng nas zhal mjal zhus chog pa'i skal ba shin tu bzang / sku gzhogs sayas g.yon thams cad dag chang gis khengs pa/ phyag phyi rnams kyang kun spyod sna tshogs pa bcas las ma dag pa'i skye bo rnams blor mi chud pas ha las su byed/ de nyin kyang sde srid ngag dbang rin chen dang / de mo sprul pa'i sku sogs zhabs phyi tshang ma bzhes khrung gis bad pas ngo tsha dang bral ba'i spyod ngan sna tshogs dang / phan tshun du sgor nas bzhengs bzhugs mi thub pa tsam 'dug kyang / gong sa mchog ni 'gyur ldog skad cig tsam med pa ra slob ston dang / bka' rtsom phyag bris/ gsung glu gnang ba thams cad kyang 'khrul med du gnang zhing thugs 'khrol bas zhal mjal dang / gsung

rdza /(tshang dbyang rgya mas mgur glu 〉dang wel ba'i lo rgyus kyi don dathem 'ga'/ 171mjal gang 'dod byung zhes gsal yod/ de dang de 'dra ba'i 'brel yod lo rgyus kyi yig cha da dung yod srid kyang / skabs 'phral lag son ma thub pa dper na/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rang nyid kyis rtsom sgrig gnang ba'i (thams cad mkhyen pa sku drug pa blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba nges don gyi rnam par thar pa ba bral gser gyi a dar sha 〉 zhes pa bris ma zhig yo da pa de'i nang mdzad tshul zhib tsam 'bod yod tshul rgan rabs tshos sasungs pa go myong zhing / nges tshod gcig la long bis gri dang thag pa bsnams te sde srid kyi sar phebs nas lus la rang dbang med gyur na/ gson por bsdad nas snying po ci/ zhes gsungs te sku srog lceb rgyu'i rnam pa ston gnang mdzad tshul sogs 'khod yod skad thos rung / rang gis dngos su ma mthong bas phra zhib zhu mi spobs pa lta bu yin/ 'on kyang gong du drangs pa'i dum bu 'di dag kyang skabs de'i bod kyi bla chen chos srid gang thad nas yongs grags kyi mtshan snyan ldan pa 'ga' tshig gi gsung rnam las thog ma'i tshig don ji ma ji bzhin zur 'don byas shing / de yang mang che ba bla ma so so'i rang rnam rang rtsom gnang ba las drangs pa yin sta bas slob ma dang nye sanas sogs kyis bris pa 'i 'ud bstod kyi mdzad rnam dang mi 'dra bar don dngos mtshon shugs che tsam yod pa dang lhas pa ra 'di dag nang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshor dgos dbang gis sgro btags skur 'debs kyi rigs rtsa ba nas yong mi srid pa ni bla ma so so'i lo rgyus nas zhib bsher 'pher ba sha stag yin/ skabasade'i spyi tshogs thos skye bo kun gyi mthong chos myong gyur yin pa'i khong gi thugs gshis dang mdzad spyod ngo ma de lta bu'i sanas tshul 'os (mgur glu 〉 'di 'dra zhig brtsams spel gnang ba de la ya mtshan rgyu dang / yid mi ches pa byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan spu tsam yang med pa nus ldan gyi ra sprod byung yod /

172 sngag chab spel tshe 0rtan sun tsho sa kyi ma ris brtsam cho phyogs bsgrigs/gsum pa/ lo rgyus kyi don dngos mtshon pa'i gzu dpang 'ga' zhigagacig mgur glu'i nang don thog nas lo rgyus kyi don dngos mtshon pa// mtshan ldan bla ma'i drung du/ sems khrid zhu bar phyin pa sa/sems pa sgor kyang mi thub/ byams pa'i phyogs la shor song /zhes pa 'di ni song du bkra shis lhun por pa ṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa mjal bar phebs skabs paṇa chen gyis chos srid gang thad nas zhal ta zhib rgyas nan tan gnang rung / 'ur stabs kyi rnam pas phebs te nyi 'od kyi phyi nas sku phyag gsum gnang zhing / bla ma'i blde'u bcas pa mthol lo bshags gsungs pa spel mar gnang nas phebs zhes gsal ba de'i nyin tho lta bu zhis mi 'dug gam/2 dur smrig mdog gis bsgyur bas/ bla ma yong gi yod na/mtsho stod ser bya ngang pas/ 'gro ba 'dren pa 'dug gozhes pa 'di'ang paṇa chen gsung rnam nang namathar sku skya chas su mi bsgyur ba dang / mi ring bar bar ma rab byung thugs rdzogs bzhes te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs nged rang gis dbus tshang mas sasol 'debs zhus kyang ma smin 〉zhes gsal ba ltar khong bis na bza' ngur smrig gsol rgyu zhal bzhes mi gnang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyi bsdoms zig gsal po zhig gnang ba mthong thub/3 brag dang rlung po bsdebs nas/ rgod po'i sgro la gzan byung /g.yo can rdzu bag can gyis/ nga la gzan po byas byung /zhes pa 'di las/ sde srid dang / mda' dpon dga' chags pa/ dar byung nas/ drung yig bstan 'dzin dbang po/ ma pho lnga 'dzoms sogs ser skya mi drag

— rdza /(sgomadabyangam rgya ma' dista ra glu )/rda 'brelaba'i lo rgyus kyi don da/ma 'ga'/ 173khag gcig nas phyi tshul du khong la dad zhen brtsi bkur chen po zhu ba'i rdzu bag ston na'ang lkog tu sayo sgyu'i sbyor ba sna tshosas brtsams nas long gi mdzad spyod la drag rtsub kyi 'thog rtsol byas pa sogs thugs la phog thug chen po byung tshul rnams mtshon gyi mi 'dus sam/ 4 sprin pa kha ser gting nas sad dang ser ba'i gzhi ma/ban de skya min ser min/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo/zhes pa 'di ni/ phyogs gcis nas bslab sdom med par grwa chas gyon pa de di 'dul ba'i bstan pa la gnod tshabs che ba zhig yin dgongs pa'i khong rang ri thugs 'dod gsal ston gnang ba dang / phyogs sa'an zhis nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshor bsun 'byin gnang ba zhig yin snya ma/ de dus sde srid kyis na bza' grwa chas ba'es shing / phyi tshul du bla ma nang bzhin sanang rung mdzad spyod la la ci 'dra zhig yod ce na ( che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi byung ba brjod pa sadung ba'i mun sel 〉 nang sde srid mchog sku dbang btsan zhing /bde yangs gsum skas 'go'i bka' shos tu/ rgyun du bas med kyi jo mo bzhes pa sogs mdzad mi chog pa la dus phyis 'chi med dga' tshal dngazha dpal rab khang gsar gyi bdag mo gnyis bzhes te che 'don bdag rkyen yongs gra4sa mdzad pa dang / de dus lha sa dang / phyogs nas yong ba'i skye dman kha stabs drag tshad sde srid rang nas ma bzhes pa med ces sogs gsal ba dang /lo rgyus kyi yig cha 0zhan du mar yang sde srid la sras dang sras mo mang po yod pa'i skor sogs 'khod pa ltar gnang stangs de dag la bsteng tshig gsungs pa gsal por mtshon gyi yod/6 ma byas mi kha snang ba/ nga dang pho rog nag chung /byas kyang mi kha min 'dug khong dang skya khra hor pa/

174 ga chab spel tshe brtan gun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams cho phyogs bsgrigs/wa wazhes pa 'di yang skabs de'i gzhung zhabs dang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyi bla ma las sne sogs nas khong gi mdzad spyod la skyon 'dogs mang po byed kyang / gne srid kyi mngon sum 'dzem bag med pa'i gnas tshul de lta bur lab gleng gang yang med pa brtsi bkur zhu rkyang byed pa'i gleng phyogs la thugs ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur ston gnang mdzad pa mthong thub/6 mi tshos nga la lab pa dgongs su dag pa khag thesayosalo'i gom gsum phra mo/ lanas mo'i nang la thal song /zhes pa 'di las/ gong du gsal ba ltar de'i tshe rgyal dbang rin po che'i mdzad par bod sog si mi rigs mang pos log mthong dang / skur 'debs ci rigs yong gi yod pa zhes 'khod don bzhin don dngos dang mthun pa'i mi mang gi skyon brjod dang len gnang ba'i khong i thugs rgyud bzang po de'ang gang legs mtshon pa yin snyam/ gzhan yang /rtsi thos ba mo'i la la/ skyi ser rlung gi pho nya/me tog sbrang bu gnyis kyi/ 'brel mtshams gcod mkhan los yin/zhes dang / khyi zan rgya lu zer ba/ rnam shes mi las spyang ba/srod la slebs byung zer gyi/ tho rengs los song zer gyi/yang / srod la byams pa btsal bas/ tho rengs kha ba babs byung /gsang dang ma gsang mi 'dus zhabs rjes sangs la bzhag song /zhes pa la sogs pa 'di dag gi thog nas kyang sde srid kyi 'gag bya che ba dang / spyi tshogs lam lugs kyi bsnams shugs 'og khong gi rtse dga'i mdzad spyod rnams lkog lkog sud sud ngang gnang dbos kyi yod pa 'i skabs de'i rnam pa dngos gsal bar mtshon pa sogs 'di tsam zhig dpe mtshon du bkod pa'i thog nas kyangalamagur glu'i nang gi tshig don mang po zhig gi skabs de'i lo

rna/(chas dbyang rgya mtha mgur glu nyis 'brel ba'i lo rgyus kyi rdon dngo ri 'ga'/ 175———rgyus kyi byung ba dngos dang mthun pas khong ri ljags rtsom ngo ma yin par de bas nges shes 'dren thub pa zhig mi 'dugagam/gnyis/ dmangs khrod du yongs grags chaba'i lo rgyus kyi rjes shul dang (mgur glu 〉 par ma rnying ma'i thog nas kyang lo rgyus kyi don dngos mtshon pa/1 de snga'i lha sa rnying pa cha rgyus yod pa'i mi tshang mas mthong chos myong gyur gyi dngos yod gnas tshul zhig ni/ gna' rabs kyi grong khyer 'dir dgon pa dang lha khang la la'i lte bar sa rtsi dmar ser byugs pa nyung shas tsam yod pa rgyud/ de byings grong mi drag zhan gyi khang khyim che chung la ma ltos par mi rigs kyi yul srol bzhin sa rtsi dkar po zhe cis btang yod/ 'on kyang bod kyi grong brdal gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar lha zhol gyi grong mi'i sdod khang gi khrod du de snga nas sa rtsi ser po byugs pa'i khang ser zer ba thar thor 'ig gang sar mthong rgyu yod pa dper na/ thal phung sgang ṣka khang ser ldo ma zhes pa dang / shar bsam grub khang gsar zhes pa / lho bkra shis khang gsar zhes pa/ de bzhin sbra zhol khul 'jang tsha tshang dang / ldan ma khang ser/ lcang sdong tshang / 'bri na ra zer ba sogs/ bar skor mdung rtse'i zur gyi khang ser/ nyag rong sheg bi 'gram lang ser ma zer ba/ khrom gzigs lang gi byang ngos su spo cod phun khang zer ba/shar spyi khyab khul tshal shar zer ba sogs yod pa de das khang ser yin pa da lta'i rgan rabs mang por nges rnyed gsung rgyu 'dug cing / deng skabs dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa ni klu sbrug go bo lang ser tsam zhig lo rgyus kyi bden dpang lta bur bsdad pa las/ de min la la rim bzhin lang pa gsar rgyag khongs tshud pa dngaka 'ga' shas khang pa dngos bzhi bsdad yod rung / rig gsar yas mas nas sa rtsirakar por bsgyur zin pas da cha mngon gsal med par gyur pa dang / da dung bgres rabs rgyus can la bka' 'dri zhu dus de snga lha zhol khul

176 ji /chab spelatshebartanasun ga kyirnamari brtsams cag ba sa wa khang ser de gras bcu phrag 'ga' shas yod pa red ces gsung gi 'dug des na tshang mas mkhyen gsal bzhin rang cag rgya khyab bod mi rigs kyi khrod du chos lugs dang 'brel ba yod pa'i goms srol ltar na sa rtsi ser po ni lha khang re zung dang / gtso bo tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs yul pho brang sogs la byugs pa'i dmigs bsal gyi thob thang chen po zhis yin pa las/grong mi rang ga ba par bzhag sde dpon che khag gi khang pa la'ang sa rtsi ser po rtsa ba nas byugs mi chog pa yin mod/ 'on kyang lha sa'i khang ser de tsho'i dang sngar nas bzung lha khang med la/ gtso khang tsam yang dmigs su med pa'i ches gyir btang gi grong mi mang tshogs sdod pa'i khang pa sha stag yin/ 'o nade lta bu'i dmangs khyim pal par mi lo brgya phrag brgal ba'i ring lo ltar sa rtsi ser po byugs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig yin zhe na/ mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud pa'i lha sa'i mang tshogs kyi gcig gyur shod rgyun la/ khang ser de dag ni rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho sku gzhon nu'i skabs khrung bzhes gnang sa'am/gsang grogs bsten nas mtshan gzim gnang myong ba'i khang pa yin pa'i rkyen gyis sa rtsi ser po byugs pa red ces yongs su grags pa de ni da lta 'tsho bzhugs kyi lha sa ba ser skya gan rabs tshang mas mkhyen pa ma zad/ da phan mi lo sum brgyar nye ba'i dus yun nang pha gtam bu 'jags kyi shod srol gnyis pa med pa de ni ljongs yongs kyi mang tshogs spyi'i khrod du'ang bag chags gting zab yod pa zhig yin/ da dung bgres rabs mang por bcar 'dri zhus pa'i skabs thal phung sgang gi khang ser lho ma zer ba dang / sto bkra shis khang gsar gnyis kyi nang de snga tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i bzhugs khri yin zhes pa'i sa khri chung chung re yod pa dang / bkra shis (bsam grub )khang gsar nang du/ dgong gcig khrung mal brgyab pas/ rma lor snang rtse shag nas/ ske la sba sgor g.yogs byung /5 zhes

ga (tshangs dbyangs rgya mcho'i ma0 rmu 〉dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus kyi don dbyus 'ga'/ 177————pa'i dmangs gnas kyang gtong srol yod spu red ces ngo sprod gnang byung /des na sog po lha bzang gi phyogs gtogs dang de rjes kyi dbang bsgyur pa rim can sus kyang lo rgyus kyi don dngos mtshon pa'i mang tshogs kyi bshad rgyun dang rjes shul khang ser de dag rtsa med bzo thub med/ 'on kyang bar lam zhig la grub mtha'i phyogs ris can re zung gis zer na lang ser de tsho ni sog po lha bzang khang gis tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshor mtshan shas bzo phyir bzos pa zhig yin gyi red ces bshad mkhan yang byung skad 'dus de ni lo rgyus kyi byung tshul ngo ma dang mi mthun pata cang gsal po yin/ lha bzang khang gis tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'dul khrims kyi bcas pa las 'gal ba'i mdzad spyod de dag rgyu mtshan du byas nas khong tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid min mas gong ma khung shis lasnyan seng zhus te khri las phab thog pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho zhes pa zhis po ta la'i khri la bsod de tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa yin pa'i gser tham gnang rogs zhus don ching bong ma khang shis nas cabaka' yis zhus bskyangs byed pa tā la'i bla ma drug pa'i tham ga zhes 'khod pa'i gser —tham zhig sprad pa sogs lo rgyus kyi yig rigs dang / srid gzhung rnying pa'i tham deb kyi nang du'ang gsal thag chod 'chod yo da/ gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos khrung ba'es sam gsang grosas bsten yul gyi khang khyim la lha bzang khang gis sa rtsi ser po gsol srid kyi red dam sa rtsi ser po sasol ba des tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho ri sang ltar tā la'i bla ma'i sku phreng yin pa khas blangs te tha na khong dgong gcis gzims pa'i khang pa yin rung / rgyal ba bzhugs myong ba'i gnas mchos tu brtsis nas bkur gzos chen po zhus pa yongs su mtshon pas gal srid de lha bzang khang nas byas pa yin zer na/ rang la rang gis 'gram lcag gzhus pa gis min na gang yin nam/ lo rgyus 'khyog

178 ra / ba spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi rtsom ris ba mas cho cags bsgrigs/————rtewa ge bshad byed pa'i skad cha de tshor don dngos kyi rkang pa 'dzugs sa med stabs mang tshogs tshos rkang 'og gi thal bar brtsis nas gzhi med du btang yod/mdor na sus kyang gsar bzo dang dag bsub gtong thabs med pa'i lo rgyus kyi shul dngos dang / rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi khrod du mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud pa'i shugs rkyen ha cang zab la rlung ltar grags pa'i gcig gyur gyi ngag rgyun 'di dgasha thog nas tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur spu 'di rigs brtsams zhes gnang ba'i sa gnas 'ga' zhig kyang 'di dang 'di dag tu yin snyam pa'i nga tshor rjes dran zab mo zhig 'jog srid kyi red/2 dngos byung rtsod med lo rgyus kyi bshad grol de mi rabs nas mi rabs bar rgyun chags su brgyud par brten nas bod rnying pa'i nang da phan mi lo brgya phrag gsum la nye ba'i ring (tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu 〉de bod rigs mi dmangs yongs kyi khrod khyab gdal du grags shing / 'dzem bya gang yang med par yul dus so bo'i dmangs cod gzhas mdangs sna tshogs kyi gzhas tshig tu bcug ste gang sar gtong rkyang byed pa ma zad/ sger gnyer slob grwa lag gi nang slob phrug tsho yig gzugs 'khri stong byed pa'i yig dpe'i tshig gzhir yang bed spyod byed pa sogs bod rigs mi dmangs nang dga' zhen dang shugs rkyen ha cang zab pas zam mi 'chad par rgyun 'dzin byas yod padang / lhag par du de snga 6mgur glu'i gzhas tshig ched bsgrigs byas pa zhig lha sa'i par pa spyi pas shing par du bskos pa'i dpe thung dpe khrom gang sar bton te rgya khyab mang tshogs kyis rang 'dod ltar nyo sgrub byed pa sogs ni da lta'i sgon rabs tsho'i mig mthong lag zin gyi don dngos shig yin/ bya ba de dag la de snga'i bod kyi chos srid dbang 'dzin pa su zhig gis kyang bkag 'gog dang dam bsgrags par bzhag rtsad zhib tsam byed mkhan byung med la/ chos lugs grub mtha' khag

rdzi /(tshangs dbyang snyo mtsho mgur sku 〉 dang stsol ba'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos 'a 'a/ 179dang rtsom ris pa ser skya sus kyang yin min gyi klan ka chags pa'i lo 'phros tsam go rgyu med par gong 'og tshang mas de ni dngos yod kyi lo rgyus rtsom rigs shis dang / dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i gsung rtsom bston med cis tu brtsis te snyan grags yongs su khyab yod/ bod rigs mang tshogs kyi khrod du yun ring rgyun chasas su gnas pa'i don dngos de das gi thog nas kyang mig sngar (tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur gru 〉zhes pa de khong rang nyid kyi gsung rtsomar ma e yin zer ba'i klan ka zhig gsar du thon pa de ni gzhi 'dzin sa med pa'i 'ol tshod cig yin pa ra 'phrod gang legs byung yod/gsum/ ngag dbang rdo rjes brtsams pa'i khong i (posang ba'i rnam thar 〉(bsham du 〈 gsang rnam 〉zhes bsdus ming 'bod rgyu )zer ba de'i nang du'ang bsam zhib byed yul yod pa/1 zhugasang rnam 〉 zer ba de'i nang / khong dgung lo bco lngar tā la'i sku pheng lnga pa'isgong srid du mnga' gsol zhus pa nas/ dasang lo nyer lnga par khri zhe ga dmi byi smyo ga las ma phab bar gyi lo ngo bcu tham pa de'i ring bi mdzad pa yongs rdzogs dril bar shog lte gcis tsam la sa bris med cing / nang don gnad bsdus bshad par yang rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid kyang gdan sa chen mor dgung lo nyer lnga'i bar du sku phreng song ma rnams kyi dus bzhin bstan srid kyi mdzad srol sa bsam gzhigs mi byed ka med cig bzos yod pa de tsam 'ig tu 'khums/tshi gzhan zhig ni (gsang rnam 〉 pe cin par ma'i sheg ngos83par bod kyi rtse zin nas slong mo dang gnas mjal byed bzhin pas lha sar 'gro bsams nas yong bas ka tshal dgon pa'i skor lam du bud med gzhin nu ma rgyan chas bzang po byas pa zhig dang thug byung ba'i mos nga la zhib tu blta zhing gnas skor ba khyed gang nas yin zer bar/ nga khams nas yong ba yin/ lha sa mjal

180 ga /— rṣa tshe brtan lo tshogs kyi rtsom rig ba ma cho phyog bsgrigs/du 'gro byas pas/ mo lha sar song nas yong ba yin pas da lta gnas skor ba'i rigs lha sar 'gro ba gang 'dra yin zer nas cung zad 'dzum byung the tshom pa zhig byung nas yang 'gro grabs byas pas/ rings khyad med na mos sanas tshang g.yar gyi/ re zhig bzhugs na zer bas/ 'o na de ka byed/ khyed rang gi nang gar yod dris pas/ nga'i nang la da lta bzhugs chog pa med/ rgyab ri'i ri khrod 'di 'gol zhing su med pas der phebs dang ngas zhabs tog byed zer bas/ sang ltar sha tsha ba zhig 'dug pas 'dis zer ba ltar byed snyam nas ka tshal gyi rtse de'i ri khrod du phyin pas mos zer ba ltar 'dug mun sros tsam na bud med des chu chu bem gang dang / me shing / rtsam pa cung zad bcas bskyal nas khyed rang 'di gar re zhig bzhugs dang 'di rnams zad pa na mos skabs skabs bskyal chog zer nas song zhes sogs gsal zhing / (gsang rnam 〉nang de ni lha mo rdo rje g.yu sgron mas khong la skyabs rogs gnang ba zhig yin lugs bris 'dug 'on kyang yig cha de rang gi par ngosaskuḥpar shar gangs la dang / nub gangs la'i bar der jag pa mi bzhi dang 'phrad de chas ka chen po med kyi/ rtsam pa dang ja cung zad yod pa rnams phrogs song bas bod kyi sa sne ma zin bar du dka' tshegs chen po byung gsungs zhes gsal bas rdo rje g.yu sgron ma khong la bgo ba'i lha mo de lta bu zhig yin na/ dka' nyen che ba'i dus der srung skyob ma gnang bar yin gcig min gcig bod dbus kyi ka tshal du bde 'jags ngang phebs dus rogs skyor gnang dgos don ci yod/ de dag kyang slob ma dad pa can gyis bla ma thog por gtong zer pa'i dpe ltar dpyad pa byed 'os pa zhig 'dug3 gzhan yang don dngos ni gang ltar sped mi thub pa zhig yin te dpe deb de'i shog ngos 142—143bar rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi
