ga /(tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur rmu 〉dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus kyi don dngo 'ama' /81rnam pani snyan shal ring zhing bug pa yod pa zhes gsal bas khong ni 'khrungs nas lo 'khor gcig lhag tsam las ma song bar bla ma'i yang srid du bdag 'dzin nus pa zhig yin na/ snyan shal la bus pa yod pa de dus gang zhig dang rgyu mtshan gang la brten nas phug pa'i thad 'grel bshad ji ltar byed dam/par ngos 144par tha ma kha bzhes dus du ba zhal du blangs nas gnan la sog par mdzad pa na 'ozhes sogs 'tshad pas dngos yod kyi mdzad tshul ni nyi shar sbar mos mi khebs pa'i dpe ltar der yang rang shugs kyis mtshon yod/ da dungakres cha de'i par ngos /6 nang 'khod pa'i gsung mgur las/ 'dzam gling dbang po'i rgyal po/ seng be glang chen khri steng / nyi zla 'od dang 'bar ba/ kun la gzi brjid rgyas pa/ rin chen ra sa'i phreng ba/ mgul du bzhes pa tsam gyis/ 'od zer rgya mtshor phog pas/ rgya mtsho'i nor bu mi rnams /rgya mtsho kha yi rlangs pa/ nam mkha'i mthongs la phog 'dus/ dkar nas dkar gsum 'khyugs pas/ sprin gyi 'ja' bun 'khrigs 'dus ces sogs gsal ba 'di dag gi rtsom stangs dang / tshig sbyor/ com gshis solas gang i thad nas dpyad rung / mgur spu'i tshis gi 'khyer so dang ha cang mthun pa 'di lta bu dus mnyam pa'i bla ma gzhan dag gi gsung mgur khrod nas btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba bcas gong gsal gyi gnad don de tshos kyang ldog phyogs sam/yang na drang phyogs nas khong si mgur glur dbye zhib byed par phan yod kyi dpyad gzhi 'don sgrod byed srid pa las/ yig cha de spyad nas mgur glu brtsi med du gtong thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gtan nas med do snye /song du brjod pa'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos de dag la brten nas 'dir dpyad brjod byed pa'i snying po ni/ mig sngar (tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu 〉de / blo /rdo( /ji( /skyo/ /1kyi /ste/ ///1rdordo /bye//ji //rdong ma gsung ma na dang na gas ga ga gsar du ba na par

182 ga ༈ ngaperatshe bcan phun tshogs kyi ma rig ba ma chos phyogs bsgrims/brten de'i thad mi rnams la the tshom dang som nyi byed dgos don ci yang medag pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal bshad bya rgyu 'ba' zhig gi ched du yin pa las/ lo rgyus kyi mi snarasar yang dpyad zhib byed pa zhig gtan nas min/ 'on kyang mi la las shod pa ltar tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur sbu yongs bsgrags byed pa 'di ni/khong la dma' 'bebs dang skur 'debs byed pa'i ched du red zer ba de ni rbad de sgo ba log sgrub cig yin/ gang yin zhe na/ mgur glu de'i thog nas khong ni bugs rgyud drang zhing / zhal gsal gting gsal zhig yin pa dang / dregs ldan gyikhriganon shugs la gnya' mi skur zhing / spyi tshogs kyi sgrig srol rnying pa'i chings zhags gtor phod pa'i snying stobs ldan pa/ mi dmangs mang tshogs la thugs blo dkar ba dang / mi gzhan la 'dra mnyam gyi spyod tshul 'dzin pa sogs gang legs mchon gyi yod la/ lhag par du khong gi mgur glu des bod rigs mang tshogs kyika bde ba'i skad cha rnams snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan dang thung 'brel 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig gnang ste gsar gtod rang bzhin ldan pa'i sgo nas khyab che ba'i bod kyi dmangs khrod gzhas tshig de chu tshad gsar pa zhig tu gong spel mdzad par brten/ da phan mi lo sum brgyar nye ba'i dus yun nang bod rigs mi dmangs kyi khrod du khong gi mgur grur dga' zhen tshad med byed pa ma zad/ mang tshogs kyis de nyid mig dper byas te rang si dga' sdang mtshon par byed pa 'i gzhas tshig khri stong mang po gsar rtsom byas pa brgyud/ bod rigs dmangs khrod kyi rig rtsal sdum ra de sngar bas phun sum je tshogs su gyur pa sogs shugs rkyen ha cang chen po ldan yod pa'i rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas gsung rtsom de nyid rgyal khab phyi dang gang sar rlung ltar grags rin pa bcas de lta bu'i mi rigs kyi rig rtsal rtsom rig cig la da lta nga tshos gna' bzang deng spyod dang / snyigs dor bcud len gyi dpyad zhib bya rgyu ni/ bod dmangs

rdza/〈tshangs dbyangs dngha mas mgur glu 〉dang wel ba'i lorgyus kyi donadangos 'ga'/ 183khrod kyi rtsom ris sgyu rtsal de spyi tshoms ring lugs kyi la phyoms brgyud gong 'phel gtong ba'i bya ba bzang po zhig yin pa des rtsom pa po'i thun mong ma yin pa 'i thugs gzhis dang / khyad du 'phags pa'i rtsom rtsal sogs kyi mtshan snyan nam yang mi nub pa ris rtsal lo tsa sa kyi deb ther thog bkod nas mi rabs rjes mar brgyud sprod byed pa zhig la sa/ dma' 'bebs dang skur 'debs su 'gyur ga la srid/ 'di ni gtso bo'i phyogs dang rtsa don gyi gsal bshad yin/ 'on kyang rang re'i dpe kun las risas nas do snang byed 'os pa'i gnad don chung tsag re zung yang mchis snyam/ dpe skrun byas pa'irnamagur glu deb la la'i la shog gam bar bris ri mo 'ga' shas nang / rab tu byung ba'i cha byad can gyi btsun pa dang bad med 'tham 'khyud dam lag gdang dang nga gshib sogs bis gi ri ji ri ri smyo gapa de rigs dngos byung lo rgyus dang 'tsham po med pa gong gsal yig cha las mthong thub pa dang / mgur glu'i gzhas tshig gi grangs 'bor thad 'dra min sna tshogs bsdu bsgrigs 'grems spel byas pa des mi rnams la dogs gzhi chags pa sogs lta bu yin/ gzhi zang (tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu 〉ni yul dus dang gnas tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshosas kyi skor sho lo 7 re zung tsam byas nas rang dgar thol byung du ljags rtsom gnang ba rnams thor bu phyogs bsdus gang thub byas pa zhig yin par brten grangs tshad dang / nang don gang thad nas yongs su gtan 'khel ba zhis sus kyang brjod par dka' ba de la ya mtshan rgyu ci yang med/ 'on kyang rang re 'brel yod tshan pa dang mi sger tshang ma sa rtsad 'ib byas te skabs de rang ngam/ yang na de dang nye ba'i dus su phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i ma dpe yis rnying khungs dag 'dra rnyed son thub thabs la 'bad brtson byed dgos shing / gal srid ma rag na snga sa nas thing par du bzos pa'i lha sa'i dpe thung de'i thad sngon chad rgan rabs kyi bshad srol la 'di ni mgur glu

184 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshog kyi ma rig brtsa ma chos phyogs bsgrigs/— —— —wa wa cha tshang ba zhig min par 'di nang ma tshud pa da dung mang po yod tshul brjod pa go myong yang / gang ltar spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang rgya khyab song 'og tshang mas tshad 'dzin byed bzhin klan ka med par yun ring de lta bu song bar brten re zhig mgur glu par ma de rang gzhi 'dzin sa byas na mi chog rgyu ci yang med snyam/gzhan du dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshig bsdu ba ltar byas nas 'di yang mgur glu'i gras shig yin la/ de yang yin zer tshad bsdu len byas na mi 'grig pa los yin/ de min 'brel yod rgya rigs kyi mkhas pa tshosam mgur glu 'di'i skor dpyad brjod 'ga' zhig spel ba rnams ni so thos tsam las/ rang nyid rgya yig thad yig rmongs la brten dge skyon gang yang bshad bya'i yul las 'das pa bcas mdor na bod mi rigs kyi rig rtsal rgyun 'dzin dang / gsar rtsom gyi bya ga'ag skyon bral ngang gong 'phel gtong rgyur cung zad phan na snyam/ 'dir mgur glu'i skor rang gi gang shes lhag bsam zol med kyis dpyad brjod cung zad tsam byas pa yin rung / nga rang shes yon gyi chu tshad dma' zhing / rig rtsal gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs sogs la sbyangs pa med pas skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig byung yod pa gor ma chag stabs 'brel yod blo mthun tshang mas skyon brjod dang yo bsrang gnang rgyu'i re ba yod/

ri — 1tshu /)bod mi rigs kyi phul byung rtsom rig shul 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas gsar pa yong ba byed dgos/wa wazhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs lnga'i bod rigs kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog gi gtam bshad/tang gi mi risas srid jus kyi 'od snang rab tu 'phro ba'i dro skyid kyi dus bab bzang po'i nang / da lo zhing chen dang rang skyong smongs lnga'i bod rigs kyi com ris gsar com bzhusas mol tshogs 'du 'di lha sar skong 'tshogs sanang ba ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog thengs dang po yin/ da res nga rang yang tshogs 'du'i nang dngos su zhugs thub ste sa khul gzhan nas phebs pa 'i mkhas pa tsho dang mjal 'phrad thos slob ston nyan rgyu'i go skabs bzang po thob pa 'dir dga' spro ha cang chen po byung / rang nyid la mkhas pa'i tshogs dbus su rtsom rig ji skor gtam bshad zhu rgyu'i 'os tshad gang yang ma mchis kyang / lhag bsam zol med kyi kun slong kho nar bsten nas bod rigs kyi rtsom ris lo rgyus gang shes rasas tsam dang / mi rigs kyi rtsom ris rgyun 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i skor la rang bsam gyi 'char sgo cung zad cig zhu gi yin dang bo/ bod mi rigs kyi rtsom ris ni lo rgyus ring la/ rnam mang phun

186 ga /chab sprel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi rtsom rig ba mas chos phyogs ba gas/sum tshogs pa zhig yin pa'i skor/ nga tsho'i rlabs chen mes rgyal 'di ni/ gna' rabs nas bzung 'dzam gling thog shes rig gi dpal yon thog mar dar ba'i grags ldan rgyal khab kyi gras shig yin zhing / rang cag bod kyi mi rigs 'di'ang las la brtson zhing / depa' ngar che la/ shesarig dang ldan pa 'i gul du byung ba'i spung hwa mi rigs kyi gras thig red/ der brten bod rigs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal ni lo rgyus yun ring ldan zhing phun sum tshogs la 'od zer ldan pa zhig yin zhing / yig thog tu 'khod pa'i rgyu cha gzhir bzung na ha lam mi lo nyis stong yas mas kyi lo rgyus yod par mngon/ dper na/ spyi lo'i dus rabs dang po 'go tshugs pa'i snga rjes tsam la byung bar grags pa'i bod kyi btsan po'i mi rabs brgyad pa'am dgu par yang brtsi ba'i btsan po spu de gung rgyal gyis yab kyi sku mtshal gnyer nas mkhar myang ro sham po phab ste lo ngam pho brgya mo brgya btul ba'i dus su bzhes pa'i mgur tshig de dag ni da lta nga tshos shes pa'i bod kyi gna' bo'i rtsom rig snga shos shig yin snyam/ de rjes dus rabs drug pa'i smad char byung ba'i btsan po stag bu snyan gzigs skabs kyi byang tseng ku'ingag rtsom dang / yar lung 'bangs 'khor gyi glu tshig dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor gnam ri srong btsan skabs khyung po spung sad thu tse dang / myang mang po rje 'ang snang gnyis shags 'gyed pa'i rtsom tshig de rjes srong btsan sgam po mchog nyid dang / khong gi sring mo sad ma lar/ de bzhin dus rabs bdun pa'i stod char blon po mgar stong btsan dang dbas dbyi tshab la sosas pa'i spyo mgur com/ lhag par thu mi'i mgur com dang sum rtags kyi gzhung lugs sogs dang / dus rabs bdun pa'i smad char byung ba'i btsan po 'dus srong mang po rje'i sasung mgur/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i stod char btsan po khri lde gtsug btsan skabs sogs kyi mgur dang / shags sogs khag gcig yig char

ga khod me rtemirtsal jing ma rig 'dzin rtseyodagos pa/ ri 187—wa wazhe wa —— —'khod yod pa las sum rtasas gud/ de byings rnams mgur rtsom dang thags 'gyed pa'i rnam pa stabs bde tsam dang / nang don yang skabs so so'i don gnad bye brag pa mtshon pa'i phan tshun gtam gleng lta bu zhis yin mod/ 'on kyang de dag gi thosanas gna' rab sa su bod kyi skad dang rtsom yig 'phel 'gyur byung ba'i snang tshul rnyed par dka' ba rags rim tsam mtshon zhing / skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so sogs ngo mtshar ldan pa'i lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi yid rton rung ba du ma tshad zhib thub pa dang lhas par skad yig gi sgyu rtsal thad nas bshadan gna' rtsom de dag tshig sdud che la don thag pa/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi rtsom nyams thun mong ma yin pa dang ldan pa sogs da lta rang cag mi ma nyung ba zhig brnga rnying la mi mkhas pa sa 0na' tshig la la go dka' ba ma gtogs/ rtsa ba'i brjod bya go ba rags tsam lon rims blta bzhin blta bzhin tshis don gyi ro bcud je cher 'gro bas bod mi risas kyi skad yig dang / lo rgyus rtsom ris la zhib 'jug byed pa'i dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha rin thang bral ba zhig yin snyam/ de rjes spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i ngas dkyil la btsan po khri song lde dmi ji ma ribatsan gyi sku dus su bod mi'i shes rig sngar bas gong 'phel du gyur nas btsan ngo sa rgya sar dang / rgya nas li yul/ bal po/ kha che sogs nas mkhas pa mang po gdan drangs shing yul de das tu dar ba'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bka' dang bstan bcos gtso bor byas pa'i sman rtsis rig sanas sogs kyi dpe cha mang po bod yig tu bsgyur pa de nas bzung bod sana' rabs kyi rtsom ris de la 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldog ha cang chen po zhig byung ste rtsom gyi nang don dang / nyams 'gyur gang sar sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i yar rgyas gzengs su thon pa zhig byung yod pa ri mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi bsgyur dpe grangs las

188 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshogs kyi ma ris brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/— — —'das pa zhig da lta'ang mngon sum mig gi spyod yul du mchis pa de dag la bltas pa tsam gyis rtogs thub pas 'dir dpe mtshon zhu dbos don med la /blo chung bdag lta bus zhu bar rngo ga la thogs/ mdor na bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus nas bshad na dus skabs 'di ni rtsa ba'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'phel 'gyur 'gro 'go tshugs pa'i dus mtshams shig yin snyam/ 'on kyang nga tshos mthong dgos pa ni dus yun ring po'i nang mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad yig dang com rig de rim bzhin 'phel rgyas chen po zhig byung bar brten gzhi nas phyi phyogs rig gnas kyi legs cha rnams blangs te rang gi rig gnas yong 'phel gtong thub pa zhig byung ba yin zhing / gal srid rang la phun sum tshogs pa'i skad yig cig dang chu tshad mtho ba'i rtsom rtsal zhig med na skabs de'i sngon thon yin pa'i rig gnas de dag mi rigs rang nyid can du 'gyur thabs med pa de yin/ dus rabs bcu pa'i dus mjug tsam la bod du bstan pa phyi dar byung ba'i rjes su/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mang po rgya gar dang / kha che/ bal po sogs su phebs te chos dang ris gnas sna tshogs la slob sbyong gnang ba ma zad/ dpe cha 'bor chen zhig rim bzhin bod yig tu bsgyur ba bcas kyi dar srol chen po byung ba dang / skabs der mi risas kyi rtsom ris la'ang yar rgyas che tsam byung ba'i mtshon byed gtso bo zhig ni rje mi la'i mgur 'bum che mo yin/de rjes dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i stod char sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan mchog gis rgya bod kyi mkhas pa dang lo tsā ba du ma slob dpon du bsten nas thog mar rang nyid rig pa'i sanas che chung mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs brtson gnang thog bod kyi rig sanas spyi dang bye brag rtsom rig gong spel satong ba'i ched du bstan bcos 〈malas pa 'jug pa 'i sgo 〉zhes pa gsar rtsom ma dzad de bod kyi rtsom ris dang sgyu rtsal dar rgyas gsar spel btong rgyur gzengs su

sdi rdo /bod mi rigs gi sul byung rtsom rig 'dzin spel dgos pa / ci /89thon pa'i phyag rjes bzhag gnang zhing / thong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / dpang lo blo gros brtan pa sosas kyis de'i mjug skyong nan tur gnang thog rgya gar gyi mkhas pa dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i (snyan ngag me long 〉 bod yig tu legs par bsgyur zhing gtan la phab pa ma zad/ 'grel bshad gsar rtsom dang 'brel khrid rgyun dar spel gnang ba bcas de nas bzung bod kyi rtsom rig la tshig rgyan gyi rtsa ba'i gzhung lusas shig gzhi nas byung zhing / rtsom ris gi sgyu rtsal thad la'ang yar rgyas dang gsar spel chen po jig byung ba red/ de nas rim ba'in sa skya pa dang / bka' rgyud pa / rnying ma ba/ dge lugs pa thegs grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma dang mkhas pa grags can gyi rtsom pa ngo/ ser skya bgrang bis mi lang ba phebs pa de dag gis chos dang 'jig rten srid lusas kyi bstan bcos dang / lo rgyus/ chos 'byung / rnam thar/ 'ogs brjod/ gtam rgyud// byung ba brjod pa/ gso ba rig pa dang / skar rtsis/ sgra/ snyan ngag solas kyi gzhung 'grel/ legs bshad/ bslab bya/ brtsams sgrung / bstod dbyangs/ bshad pa/sgrung gtam la sogs pa rtsom ris rnam pa sna tshogs char rjes kyi sgyus rtsa bzhin du thon pa ni brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig yo da/rang re'i mes po tshos skabs de'i phyi phyogs kyi sngon thon rtsom ris gi legs cha blangs te mi rigs rang nyid kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gong spel gtong bar dka' spyad 'bad brtson chen po gnang ba ma zad/ rtsom rtsal gyi thad la rgya gar gyi snyan ngas gi rgyal por grags pa'i (dpa ga bsam 'khri shing 〉 la do zlar phod pa'i rtsom rig kyang ji snyed cis thon yod/ 'on kyang thos pa dang shes tshad gnyis dman kho bo lta bus chos srid kyi gzhung dang sbyar ba'i snyan rtsom chen po dag la sa dpe mtshon mu bar mi spobs kyang / 'dir rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal kho na'i thad kyi dpe mtshon dum bu gsum drangs te tshang mas gzigs bsdur sanang rgyur bsod

190 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun chog kyi rtsom rig brtsams cho snyoms bsgrigs/wa wa wa—pa dper na (mdzes mar bsngags pa 〉 lag sor nyi 'od tshogs kyis gi/ /pad ma'i tshal 'di mngon par phye/ /mig yangs de yis lta byed gzhan/ /ri mor bris pa'i mig tubs/ /de mthong rdzi ma'i sred ldan gyis/ /rang gi dga' mar 'khyud pa brjed/ /zla 'od mthong tshe ku mu da'i/ /'dab mas grogs la 'dud pa dor zhes dang / 5de dag dbus su yid 'phrog ma/ /khrus byas langs pa mthong gyur te/ /dran pa'i mig gsum me dag ni/ /zhi byed chu yi lha mo bzhin/ /lus med rnam 'phrul rtsom pa yi/ /rba rlabs tshogs ldan lang tshor ni/ /gzhon nu ma nyid dbying pa yi/ /brtan pa dag ni byed pa bzhin/ /yid 'ong lha yi gos bsos shing / /ske rags dag ni legs par bcings/ /chu rtsed rol pa'i dbu ba yi/ /phreng ba rab gsal chags pa bzhin( zhes dang / khengs ldan khengs pa'i yam shing la/ /rtse dasa'i bla mas sbyin bsreg byas/ /gang gi the rtse'i phreng ba bzhin/ /skang shu ka yi me tog 'bar/ /ba ku la rnams yal 'dab kyi/ /lag pa dpral ba la bkod nas//chang gi 'gram pa 'i 'khur bkangs can/ /chang mig ma la bya ra byed/ /bung ba rol pa'i smin 'khyog dang / /me tog dmar po'i bzhin ras can/ /mig sman ldan pa'i ljon shing gis/ /gtum rma rnams la 'phras kyang gdags/ /utpal pon po'i rna rgyan gyis/ /mdzes pa'i nor 'dzin ri dwags mig /rkang drug phyogs su 'khyams rnams kyi/ /mig nas bzung ste 'gugs pa bzhin/ / zhes sogs gong gsal dum bu gsum bkod pa nas gcig ni/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po snyan ngag mkhan dge ba'i dbang pos brtsams pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs brjod (dpag bsam 'khri shing 〉dang / gcig ni dus rabs bco lnga par bod kyi snyan ngag mkhan zhang zhung pa chos dbang grags pas brtsams pa'i (rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod dri za'i bu mo'i rgyud mang gi sgra dbyangs/〉 gzhan cig shos de ni dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i snyan ngag mkhas pa sman ri ba blo bzang rnam rgyal gyis

rig bod mi ris kyi phul byung rtsom rig 'dzin spel dgas pa 191 sa la brtsams pa'i 〈 dri med kun ldan gyi rtogs brjod bsngags 'os bsngags pa 〉bcas so so las drangs pa yin/ gzigs dang / phul du byung ba'i snyan com de dag dkyus gcis tu bklags na phal cher mkhas pa gcis gis brtsams pa lta bu'i tshor snang 'byin thub pa 'i/sa mi 'dug sa/ma/ da dung chos dang 'brel ba'i snyan rtsom ni de bas mang zhing phul du byung ba ji snyed cig yod/ dper na/ rje tsong la pas mdzad pa'i 〈rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod 〉 dang / (blo sbyong /〉(dbyangs can mar bstod pa 〉 solas dang / dge 'dun grub kyi (sgrol bstod lesas bris ma/〉 rin spungs ngag dbang 'jigs grags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈sa paṇa gyi rtogs brjod skal bzang legs la ma 〉dang / 〈yab rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal la phul ba'i zhu 'phrin 〉 solas de dang de 'dra brjod kyis mi lang ba de dag gi chu tshad ni snyan ngas gi gzhung ltar byas na ngo mtshar mchog tu skye ba zhe gcig brtsams yod/ dus mtshungs sngon byon bod kyi mkhas pa tshos brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi 'bor grangs la mtshon na'ang mi rnams ha la sa pa zhis mchis te/ dper na/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga pa'i nang byung ba'i mkhas pa bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i gsung 'bum kho nare po ti brgya lhag tsam yod tshul thos shing / de min mkhas pa la la'i sasung 'bum la po ti bcu phrag brgal ba dang / tha na bcu phrag khu shas kyang mchis pa sogs dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa 'di yin/ de tsam du ma zad bod kyi dmangs brod rtsom ris gi thad la'ang 'dzam gling du skad grags yod pa'i bod mi rigs kyi rtsom chen gling ge sar rgyal po'i sung dpe po ti bcu phrag 'asa' shas yod pa phud/ da dung rgya khyab sa khul mang por yis thog tu 'khod dang ma 'khod kyi a khu ston pa'i sgrung la sogs pa sgrung 0tam rnam pa sna tshogs dang / yul phyogs so so'i ri klung yul ljongs la bstod pa'i bro 0'as kyi tshig rtsom/ gnyen sgrig bag ston gyi bshad pa

192 sto/chab stsa tshe brtanasan gas kyi rtsom ri gā di rtas chos phyog bsgrigs/sogs bshad pa'i rigs du ma/ de min dmangs khrod kyi ka bshad/ gzhas tshig dang gtam dpe mi 'dra ba khri stong du ma sogs nang don dang rnam pa ci rigs pa'i dmangs rtsom ha cang mang po yod/ lhag par du spyi lo 1700yas mas tsam la tā la'i sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos mgur glu brtsams spel gnang ba nas bzung dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshig nang du'ang snyan ngag tshig rgyan gyi rtsom nyams sna tshogs spro ba'i dar srol khyab gdal du 'gyur bar brten/yi ge mi shes pa'i mang tshogs pho mo mang pos skyeng rang rtogs med rung snyan ngag dpe rgyan dang / gzugs rgyan/ lhag par bsdus brjod kyi rgyan sogs dang mthun pa'i gzhas tshig snyan zhing go bde la nyams 'gyur ldan pa grangs med cig gsar rtsom byas yod pa bcas 'dir rang sga shes tshad la dpag pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig skor gang dran rags bsdus tsam zhus pa las cha tshang gting zab par bzhag gnad bsdus don 'khel zhis kyang rtsa ba nas byung med rung /mdor bsdus de tsam gyi thog nas kyang rang re bod mi rigs kyi sngon byon mes po tshos mi lo nyis stong gi ring la dka' spyad 'bad 'bungs kyi sgo nas mi rabs rjes mar 'od zer 'phro ba'i rtsom rig gi shul bzhag ngo mtshar ldan pa 'bor chen zhig gsar skrun gnang yod pa'i cha shas tsam mtshon thub/ mdor na/ rang cag bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas rtsom rig ni dngos 'brel lo rgyus yun ring ldan zhing / 'phel rgyas kyi dus rim 'ga' shas brgyud rnam mang phun sum tshogs la/ tshig don gang sar rtsom rtsal gyi dbye ba zhib pa dang / sgyu rtsal gyi rim pa mang ba/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa bcas byas nas rlabs chen mes rgyal gyi 'od stong 'phro ba'i rig rtsal ldum ra'i nang thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi me rtog cig tu chags grub byung / der brten rtsom rig tshud pa'i bod kyi rig gnas la deng skabs 'dzam gling sa gnas mang por yang mthong chen gyis do

rig /bod mi rigs kyi gul byung rtsom rig 'dzin spel dathos pa/ 193wa — wa wa snang byed kyin yod/ lo rgyus kyi thog nas bltas na da phan lo ngo stong phrag zung gi ring bod kyi bya gzhag nang mi rigs com rig gis 'khur la 'os pa'i las 'gan khur yod la/ mi rabs rjes mar rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi dpyad gzhi'i shul rgyun rgya chen po zhig bzhag yod pa red/gnyis pa/ rang cag bod rigs sa khul gyi rtsom pa po tshos mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom ris gi shul rgyun bzang po nge dag rgyun 'dzin dang zhib 'jug bya rgyur snang chung ngam khyad gsod rtsa ba nas byed rgyu med snyam gyi 'dus sang yin zhe na/ bod rigs mi dam ngas tshos blo sacig sems gcig nas tang gi 'go khrid la brtsi bkur dang / sbyi tshogs ring lugs kyi la ma du bskyod pa /mes rgyal gcig gyur srung skyong dang mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag pa'i thad la rgyal yongs spun zla mi rigs byings dang rbad de gcis gyur yin pa bshad ma dgos / dus mtshungs mi rigs so sor lo rgyus yun ring nang chags pa 'i rang nyid kyi skad yis yod pa ma zad/ mi rigs de rang la thun mong ṅga bsam blo'i grub sa'i dang / yul som sa gshis lugs sogs mi rigs kyi khyad chos 'tha' zhig yod pa ni phyi yul la sanas pa'i don dngos this red rgyu mtshan de kho na'i dbang gis mi rigs gang zhis bi mi dmangs la spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa 'i dpal yon dar bar byed pa'i yo ngas khyab kyi dril bsgrags slob gso'i las don cha tshang ba dang gting zab pa zhig byed bsam na satso bo mi rigs de rang gi sad yis dang / mi rigs de rang gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal brgyud nas bya rgyu der gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i nus pa ldan yod pa red/ nger brten tang krung dbyang gis mi rilas 'dus sdod sa khul du mi risas kyi skad yis gong spel dang / mi rigs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal phul du byung ba rnams shul 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas gtong rgyur thulas 'khur ta cang chen ngo sanang ba de ri

940sheto /༄༄tshebartan gan tsho ma kyi rtsom rig brtsams i phyog bsgrigs/yongs su yang das pa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin zhu gi yod/bod kyi rtsom rig gi lo rgyus thog nas bltas na'ang / rang re'i mi rabs gong ma tshos phyi phyogs kyi sngon thon rtsom rig dang len byed pa dang dus mtshungs mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rtsom tshul de'i shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin bya rgyur do snang chen po byas pa mtshon gyi 'dug dper na/ dusarabs brgyad pa'i nang phyi phyogs kyi ris gnas dang 'dren dar spel byed pa'i skabs su'ang /btsan po khri grokhor lde btsan gyis bsam yas gtsug las khang gsar bzhings legs grub byung ste rab sanas kyi dgyes ston chen po'i dus der thog mar btsan po rang nyid kyisamang yi dbu rtse rigs gsum 'di/ /brtsisas pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra// zhes pa la sogs pa'i mgur 〈g.yu khang gser khri 〉bya ba bzhes tshul — dang / de nas rim pa bzhin rgyal sras dang / btsun mo/ mkhan po/ slob dpon/malas pa/ ban de/ blon chen/ blon po/ dmas dpon/ gtso bo/'bangs 'khor pho mo rkan gzhon la sogs pas ming can gyi mgur glu nyi shu rtsa bdun tsam blangs pa'i lo rgyus yod cing / de rjes su yang gna' bo'i rtsom srol de rgyun 'dzin byas te 〈ge sar sgrung 〉nang gi glu sogs byung zhing / (khrom chen zil gnon 〉 dang 〈yob chen 'gying glu 〉 zer ba la sogs pa'i glu rer ming re 'dogs srol de yang shul 'dzin byas yod/ dus mtshungs rje btsun mi la'i gsung mgur rnams kyang gna' bo'i mirigs kyi rtsom tshul de rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gnang ba ma zad/ de rjes bka' brgyud sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma mang pos mgur rtsom gyi srol rgyun shul 'dzin gnang yod/ bod du snyan ngag gi rtsom srol dar spel chen po byung ba'i rjes su yang rje dge 'dun grub pa dang / rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho sogs dbe lugs kyi mkhas pa du mas kyang mgur rtsom mtha' yas pa der spel gnang yod/ nye rabs su'ang dper na/ co

ga /bod mi rigs rdzisu byung rtsom rig 'dzin spel da sa pa/ ri /95— wa wa de dbe bshes blo bzang rgya mtshos ston mkha'apho 'char ba'i chu shel gyi zlab / /tshes bco lnga'i cha shas yongs rdzogs su khengs kyang / /0za' sgra gcan 'khyug bgrod nam 'ong ni mi 'dug /shar rgyu skar tho rengs skar chen la smon byung / shazhes sogs brtsams pa de dag las sngon byon malas pa tshos mi rigs kyi sana' bo'i mgur rtsom srol rgyun de mi lo stong phrag brgal ba'i ring rgyun 'dzin dar spel ci 'dra gnang ba mthong thub ga com srol de deng skabs kyi malas pa tshos kyang shul 'dzin gnang bzhin pa yin/mdor na bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig de ches 0na' rabs kyi mgur tshig stabs bde dam dum zhig nas rim bzhin da yod snyan ngag i bstan bcos chen bo'i bar 'phel rgyas su gyur pa 'i lo rgyus nang mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i com srol phul du byung ba rnams rgyun 'dzin byas yod/ des na da lta'i skabs su yang blo mthun ma'o tse tung gis spung dang phyi rgyal gyi sngar gyi dus rabs kyi rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal gyi shul rgyun phun sum tshosas pa rnams dang rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal gyi shul rgyun bzang ngo rnams kyi rgyun bzung dgos kyi med yin na'ang rgyun bzung dgos pa'i dmigs yul yang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi ched du red/ji ces gsungs yod pa ltar nga tshos mi rigs kyi rtsom ris phul du byung ba rnams rgyun 'dzin gyis bod rigs mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi blta 'dod la nyan spro ba'i rtsom rig cig yong rgyur 'bad brtson byed rgyu ni de bas kyang gal ha cang chen po red snyam pa 'dug sal te sand don 'di la snang med dang mthong chung byas na mtha' mtshams sa khul 'dir spyi tshogs ring pi gas kyi rtsom rig khyab gdal du spel rgyu'i las ka de 'khor rgya chung ngu 'is gi nang du tshud srid kyi red gsum ba/ bod kyi mi risas rtsom rig bi rjes shul bzang po rnams rgyun

/—98 ga /chab spel tshe brtan sun tshogasakyi rtsom rig brtsams chos rgyag bsgrigs/rgyud la bkyon pa'i mgur tshig dang / btsan po khri lde gtsus btsan gyi skabs 'jang gi blon pos phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe gsungs pa'i rje blon gyi mgur tshig la sogs pa'i nang du ni de bas kyang chab srid kyi brjod bya zab cing rgya che ba das kyang com rig si nang du drangs pa dngaka rjod byed kyi tshig rgyan yang nam mkha' dang / nyi zla/ sa gzhi dang / gtsang chab/ lharang lha yul la sogs pa 'i bar rgya cher gyur yod pa mtshon gyi 'dus snyam/btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs su/ bod kyi rtsom rig la sngon chad kyi dus rim gang zhig dang yang mi 'dra ba'i yar rgyas dang 'gyur ldog chen po de lta bu yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ skabs der bod kyi btsan po'i mnga' thang rtse mor son zhing / mi rigs kyi shes bya song du spel ba'i cha rkyen sngar las lhag pa 'dzoms pa'i khur/ btsan po rang nyid la'ang sngon thon gyi rig gnas bsam blo dang len dang gsar spel gnang rgyu'i snying stobs yod pa bcas la brten thog mar thang sbong ma'i drung du sang shi la sogs pa'i pho nya ched du mngags te rgya yul nas chos bam po stong phrag longs pa bod du gdan drangs pa dang /lhag par du sba gsal snang sogs pal yul du snga phyir mngags nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po bornyi sa twa dang 6rgyan pad ma 'byung gnas sogs gdan drangs pa'i zad/ ye shes dbang po dang bai ro tsa na la sogs pa lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gis rgya gar gyi mdo rgyud bstan bcos 'bor chen zhig bsgyur pa dang / de bzhin rgya yul nas hwa shang ma ko le spyan drangs shing / bran kha legs kong dang lha lung klu song sogs kyis rgya'i chos dang rig gnas kyi dpe cha bsgyur pa sogs byas te nang pa sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs dar bar mdzad pa dang / dus mtshungs sgra dang sman rtsis la sogs pa rig gnas kun dar spel chen po byung ba brgyud/skabs der sngon thon yin pa'i mi rigs dang / tha na phyi phyogs kyi com rig sgyu

ga /sdodamirisakyi sul byung mariga'adzinastodags pa 1tshortsal gyi legs cha dang nying khu rnams blangs te mi rigs rang nyid kyi rtsom rig gong spel dang phun sum tshogs su btang ba la brten nas byung ba zhig yin pa de lo rgyus kyi don dngos thog nas ra 'phrod gsal po yod/ de rjes btsan po sadan legs dang / khri ral pa can gyi dus su'ang sgra bsgyur gyi bya bar mu mthud nas 'bad brtson gnang ba ma zad/ bkas bcad kyi satan 'bebs snga rting du mdzad pa des kyang bod kyi yi ge dang com ris 'phel rgyas 'gro bar phan pa rgya chen po byung ba red bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus nas bzung bod kyi mkhas pa don gnyer can mang po rgya sar du phebs shing sgra bslabs pa dang chos dpe blangs te bod yis tu bsgyur pa'am/ yang na rgya gar gyi paṇa grub du ma bod du phebs nas chos spel ba bcas de dag lagasangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mtha' mi 'dra ba so sor chags shing /chos rgyud so bo'i dpe cha dang rig gnas 0'an dag bsgyur com 'bor chen byas pa'i brgyud rim nang du mi rigs rang nyid kyi rtsom rig kyang de bas dar 'phel che ru song ba dang / lhas par du spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa 'i stod cha tsamanas bzung sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / de rjes shong dpang lo tsā ba chen po gnyis bcas pa slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis rgya gar du dar ba'i snyan ngag gi gzhung lusas chen po rnams kyi snying bcud gsar du bsdus pa'i bstan bcos (snyan ngag me long 〉bod yig tu bsgyur spel gnang bdeni bod kyi rtsom rig la 'phel rgyas lasar pa dang rtsom tshul gyi thad rtsa ba'i 'gyur ldog byung ba'i dus mtshams shig yin snyam gyi 'dug gang yin zhe na/de nas bzung rtsom rig gi shes bya kho nar ched du dmigs pa'i tshad 'dzin gyi gzhung lugs shig gzhi nas byung ba dang / de la brten nas rtsom rig sga thos bsam stong khrid kyi bshad rgyun zhig sazhi nas dar ba/ rtsom rig la dasa' ba'i

200 ga / ba sgro tshe brtan gun tshogs kyi rtsom rig brtsams cho zugs ba gas/———blo gsar tshor yang ched las kyi stong tshan der 'jug pa'i sgo chen zhig gsar du rnyed pa bcas byung zhing / gzhung lugs de'i dang brgyud rim ldan pa'i sgo nas rtsom gyi lus dang rgyan/ tshig rgyan gyi dbye ba chen po dang / de dag la'ang nang gses yan lag gi khyad par dang nying lag gi dbye ba sogs rgyan gyi bye brag mi 'dra ba brgya phrag 'ga' shas so sor bshad yod pa ma zad/ de rnams re rer yang rang rang gi mtshan nyid bstan yod pa/ dus mtshungs snyan rtsom gyi skyon bcu dang / dpe'i skyon/ de'i sel thabs la sogs pa'ang bshad yod pa bcas mdor na nang don mang che ba skabs de'i bod kyi rtsom rigashong spel gtong ba'i dgos mkho dang mthun zhing / gzhung der rtsom pa po'i blo 'khrid yid 'gug gi nus pa 'ang cung che tsam ldan yod pa red/ der brten bod kyi grub mtha' khag gi mkhas pa ser skya ris su ma chad pa du mas gzhung lugs de la khrid sbyong dang zhib 'jug gnang ba ma zad/ mdor na rim bzhin rtsom gyi sgyu rtsal la 'bad brtson byed pa'i dmigs tshad kyang skabs de'i phyi phyogs rtsom ris gi snyan grags rtser son gang yin pa de ji lta ba zhig brtsam rgyu'i snying stobs bcangs yod pa dper na/ sman ri ba blo bzang rnam rgyal gyis (bsngags 'os bsngags pa 〉gsar rtsom mdzad skabs rtsom par dam bca' ba'i nang du 6ngo mtshar gtam gyi lang tsho mtho ris chab/ /sgra don rgyan gyi dbu ba'i 'dzum phreng ma/ /lam gsum gang las 'ongs kyang mkhas rnams yid/ /kun dga'i bdud rtsi sbyin la khyad med kyang / /bsta dzā ti'i sdebs stor me tog i /phreng bas spud pa'i rtogs brjod dpag bsam shing / /nyams 'gyur yal 'dab 'bum du grol ba yis/ /yid rab mi 'phrog snyan ngag mkhan dbang su//zab dang rgya che'i blo gros mtshor/ /dbyangs can ngang mo rol bas mchog sbyin pa/ /ma lus mkhas pa 'i gtsug rgyan dge ba'i dbang / /yab sras gsung gi rjes su slar btud nas/ /snyan pa'i tshig

ga /bod mi rigs kyi gul byung rtsom rig 'dzin spel dgos pa/ 201wa wa — —dang 'grogs byas mkhas pa rnams/ /chang mig ma dang lang tsho can bzhin du/ /gsar pa 'i dga' dang grasalapa 'byung 'gyur zhes/ /nges par bstan pa'ang don dang ldan pa'i slad/ /'phags yul mkhas la grasas pa'i lci yang sogs/ /sdebs sbyor mtshan nyid bod la ma mchis kyang / /tshigs bcad rkyang pa'i lus mchos rgyan mang gis/ /brgyan pa snyan ngag chen po'i bstan bcos 'di/ /daṇḍi'i gzhung mi dang 'gal bsngalas 'os nyid/ bsngags pa'i tshig sbyor me tog phreng brgyus nas/ /khyab bdag dus mkhyen rgyal po'i rnam thar dang / rjes su mthun pa'i legs byas bdas gir bya/smyo zhes gsungs yo da pa ma zad/ dam bcas pa ltar snyan ngag gi bstan bcos de legs pa ra brtsams grub pa'i rjes su pa ra du 'bod skabs ldan rje ngas dbang chos 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i par byang du'ang go ṭa'i lugs kyi snyan ngag mgul pa las/ /blangs pa'i rgyal sras dpa' bo'i rtogs brjod glu/ /dpag bsam 'khri shing 'dor byed bsngags 'os nyid/ /bsngags pa'i ngo mtshar phrag dog mi 'gyur ram/rte zhes sogs kyis bstod pa'ang don la sanas pa yin snyam/ de ltar snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs de spyad nas chos srid dang rig sanas kyi brjod bya zab cing rgya che ba'i com rig ji snye da cig lo brgya phrag 'ga' shas kyi ring spel bar brten bod kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag de sngar bas khyab che ba zhig byung ba bcas lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim de ltar brgyud nas rang re bod kyi snga rabs rtsom ris 'di phan sam tshogs shing 'od sto nga 'pho ba rigazi rigs dzom mjugazhig tu rim 'gyur byung ba yin pa las/ dus gcig la cha tshang lhun gyis grub pa'am/ yang na mkhas pa gcig dang gnyis kyis gsar gtod gnang ba zhig ni rtsa ba nas ma yin la de 'dra yong yang srid kyi ma red /bod kyi rtsom rig 'o rgyus la phyir mig yul tsam zhis bltas pa de'i thog nas rtsom rig sgyu rtsal yang 'jig rten thos gi bya dngos gzhan dag dang 'dra bar
